rows.title: Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Salary: £43,000 - £48,000

Leonardo UK operates a grade-based salary framework with broad bands. The salary range shown reflects the approved grade band for this role, or a narrower hiring range published within that band, and is benchmarked against the external market. Exceptions above the standard range are managed through governance controls to protect internal equity.

Your Impact

We have an excellent opportunity for a Procurement Data Analyst to join the UK Category Management Organisation within the Procurement & Commercial Function of the Electronics Division. The successful candidate will report to the Head of Direct UK Category Management.

What You Will Do

Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to gather, understand and report forecast data to enable sourcing and contract activities.Establish and develop Power BI reports.Develop and maintain inflation reports.Develop, manage and report Procurement key performance indicators. Create data dashboards, graphs and visualisations for category strategies and business reviews. Collate and analyse spend and performance related data. Determine and implement actions accordingly.Gather, analyse and report supply risk data in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.Act as point of contact for Procurement reporting, supporting data requests from the Procurement team.Establish strong relationships with stakeholders.Ability to work independently and with teams to meet requirements and deadlines.Knowledge of design and build quality datasets that enable stakeholders to make decisions, provide business recommendations and solutions.Provide supplier and market intelligence information and analysis to enable effective long-term decision-making and manage risk.Set up and maintain automated data processes.Identify, evaluate and implement solutions to support large volume data validation and cleansing.Monitor and audit data quality.Design and carry out surveys and analyse survey data.Focus on leading indicators and improving the function through effective analysis and reporting.Mine and analyse large datasets, draw valid inferences and present them successfully to management.Active participation in cross business working to support development of data management processes and process policies.

What You Will Bring

Good knowledge in analytics and reporting covering complex range of sub disciplines including – process, performance and supplier risk management.MS Office proficient, with expert level in MS Excel and Power BI.Extensive SAP user experience.Methodical and diligent with good planning abilities.Excellent interpersonal/communication and presentation skills, including the proven ability to influence at all levels, internally and externally.Able to work unsupervised and can operate well as part of a team.An understanding of Supply Chain and Procurement principles, techniques and practicesSelf-motivated, able to identify & drive key issues.Demonstrate collaborative and supportive behaviours. The ability to build strong and trusted relationships to achieve objectives.

Security Clearance

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). An additional range of Personnel Security Controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV) may apply, this could include meeting the eligibility requirements for The Security Check (SC) or Developed Vetting (DV). For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting

Why join us

At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.

Time to Recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year.Secure your Future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution.Your Wellbeing Matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Armed Forces, Carers, Wellbeing and Ethnicity).Rewarding Performance: All employees at management level and below are eligible for our bonus scheme.Never Stop Learning: Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning.Refer a friend: Receive a financial reward through our referral programme.Tailored Perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more.Flexible working: Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role.

For a full list of our company benefits please visit our website.

GB - Luton - Cap. Green 300

GB - Basildon, GB - Edinburgh

Permanent

rows.title: Customer Performance Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Join us at Entrust 

At Entrust, we’re shaping the future of identity centric security solutions. From our comprehensive portfolio of solutions to our flexible, global workplace, we empower careers, foster collaboration, and build solutions that help keep the world moving safely. 

  

Get to Know Us 

Headquartered in Minnesota, Entrust is an industry leader in identity-centric security solutions, serving over 150 countries with cutting-edge, scalable technologies. But our secret weapon? Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future. 

Help Shape Exceptional Customer Experiences Through Data

At Entrust, we're committed to enabling trusted identities, secure payments, and data protection for organizations worldwide. As a Customer Performance Analyst, you'll play a key role in ensuring our products consistently deliver exceptional performance for our customers.

This is an exciting opportunity for a naturally curious and analytical professional who enjoys solving complex problems, uncovering insights from data, and partnering with cross-functional teams to drive meaningful outcomes. You'll become a trusted advisor on product performance, helping identify trends, resolve customer-impacting issues, and improve the overall customer experience.

What You'll Do

As a Customer Performance Analyst, you'll combine data analytics, customer engagement, and cross-functional collaboration to proactively improve product performance and customer satisfaction.

Customer Support & Performance Insights

Develop a deep understanding of Entrust products and performance metrics.Analyze customer performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks.Provide evidence-based recommendations to help customers achieve their objectives.Build strong relationships with customers through clear, timely, and empathetic communication.

Data Analysis & Problem Solving

Investigate large and complex datasets to uncover actionable insights.Translate ambiguous problems into structured analyses and meaningful recommendations.Challenge assumptions and proactively identify root causes of unexpected results.Drive investigations through to resolution, ensuring stakeholders are informed throughout.

Product Performance Monitoring

Monitor key product performance indicators and identify emerging issues.Escalate concerns and coordinate with engineering, product, and support teams when required.Help establish best practices for proactive performance management and reporting.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with Support Engineers, Software Engineers, Product Managers, Customer Success Managers, and other stakeholders.Communicate technical findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.Act as the central point of coordination for customer-impacting performance issues.

Ownership & Continuous Improvement

Take ownership of investigations from initial problem definition through to resolution.Demonstrate sound judgment regarding when to escalate issues and when to independently drive solutions.Continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, reporting, and customer outcomes.

Required Qualifications

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to derive insights from large datasets.Experience using Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or similar tools for data analysis and reporting.Excellent written and verbal communication skills.Ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.Comfortable working in both structured and ambiguous environments.Self-motivated with a proactive, "can-do" attitude and a growth mindset.Collaborative team player who thrives in cross-functional environments.Fast learner with a passion for continuous development.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline or another field with a strong analytical focus.Experience with Looker or similar business intelligence and analytics platforms.Working knowledge of SQL.Previous experience in a data analytics, business analytics, or performance analysis role.Exposure to technology organizations, particularly working alongside Engineering, Machine Learning, or Product teams.

Why Join Entrust?

At Entrust, you'll have the opportunity to work with industry-leading technologies that help secure identities, payments, and data around the world. You'll be part of a collaborative team where your insights directly influence customer success and product performance.

We believe in empowering our employees through continuous learning, career growth, and meaningful work that makes a global impact.

At Entrust, we don’t just offer jobs – we offer career journeys. Here is what you can expect when you join our team: 

Career Growth: Whether you’re a budding developer or a seasoned expert, we’re invested in your professional journey. With learning-forward initiatives and exciting challenges, your growth is our priority.  Flexibility: Life is all about balance. Whether you’re remote, hybrid, or on-site, we offer flexible options that fit your lifestyle.  Collaboration: Here, your voice matters. Our teams thrive on sharing ideas, brainstorming solutions, and working together to build a better tomorrow.  

We believe in securing identities—but it doesn’t stop there. At Entrust, we’re passionate about valuing all identities. Our culture is built on diversity, inclusion, and respect. From unconscious bias training for our leaders to global affinity groups that connect colleagues across the globe, we’re creating a community where everyone is encouraged to be themselves. 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

If you’re excited by the prospect of innovating, growing your career, and collaborating in a dynamic environment, Entrust is the place for you. Join us in making a difference. Let’s build a more secure world—together. 

  

Apply today! 

For more information, visit www.entrust.com.  Follow us on, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube

For US Roles, Or Where Applicable

Entrust is an EEO/AA/Disabled/Veterans Employer

For Canadian Roles, Or Where Applicable

Entrust values diversity and inclusion and we are committed to building a diverse workforce with wide perspectives and innovative ideas. We welcome applications from qualified individuals of all backgrounds, and we strive to provide an accessible experience for candidates of all abilities. 

If you require an accommodation, contact accessibility@entrust.com.

rows.title: Data Analyst (Strategic Projects)
rows.descriptionText:
About Lendable
Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 peopleAmong the fastest-growing tech companies in the UKProfitable since 2017Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman SachsLoved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to
Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutionsBuild the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About The Role
We’re building the most advanced, data-driven operating model in fintech. As part of Lendable’s Operations Science & Strategy team, you’ll sit at the intersection of analytics, data science, and AI engineering - using data, LLMs, and automation to transform how our Operations teams work at scale.

You’ll work directly with senior operations leadership working on special projects to diagnose demand drivers, uncover commercial opportunities, build KPI frameworks, and deploy automation that materially reduces our cost-to-serve while improving customer outcomes.

If you’re technical, curious, and love owning problems end-to-end, this is the role for you.

What You’ll DoWhat We’re Looking For
 Automation & AI EngineeringUse Python and LLM APIs (e.g. OpenAI) to design and deploy automation that replaces manual CS/FS processes.Build prototypes, test with real operations data, and scale the successful ones into production workflows.Partner with PMs and engineers to operationalise AI-driven solutions across Operations. Demand Analytics & StrategyAnalyse key operations demand drivers (contact per customer, reason drivers, seasonality, servicing behaviour).Identify levers to reduce avoidable demand and improve customer outcomes.Build analytical models that drive decision-making around cost optimisation and resourcing. KPI & Funnel IntelligenceBuild clear, robust KPI frameworks and funnel views across customer journeys.Translate data into commercial insight, operational efficiency recommendations, and productivity tracking.Create metrics that scale across new geographies, products, and teams. Work With Senior LeadershipWork directly with Ops Directors, Heads of CS/FS/Fraud/Complaints, and the COO on strategic initiatives.Turn raw data into narrative-driven recommendations that are simple, actionable, and commercially grounded.Own analytics for high-impact projects end-to-end.

Must-Have Skills
2-3 years of hands-on experience using Python in a professional setting.Highly numerate with strong analytical reasoning Ability to independently structure analysis, build prototypes, and deliver insights.Experience communicating data-driven recommendations to non-technical business stakeholders.

Nice-to-Haves
STEM DegreeExperience with dbt or modern data stacks.Familiarity with LLMs, APIs, or interest in building AI automation.Exposure to product, strategy, or operations environments.Thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.Comfortable wearing multiple hats Analyst, Data Scientist, AI Engineer, PM.Highly motivated, entrepreneurial mindset, and excited by building the strongest operating model in fintech.

Why Join
Work on high-visibility, high-impact projects that directly shape the future of Lendable’s operations.Build automation and analytics used daily by hundreds of agents and thousands of customers.Collaborate with a small, sharp, and ambitious team that moves fast.Real ownership: if you build it, you’ll see it shipped and scaled.

Interview process

Screening Call + Python Questions

Live Technical Python Interview

Final interviews with 2 senior leaders

Life at Lendable
Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companiesFlexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sitesSocials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office wallsHealth coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health coverRetirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plansEmployee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team membersOffice meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locationsSustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

rows.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!

As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.

YourParkingSpace joined forces with Arrive on our joint mission to make cities more livable, together. YourParkingSpace is one of the UK’s fastest-growing parking technology providers, changing the way people park. Our on-demand marketplace connects drivers to thousands of spaces, while our comprehensive suite of B2B solutions transforms parking assets into connected mobility hubs.

The role

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we use data to drive growth and business impact. You’ll translate complex datasets into strategic insights and actionable recommendations that move the business forward. This is a hands-on role where you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams across Commercial, Product and Operations to ensure stakeholders have the right data, insights and metrics to make confident decisions. You’ll own analytics projects end-to-end, from understanding the initial business problem through to extracting and analysing data, developing visualisations and communicating meaningful recommendations.

How To Make An Impact

Lead end-to-end analytics projects, from scoping stakeholder requirements to data extraction, analysis in SQL, visualisation and presentation of actionable insights. Partner closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Product and Operations to identify strategic opportunities for growth and improvement. Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical frameworks that enable teams to make informed, data-driven decisions. Help define and maintain consistent business metrics and KPIs. Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes. Challenge assumptions and requirements to ensure we're solving the right business problems. Continuously monitor and improve data quality, ensuring stakeholders can trust the insights they use. Proactively explore data to uncover emerging trends, risks and opportunities. 

Your background

A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience. 2+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics or a similar analytics role. Advanced SQL skills, with the ability to independently extract, manipulate and analyse complex datasets. Experience using Tableau or another mainstream BI/data visualisation tool, such as Power BI, Looker, Metabase or Sisense. Strong commercial awareness and an ability to connect analysis with meaningful business outcomes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. A proactive approach, with the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions and take ownership. Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning complex business requirements into meaningful insights. 

The role is based in London, UK, with a hybrid working model requiring three days per week in the office.

About Arrive

Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

rows.title: Data Analysis & Insights Project Intern (TikTok Shop) - 2026 Start - 2027 Start
rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities

The TikTok commerce team builds the solutions that help businesses engage audiences, inspire product discovery, and create commercial experiences on a platform where brands and merchants connect meaningfully with creators and communities.

We work closely with merchants, creators, and partners to support sustainable business growth while keeping the experience safe and trusted for the community. As the business scales across global markets, we take on complex challenges across content, commerce, trust, and the differing needs of each local market.

You will help shape the future of AI-native commerce, where discovery, entertainment, and buying happen in the same place.

About The Team

The e-Commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-Commerce experience to our users.

As a Project Intern, you will contribute to impactful short-term projects and gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, professional environment. This internship offers the opportunity to develop practical skills, apply your knowledge to real-world challenges, and explore your career interests.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

Responsibilities

 Support project-based goal tracking by monitoring key metrics across merchant and product performance, including sample supply, content output, and sales contribution. Analyze data to identify high-potential merchants and products, helping define the incubation profile and pathway for affiliate-focused sellers. Track and report on sample supply and content creation trends, identifying gaps and opportunities to optimize resource allocation. Assist in preparing weekly reports and analytical materials to summarize business performance and highlight key trends. Contribute to case study development by analyzing merchant and product performance, providing data-backed insights to support Account Managers in merchant outreach and pitch preparation. Help synthesize best practices and develop actionable pathways for merchants to optimize their affiliate investments. Support the consolidation of hit product cases by gathering data and insights from cross-functional teams, including policy resources, merchant BD inputs, and match-making incubation cases. Assist in quantifying the value of hit products by analyzing metrics such as sustained GMV growth contribution, merchant tier upgrades, and overall store GMV impact. Help document and communicate the methodology behind hit product incubation—for example, the correlation between sample investments, content volume, creator partnerships, and product success—to educate merchants and Account Managers on best practices.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s)

 Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree Available to start immediately until the end of the year Highly interested in the e-Commerce industry, with strong curiosity and the ability to learn quickly, and understand the short video/content and live broadcast ecosystems of TikTok. Proficient in Excel/Lark Sheets, with basic data analysis skills

Preferred Qualification(s)

 Be mindful of data and be able to proficiently use at least one data visualization analysis tool. Previous experience in influencer affiliate, content strategy, or e-Commerce operations will be highly valued. Programming or coding skills are a plus; interest in leveraging internal and external tools and models to explore AI-powered solutions for operational work is highly preferred.

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

rows.title: Social Insights Analyst, Studios
rows.descriptionText:
Job Requirements

About the Role & Team

At The Walt Disney Company, our stories connect with audiences around the world. Behind every successful release is a deep understanding of audience behaviour, cultural trends and evolving conversations. The Studios Intelligence team provides the audience, market and commercial insight that helps shape strategic decision-making across Disney's Studios business throughout EMEA.

We are currently looking for two Social Insights Analysts to join the Studios Intelligence team. In these roles, you will play a key part in helping Disney understand how audiences engage with our films, franchises and campaigns online. Combining social listening, audience analysis and cultural intelligence, you will uncover meaningful insights that inform marketing strategy, campaign optimisation, commercial decision-making and long-term planning.

Working across a wide range of Studios releases and the broader entertainment landscape, you'll transform complex social and cultural signals into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders across the business. You'll partner with colleagues across Studios Intelligence, Global Studios teams, external partners and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure audience perspectives remain at the heart of decision-making.

If selected for one of these roles, you will report to the Manager, Social Listening & Research.

These roles will be based in our London Hammersmith office, 4 days a week, with either a Monday or Friday working from home.

You'll join a team grounded in our Disney values: acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration, and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day.

What You Will Do

As a Social Insights Analyst, you will help translate online conversations and audience behaviour into insight that drives action across Disney's Studios business. Responsibilities include:

Analysing social listening, owned social, video and platform data to understand audience conversation, sentiment, engagement, content performance and emerging trends.Configuring, testing and refining social listening queries to ensure accurate and reliable data capture across campaigns, titles and markets.Monitoring online communities, competitor activity, platform developments and cultural conversations to identify opportunities, risks and relevant audience trends.Delivering insight across recurring social intelligence programmes as well as responding to fast-paced ad hoc stakeholder requests.Translating complex data and social signals into clear, compelling insight presentations, reports and executive summaries.Identifying implications for campaign strategy, audience targeting, creative development and content positioning.Evaluating campaign performance and audience response to marketing activity, content and creative assets.Contributing social and cultural insight to broader audience, market and commercial analysis across the Studios Intelligence team.Producing accurate, high-quality reporting, dashboards and analysis for a wide range of stakeholders.Maintaining and validating datasets, dashboards and measurement frameworks to ensure reliable reporting across EMEA markets.Collaborating with internal partners, global teams and external vendors to support business priorities.Helping evolve social listening methodologies, reporting practices, data visualisation approaches and AI-enabled ways of working.Staying informed about developments across social platforms, emerging tools and industry best practice.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience analysing social, digital or audience data to understand online behaviour, audience conversation and content performance.Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, with the ability to identify trends, patterns and actionable insights from complex datasets.Ability to translate data and analysis into clear, engaging and impactful recommendations for a variety of audiences.Excellent written and verbal communication skills.Strong organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.A collaborative approach and the ability to build effective working relationships across teams and stakeholders.Curiosity about entertainment, digital culture, audience behaviour and emerging trends.A proactive mindset with a passion for learning, innovation and continuous improvement.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using social listening platforms and social intelligence tools.Familiarity with Boolean query building.Experience creating dashboards and data visualisations.Knowledge of measurement frameworks and digital performance reporting.Interest in AI-assisted analytical approaches and emerging technologies.

The Perks

25 days annual leavePrivate medical insurance and dental careComplimentary admission to eligible Disney Theme Parks, giving you the opportunity to experience the magic we create and make memories of your own. Admission is subject to availability, capacity restrictions, applicable rules, block-out dates, and eligibility requirements.Access to a wide range of Disney discounts on Disney merchandise, Disney Food & Beverage, Disney Resort Hotels, Disney Cruise Line, Adventures by Disney, National Geographic Expeditions, and more. rows.title: BI Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Blue Light Card. Individually great, together unstoppable

The Role and the Team

We're looking for a BI Analyst to join us on a 12-month fixed-term contract, focused on metrics governance and enablement. Reporting to the BI Lead, you'll be part of a small, closely connected team and work with colleagues across every function, including senior stakeholders, to agree what our key measures mean and who owns them. You'll then build the data models and reporting that bring those measures to life and help people use self-serve analytics with confidence.

It's a hands-on role for someone who loves building, and who equally enjoys working with people to turn business questions into clear answers. You'll work mainly in SQL, dbt and Lightdash, alongside Claude and other AI-assisted development, in a fast-paced, supportive, AI-first environment with plenty of room to take ownership.

What You'll Do

Support our metrics governance programme by helping stakeholders agree consistent definitions and clear ownership of key measuresBuild and maintain data models and dashboards end to end, from the first business question to a finished product colleagues can use with confidenceScope, build, test and deliver dbt and SQL work, using AI-assisted development where it helps and checking the output carefullyDocument and test the data behind each key measure, and keep definitions and supporting documentation current so knowledge is shared rather than held by one personDeliver regular business reporting with accuracy and care, and keep our analytics tools reliable and easy to useCoach colleagues who are not data specialists, explaining concepts simply and sharing good practice so teams can act on data without waiting on the Data teamPartner with stakeholders across the business, including senior stakeholders, to understand their priorities and turn them into clear, reliable measures and reportingTurn open-ended business problems and ad hoc questions into clear analysis and recommendations that guide next steps, and keep people informed of progress, risks and any support needed


What You'll Bring

Hands-on experience building and maintaining data models in a modern analytics stack, such as dbt, in a professional settingStrong SQL and data modelling skills, with the ability to scope, build, test and deliver your own workExperience building dashboards and reports in a BI tool, such as Lightdash, Looker or TableauComfort working with stakeholders at all levels, including senior stakeholders: asking the right questions, explaining clearly and building agreement togetherThe ability to turn an open-ended business problem into clear analysis and a recommendation others can act on, while managing multiple prioritiesExperience of coaching or building confidence in colleagues who are not data specialistsUse of AI tools to work faster and more accurately, with good judgement on checking the outputExperience of metrics governance, working with data in a digitally native or fast-paced environment, or working in an AI or machine learning setting would be a bonus


Our Culture

Our mission is simple: make heroes happy. Our members are real-life heroes who keep us all safe, cared for, and thriving. It's what gets us up in the morning, what makes us want to think bigger, and create something that truly matters. By focusing on their happiness, we create amazing experiences, deliver unrivalled discounts, innovative products, and world-class service.

We don't just follow the usual path - we look for smarter, bolder ways to deliver real impact. We take ownership, move fast, and work shoulder to shoulder to build something special.

We promote hybrid working, and value in-person collaboration so encourage time in our offices – either the HQ in Leicestershire, or London, Holborn office. The frequency and office location will vary depending on the role and team. We aim to be flexible, but we aren't able to offer fully remote working.

Blue Light Card is an equal opportunities employer. We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team where different perspectives and experiences help us grow, innovate, and better reflect the communities we serve. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. In the event of a high number of applications, we'll prioritise candidates who meet both the essential and desirable criteria for the role.

What We Offer

25 days annual leave plus public holidays and an additional day off for your birthdayA Moments that Matter day – one extra day of leave each year to use for something that matters to youBuy and sell holiday scheme of up to 5 daysA volunteering/fundraising day – one paid day each year to give something back to the communityAnnual company bonus scheme – linked to both company and individual performanceYour own Blue Light Card and exclusive access to thousands of discountsPersonal growth fund of £450 per year to invest in your developmentPrivate Medical Insurance that includes cover for pre-existing conditionsAuto-enrolment pension scheme via salary sacrifice, with 100% of employer NI savings reinvested into your pensionEnhanced Maternity, Partner, Adoption and Shared Parental LeaveHealthcare cash-back planColleague Assistance Programme – 24/7 confidential support whenever you need itHybrid working and flexible hoursEV charging and free parking onsite at HQRelaxed dress code and modern office space (games area, chill-out areas, book club, free drinks and well stocked snack drawers!)On-site gym including free HIIT and stretch classes at HQ

rows.title: Lead Associate, Investigations, Diligence and Compliance - Core (Arabic Speaker)
rows.descriptionText:
Join Kroll's Global Investigations, Diligence and Compliance Core team and gain hands-on experience in the dynamic field of compliance consulting. We are seeking motivated and detail-oriented individuals to contribute as new joiners here at Kroll.

Through a combination of expertise, global research capabilities and flexible technology tools, the Investigations, Diligence and Compliance Core practice of Kroll helps clients take a risk-based approach toward meeting obligations or remediating failures regarding anti-bribery, anti-corruption and related regulatory mandates. These include pre-transactional intelligence; vendor, supplier and distributor due diligence; vendor screening and monitoring; country/industry risk; and bespoke inquiries.

At Kroll, your work will help deliver clarity to our clients’ most complex governance, risk, and transparency challenges. Apply now to join One team, One Kroll.

Responsibilities

Have an analytical mind and enthusiasm for research and investigation? Come join our thriving global team and work with Fortune 500 clients in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment!

We are committed to the continuous professional support and development of our people; hone your skills and master new ones with the support of a world-class in-house training program. Become a regional specialist, learn to lead, deepen your linguistic abilities, build technical expertise--the opportunities are endless.

The right candidate will have outstanding English reading and writing skills, outstanding Arabic language skills in reading comprehension, meticulous attention to detail, a sense of curiosity, the ability and enthusiasm to learn quickly, and a dedication to client satisfaction.

Conduct Arabic and English-language due diligence research using public record databases, commercial and proprietary databases, and news media and internet sources in various jurisdictions Collaborate with investigators to interview trusted in-country sources about the background, reputation, and current status of the subject(s) of a due diligence investigation.Apply knowledge of various regulations and statutes, including the US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, UK Bribery Act, and EU GDPR, to daily work responsibilities. Manage multiple projects simultaneously from start to finish in a fast-paced and collaborative environment while meeting tight deadlines.

Requirements

Extremely strong English-language reading and writing skills, ability to quickly and effectively summarize information from multiple sources into a concise analytical assessmentProfessional/Native language proficiency in the Arabic languageAbility to conduct online research using various primary and secondary sourcesAbility to quickly and effectively summarize information from multiple sources into concise analytical assessmentsAbility to work independently in a fast-paced, collaborative environmentAbility to understand, accept and apply constructive feedbackResponsible for managing and prioritizing several projects or assignments simultaneously while meeting tight deadlines

Preferred Skills

Undergraduate or graduate degrees, especially in the social sciences, are preferred but not requiredOrganizational and time management competenciesAdvanced proficiency in reading comprehension in any other languageAttention to detailAbility to communicate effectively verbally and in writingInterest and understanding of current events, international affairs, financial regulations, and economics and/or financeBasic knowledge of litigation, regulatory, sanctions and corporate organization / structure terminology and concepts is highly preferred2-3 years of professional experience (including internships)

About Kroll

Join the global leader in risk and financial advisory solutions—Kroll. With a nearly century-long legacy, we blend trusted expertise with cutting-edge technology to navigate and redefine industry complexities. As a part of One Team, One Kroll, you'll contribute to a collaborative and empowering environment, propelling your career to new heights. Ready to build, protect, restore and maximize our clients’ value? Your journey begins with Kroll.

rows.title: Marketplace Success Internship
rows.descriptionText:
Temper is growing fast in the UK, and we’re looking for an intern to help us grow even faster. Temper is a fast-scaling marketplace in the UK and the Netherlands, connecting companies that need extra hands for shifts with flexible professionals who want to work for them. You will find workers for our platform (FreeFlexers) wherever we need them most, whether that’s a new location or a new type of job for our clients. Temper makes its money from both sides of the business; clients and the workers, you will own the FreeFlexer side of the business and directly impact Temper’s revenue from day one. This internship is designed as a stepping stone to a permanent role for exceptional performers.

Note: you must be available to work from early November onwards to apply.

🧩 The challenge 
Work with our account managers and sales team to find out which shifts our clients need filled in each new location. We operate in hospitality, logistics and retail, so you’ll be finding a wide range of FreeFlexers: bartenders, waiters, event crew, chefs, drivers, retail assistants and more.Follow our proven playbook to find and onboard FreeFlexers in new locations across the UK.Be the first friendly voice our applicants hear from Temper. Reach out by phone, email and other channels, help them set up their Temper profile and get them excited for their first shift.When the usual approach doesn’t work, quickly put together a plan to reach FreeFlexers using a mix of online and offline channels. Test new ideas, whether that’s local partnerships with schools and colleges, community events or something we haven’t tried yet, and see what works.Run our ambassador programme and motivate existing FreeFlexers to refer their friends.Find creative ways to keep new FreeFlexers engaged and coming back for shifts, through events, perks, CRM tools and other channels.

🤝 Your Temper team

You’ll join our UK Marketplace Success team and help drive Temper’s growth in new UK locations. You’ll also work with our Marketplace Success team in the Netherlands to exchange ideas and learn from what’s worked there. Day to day, you’ll work closely with the wider UK team, including account managers and sales reps, to make sure we’re finding the right FreeFlexers for our clients. You’ll be in touch with almost everyone in the business, which makes this a great role for seeing how Temper works from every angle.The role is hybrid, with a minimum two days in the office each week; the rest of the time, you can work wherever you like. We work hard and win hard. You’ll have the freedom to test your own ideas and take ownership of your work, backed by a team that celebrates success and moves quickly together.

👩 💻 How we work
At Temper, we embrace a dynamic hybrid work model that blends the best of both worlds: the energy of our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and London, and the flexibility to work from home. We believe in empowering our team to thrive in a way that suits them best. Need a change of scenery? You'll find the support and flexibility to make the most of your talents at Temper.
💪 What makes you a great fit:
You’re confident and comfortable on the phone, and happy to make plenty of calls in a day.You’re organised and persistent, and can follow a process and work through a list without losing momentum.You love solving problems and enjoy coming up with fresh ideas when the standard approach isn’t working.You’re data-driven. You use data and AI tools to spot issues, solve them and present innovative solutions, and you’ll have access to Claude to help you do it.You have a strong drive to succeed and can show where you’ve gone the extra mile, whether in work, sport, education or elsewhere.You’re happy to roll up your sleeves and do whatever needs doing, even beyond your core responsibilities.You’re available to start in early November, 4-5 days a week, and are based in London or able to travel regularly.
⭐ Nice to have...Experience in a phone-based role, such as sales, recruitment or customer service.Experience in promotions or marketing.Are comfortable using Looker and ClaudeExperience or knowledge of software such as Asana and Salesforce
🎁 What we offer:
Work closely with experienced professionals in a supportive and collaborative team environment.Hands-on exposure to a fast-growing scale-up at our centrally located London office.Flexible working hours to fit around your academic commitments.Paid lunch and travel expenses when visiting the office.Laptop and the gear you need.Compensation of £2000 per month.
🚀 We are Temper
Are you passionate about helping people adjust work to fit their lives, not the other way around? At Temper, our mission is to revolutionize the labor market with technology, making it fairer, more accessible, and efficient. We empower the new generation of workers who crave flexibility and control over when and where they work— by providing them with a solution right at their fingertips!
What makes our platform successful is that it is built around our users’ needs - We do it for them! We take pride in our user-centric approach, constantly evolving to meet their demands and exceed expectations. Our goal is to give businesses a tool that lets them easily connect with great people looking for flexible shift work.
At Temper, every team member has the opportunity to make a significant impact. Our core value, "We Own It," drives our culture (quite literally, as you will see in our equity plan). We believe in empowering you to take ownership and responsibility, so that together, we can take Temper to the next level.
Our unique culture is proudly embodied by our colleagues at Temper. With over 20 nationalities represented, we embrace remote work across more than 10 countries, alongside our bustling offices in Amsterdam and London. Twice a year, we come together to connect, share knowledge, and foster our vibrant community.
Join us on this exciting journey as we redefine the future of work! Your passion and dedication will shape the way millions approach their careers worldwide.—----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Apply now! What can you expect afterwards? Recruiter call (30 minutes)Manager interview (30 minutes)Manager interview (30 minutes)

rows.title: Machine Learning Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Why Faculty? 

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About The Team

In our Retail & Consumer Business Unit, we bring everything we have learned in more than a decade of Applied AI and use it to help leading retailers, consumer brands, marketplaces, and digital commerce businesses navigate a rapidly evolving landscape.

We develop and embed AI solutions that help organisations better understand their customers, optimise operations, improve forecasting and decision-making, and unlock new opportunities for growth. From supply chains and merchandising to marketing, personalisation, and customer experience, we work with clients to deliver measurable commercial impact through AI. We are proud to combine technical excellence with practical deployment, ensuring solutions create value in complex, real-world environments.

About The Role

Join us as a Machine Learning Engineer to deliver bespoke, impactful AI solutions for our diverse Retail & Consumer clients.

You will be instrumental in bringing machine learning out of the lab and into the real world, contributing to scalable software architecture and defining best practices. Working closely with clients and cross-functional teams, you’ll ensure the technical feasibility and successful delivery of high-quality, production-grade ML systems that drive tangible business outcomes.

What You’ll Be Doing

Building and deploying production-grade ML software, tools, and infrastructure.Creating reusable, scalable solutions that accelerate the delivery of AI and machine learning systems across retail and consumer use cases.Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, product teams, and commercial leads to solve critical client challenges.Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions to ensure project feasibility, scalability, and commercial impact.Defining and implementing Faculty’s standards for deploying machine learning systems in production.Acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex ML concepts into actionable business outcomes.Applying machine learning to challenges such as demand forecasting, customer analytics, personalisation, pricing, marketing optimisation, inventory management, and operational efficiency.Supporting clients in adopting AI capabilities that improve customer experiences and drive sustainable growth.

Who We’re Looking For

You understand the full machine learning lifecycle and have experience operationalising models built with frameworks such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.You possess strong Python skills and solid experience in software engineering best practices.You bring hands-on experience with cloud platforms and infrastructure (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture and security.You’ve worked with containerisation and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes to build and manage applications at scale.You are comfortable with core ML concepts, including probability, statistics, experimentation, and common machine learning techniques.Experience working with retail, consumer, ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, or customer data is beneficial but not essential.You’re an excellent communicator, able to guide technical teams and confidently advise non-technical stakeholders.You thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy the autonomy to own scope, solve challenging problems, and deliver impactful solutions.

Our interview process

Talent Team Screen (30 mins)Pair Programming Interview (90 mins)System Design Interview (90 mins)Commercial Interview (60 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

rows.title: Account Manager - Financial Sponsor Coverage
rows.descriptionText:
Ideas | People | Trust

We’re BDO. An accountancy and business advisory firm, providing the advice and solutions entrepreneurial organisations need to navigate today’s changing world.

We work with the companies that are Britain’s economic engine – ambitious, entrepreneurially-spirited and high growth businesses that fuel the economy - and directly advise the owners and management teams that lead them.

We’ll broaden your horizons

Our Sales & Marketing team is building a function that reflects who we are: open, trusted and focused on shaping what matters. You’ll join a team big enough to offer big priorities and commercial challenges, yet personal enough to ensure you’re supported and empowered from day one.

Here, we think beyond. You’ll bring ideas, challenge thinking and help shape how we deliver campaigns, insights and engagement across the business. Working closely with internal clients, you’ll deepen your understanding of our sectors and see how connected teams drive our 2028 growth ambitions.

From strategic storytelling to capability‑building and smarter ways of working, you’ll grow your skills while working with people who care about doing the right thing.

We’ll help you succeed

In this team, development is central to how we work. You’ll have access to best‑in‑class training, clear capability frameworks and hands‑on learning that give you the confidence and skills to grow quickly.

We make it personal with supportive teams where you belong, are trusted, and take transformative work on early. You’ll collaborate across service lines and leadership levels, building relationships grounded in openness and accountability.

You’ll bring your best - taking ownership, delivering quality and building trust across the firm. In return, you’ll get clarity, fair feedback and the development you need to succeed. You won’t just complete tasks - you’ll help shape how the team evolves and how we support the business.

The Sales and marketing team are looking to recruit an Account Manager to be deployed to the Financial Sponsor Coverage Key Account Programme. The key account provides the strategic, structural and operational backbone for BDO’s institutional approach to private equity. Operating at the centre of the FSC team, the role designs nuanced frameworks, embeds processes and ensures UK and global alignment across streams, sectors and regions. Although not directly client‑facing day‑to‑day, the role supports Lead Relationship Partners and the Financial Sponsor Coverage team, and manages selected priority accounts to model best practice and drive a consistent, insight‑led, institutional‑grade approach. The Account Manager is accountable for improving retention, expansion and client outcomes through disciplined account practices supporting account teams to deliver high-quality engagement and follow-through.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop and continuously refine the Financial Sponsor Key Account framework, tailored to private equity and adaptable across other Financial Sponsor segments, including infrastructure and real estate.Define account segmentation criteria, priority tiers and strategic account classifications to ensure differentiated, insight-led management of sponsor relationships.Establish and maintain strategic account planning methodologies, templates and best-practice playbooks.Develop and run a consistent governance and review cadence across priority accounts, including account planning, pipeline reviews, internal alignment sessions and performance reviews.Build standardised processes for account reviews, governance, escalation, risk management and issue resolution.Align UK and global account management protocols to support a consistent One Firm approach across BDO member firms.Lead the day-to-day operation and governance of the Financial Sponsor coverage programme, ensuring disciplined execution against agreed priorities.Support and constructively challenge Lead Relationship Partners (LRPs) and account teams to drive accountability, alignment and delivery across the sponsor portfolio.Facilitate account reviews and leadership meetings, ensuring coordinated execution across service lines and stakeholder groups.Establish structured review and feedback mechanisms to ensure client and market insights are effectively shared with LRPs and key stakeholders.Maintain high-quality account, opportunity and relationship data within Dynamics and associated systems, ensuring accurate opportunity capture, pipeline progression, activity tracking and next-step planning.Partner closely with the PE Operations team to extract, analyse and interpret financial, portfolio and client data to support account growth strategies.Use data and commercial insights to improve focus, prioritisation and performance across account teams.Provide reporting, analysis and performance improvement recommendations through collaboration with Operations and Commercial Insights teams.Coordinate procurement and commercial activity across priority accounts, ensuring clear ownership, timelines, stakeholder alignment and delivery against requirements. (if appropriate)Support bid and pursuit activity, ensuring opportunities are aligned to account strategy and coordinated effectively across teams.Work closely with Bids, Pursuits, Operations and Commercial Insights teams to ensure coordinated delivery of account strategies and pursuit activity.Coach and develop members of the Financial Sponsor key account team, building capability in strategic account management and Financial Sponsor coverage.

You'll be someone with 

Experience managing a portfolio of accounts in a professional services environment.Experience of working with Financial Sponsors (private equity and/or multi‑asset managers) with an understanding of deal dynamics.Strong facilitation and coordination skills with senior stakeholders/partners.Proven ability to implement consistent account routines and improve pipeline discipline.Strong CRM/pipeline experience (Microsoft Dynamics or similar).Analytical capability: market, deal and portfolio analysis; proficiency with Power BI and AI‑enabled tools.Strong programme & project leadership capability.Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence and challenge senior stakeholders including Lead Relationship Partners

At BDO, we’ll help you achieve your personal goals and career ambitions, and we have programmes, resources, and frameworks that provide clarity and structure around career development.

We’re in it together

Mutual support and respect is one of BDO’s core values and we’re proud of our distinctive, people-centred culture. From informal success conversations to formal mentoring and coaching, we’ll support you at every stage in your career, whatever your personal and professional needs.

Our agile working framework helps us stay connected, bringing teams together where and when it counts so they can share ideas and help one another. At BDO, you’ll always have access to the people and resources you need to do your best work.

We know that collaboration is the key to creating value for the companies we work with and satisfying experiences for our colleagues, so we’ve invested in state-of-the-art collaboration spaces in our offices. BDO’s people represent a wealth of knowledge and expertise, and we’ll encourage you to build your network, work alongside others, and share your skills and experiences. With a range of multidisciplinary events and dedicated resources, you’ll never stop learning at BDO.

We’re looking forward to the future 

At BDO, we help entrepreneurial businesses to succeed, fuelling the UK economy.

Our success is powered by our people, which is why we’re always finding new ways to invest in you. Across the UK thousands of unique minds continue to come together to help companies we work with to achieve their ambitions

We’ve got a clear purpose, and we’re confident in our future, because we’re adapting and evolving to build on our strengths, ensuring we continue to find the right combination of global reach, integrity and expertise. We shape the future together with openness and clarity, because we believe in empowering people to think creatively about how we can do things better.

rows.title: Digital Communications Officer

Digital Communications OfficerTransparency International UK (TI-UK) is looking for a Digital Communications Officer to join our Communications team on a permanent, full-time basis.
This is an opportunity to produce and publish the digital content that carries our anti-corruption research and advocacy to the audiences that matter. You will create content across our website, social media and email channels, produce video and graphics, and deliver the digital side of our campaigns and publication launches.
You will work with colleagues across our UK Programme, Business Integrity, Global Health and Defence & Security teams, turning complex policy work into content that informs and engages.This is a blended working role, combining remote working with attendance at our London office, meetings and events as required. Some UK travel and occasional evening events may be required.The Digital Communications Officer will report to the Senior UK Media and Communications Manager.
What will I be doing?
Digital communicationsMaintain and publish to TI-UK's digital channels, including our website, LinkedIn, X, Instagram and YouTube, delivering the channel plan agreed with the Senior Communications and Media Manager.Help grow our online presence and profile by producing content that engages different audience segments.Draft and publish reactive digital content in response to breaking stories, within agreed sign-off protocols and speed targets.Apply TI-UK's brand and tone of voice guidelines consistently across digital content.Monitor our digital channels for moderation issues, hostile or coordinated online engagement and legally sensitive content, responding in line with agreed guidelines and escalating anything outside them.
Content production and multimediaCreate engaging digital content across our platforms, including website, social media, video, blogs and other multimedia formats.Develop and produce video and audio content, covering planning, filming, editing, subtitling and formatting for different platforms, from short vertical clips to longer explainer pieces.Produce graphics, data visualisations and other visual assets using design tools such as Canva or Adobe Creative Cloud.Produce digital collateral from events organised by colleagues, including video, graphics and written materials.Work with our research and advocacy teams to translate complex policy issues into accessible, engaging content.Draft and edit blogs, social media content and web content, and contribute to press releases and other communications materials.
Campaign and publication launch deliveryDeliver the digital element of our publication launches across the pre-launch, launch day and sustained engagement phases, to the plan agreed for each launch.Contribute to digital campaign plans with programme and communications colleagues, and coordinate the production and scheduling of content against them.Work with colleagues across the organisation on content that showcases our research, advocacy wins and policy impact.Develop email communications to supporters, including newsletters, campaign updates and event invitations.Maintain and build supporter email lists, ensuring effective segmentation and targeting.
Audience growth, analytics and evaluationMonitor and evaluate digital performance through analytics, identifying opportunities for improvement and growth.Track and report the digital measures set out in our communications measurement framework, including engagement rate by platform, click-through and referral traffic, and the best-performing content each month.Log evidence of digital influence, such as amplification of our content by journalists, parliamentarians and peer organisations.Contribute digital evidence and insight to monthly communications snapshots and quarterly programme reviews.
General responsibilitiesContribute to the maintenance of our website, ensuring content is current, accurate and optimised for search.Keep up to date with developments in platforms, formats and digital tools, including AI tools, and share what they mean for our approach.Take part in training and development to build your skills across digital communications.Support other communications activity as required.
Who are we looking for?
You will have:Experience creating and scheduling content for organisational social media channels, engaging professional or policy audiences.Experience producing and editing video for social media and the web, from filming through to publication.Experience managing website content through a content management system, and producing email communications through an email marketing platform.Experience using analytics to evaluate digital performance and improve content.Experience contributing to digital content for campaigns or publication launches.Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to make technical subjects clear and compelling for different audiences.Clear, concise and structured communication, including with senior colleagues.Excellent relationship-management and interpersonal skills, and a collaborative approach to working across teams.An up-to-date understanding of trends and best practice in digital communications, and an interest in anti-corruption.A willingness to develop your skills across digital communications, with training and support.
It would also be useful if you have experience of paid social media advertising, motion graphics, animation or podcast and audio production, or designing and laying out publications such as reports and briefings to brand guidelines using Adobe InDesign or equivalent.Experience working in an advocacy, policy or campaigning organisation would also be an advantage.
Why Transparency International UK?
Transparency International is a global movement sharing one vision: a world in which government politics, business and the daily lives of people are free of corruption. Transparency International UK is the UK national chapter of this movement. We work with the UK and devolved governments, parliamentarians, civil society and the private sector to tackle corruption at home, addressing the UK's global corruption footprint and helping multinational companies prevent corruption by operating with integrity. We are also home to two major global programmes tackling corruption in the Defence and Security and the Global Health sectors on behalf of the wider Transparency International movement.
What can you expect from us?
Details of what it's like to work for us and our benefits can be found here.
How to apply:
We know AI can be very helpful for job applications. Producing well written text is essential for this role, therefore we ask that you limit your use of it to refining text rather than production.We use a recruitment platform called Applied. This promotes fairness, inclusivity and diversity. With anonymised applications and predictive, skill-based assessments, the system aims to address bias and provide a positive and efficient recruitment process. You can find more details on their website beapplied.com.
After you apply, answers go through our sift process: all are anonymised, randomised and then reviewed by a panel of reviewers. Your CV does not form part of the sift process and you should therefore take the time to answer the specific questions fully and, where appropriate, with your relevant evidence.
Closing date to apply: 9 November 2026 (11.59pm)We encourage you to apply as soon as possible if you are interested in this role. Where we have high numbers of applications we can commence screening and progress with recruitment ahead of the advertised closing date.
We aim to ensure our recruitment process takes into consideration and adjusts for any disability or long-term condition. We are happy to discuss flexible working options for all roles.

rows.title: Accelerate Graduate Programme - Enterprise Data & Analytics

Eligibility

To be eligible for this programme, you must have obtained, or be studying towards, a minimum 2:2 degree. If you are currently studying, you must have completed your degree prior to proposed start date. We recognise that mitigating circumstances can have an impact on academic performance. If you have experienced any circumstances that you would like us to take into consideration, please provide details in your application.

About The Job You're Considering

The Enterprise Data Analytics (EDA) pathway of the Accelerate Programme is designed for talented graduates who are passionate about data and AI. In EDA, we help clients unlock value from their data by combining data strategy, analytics, data science and AI innovation. Through our Accelerate Programme, you will develop a strong foundation in consulting while gaining hands on experience across a broad range of data and AI disciplines.

The Accelerate Programme

The Accelerate Programme is Capgemini Invent UK's award winning graduate development programme. Over approximately 19 to 21 months, you'll progress from Associate Consultant to Consultant through a blend of structured learning, coaching, mentoring and hands on client experience. Following an initial three week induction and a twelve week consulting training programme delivered by the Institute, you'll move into your chosen pathway, applying your skills on live client projects while benefiting from ongoing development, regular feedback and a strong graduate community. Travel to client sites may be required, and candidates should live within reasonable commuting distance of their chosen office location.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business. It will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home. Please note that you will be unable to work from home 100 percent of the time.

Your role

As an Associate Consultant, you will develop the skills and experience needed to become a well rounded consultant, helping clients solve complex business challenges and deliver meaningful outcomes. From day one, you will gain hands on experience on client projects, take early responsibility, and contribute to transformation programmes that drive real business value.

Alongside Your Project Work, You Will Benefit From a Structured Learning And Development Programme Through The Enterprise Data Analytics Academy, Designed To Accelerate Both Your Professional And Technical Growth. You Will Have The Opportunity To

Build core consulting skills in areas such as business analysis, stakeholder management, agile delivery, design thinking, storytelling, and communication Support clients in solving complex business, data, analytics, and AI challenges. Develop expertise in modern technologies, including AI, data visualisation, cloud platforms, automation tools, and programming languages such as Python and SQL Apply your skills on live client engagements, delivering innovative solutions and tangible business outcomes. Contribute to large scale transformation programmes, working collaboratively across teams and stakeholders Achieve industry recognised certifications and access continuous learning opportunities tailored to your interests and career goals Collaborate with specialist communities, contribute to thought leadership and knowledge sharing initiatives, and participate in innovation challenges and hackathons. 

At Capgemini, building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment for everyone.

Your Skills And Experience

We are particularly interested to learn if you have experience or are interested in working in the industries we operate in and are keen to start a career in an environment where you can drive change.

Ideally, You Will Have

A strong interest in data, analytics, AI, and technology driven problem solving Experience with, or an interest in, tools and technologies such as Python, R, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Google Analytics, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs) Strong analytical and logical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret business challenges and identify insights from data Excellent communication and teamwork skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non technical audiences The ability to work independently, manage priorities effectively, and adapt in a fast paced environment.  A passion for continuous learning and personal development 

An interest in one or more of the following areas is desirable:

Data analysis and insight generation Data and AI strategy, governance, and architecture Data science, AI, and innovation Data platforms, engineering, and AI deployment Operational analytics and data driven decision making 

At Capgemini Invent, we take a holistic approach to recruitment. While academic achievement is considered, we equally value potential, curiosity and mindset, which will be assessed throughout the recruitment process.

What You'll Love About Working Here

Join a global community of innovators, technologists and consultants who are helping clients transform their businesses through technology. You'll gain hands on experience, continuous learning opportunities and the support to develop your career while contributing to meaningful work that creates lasting impact for clients, communities and society.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini Is Proud To Be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) Under The UK Government's Disability Confident Scheme. As Part Of Our Commitment To Inclusive Recruitment, We Will Offer An Interview To All Candidates Who

Declare they have a disability Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role 

Please opt in during the application process.

Need to Know

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back three continuous years, and an unspent criminal record check (known as a Disclosure and Barring Service check). You will also need to undergo Baseline Personnel Security Standard Checks. There are other criteria and checks required for BPSS and, throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility including, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients' businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.
