rows.descriptionText:
Blue Light Card. Individually great, together unstoppable

The Role and the Team

We're looking for a BI Analyst to join us on a 12-month fixed-term contract, focused on metrics governance and enablement. Reporting to the BI Lead, you'll be part of a small, closely connected team and work with colleagues across every function, including senior stakeholders, to agree what our key measures mean and who owns them. You'll then build the data models and reporting that bring those measures to life and help people use self-serve analytics with confidence.

It's a hands-on role for someone who loves building, and who equally enjoys working with people to turn business questions into clear answers. You'll work mainly in SQL, dbt and Lightdash, alongside Claude and other AI-assisted development, in a fast-paced, supportive, AI-first environment with plenty of room to take ownership.

What You'll Do

Support our metrics governance programme by helping stakeholders agree consistent definitions and clear ownership of key measuresBuild and maintain data models and dashboards end to end, from the first business question to a finished product colleagues can use with confidenceScope, build, test and deliver dbt and SQL work, using AI-assisted development where it helps and checking the output carefullyDocument and test the data behind each key measure, and keep definitions and supporting documentation current so knowledge is shared rather than held by one personDeliver regular business reporting with accuracy and care, and keep our analytics tools reliable and easy to useCoach colleagues who are not data specialists, explaining concepts simply and sharing good practice so teams can act on data without waiting on the Data teamPartner with stakeholders across the business, including senior stakeholders, to understand their priorities and turn them into clear, reliable measures and reportingTurn open-ended business problems and ad hoc questions into clear analysis and recommendations that guide next steps, and keep people informed of progress, risks and any support needed


What You'll Bring

Our Culture

Our mission is simple: make heroes happy. Our members are real-life heroes who keep us all safe, cared for, and thriving. It's what gets us up in the morning, what makes us want to think bigger, and create something that truly matters. By focusing on their happiness, we create amazing experiences, deliver unrivalled discounts, innovative products, and world-class service.

We don't just follow the usual path - we look for smarter, bolder ways to deliver real impact. We take ownership, move fast, and work shoulder to shoulder to build something special.

We promote hybrid working, and value in-person collaboration so encourage time in our offices – either the HQ in Leicestershire, or London, Holborn office. The frequency and office location will vary depending on the role and team. We aim to be flexible, but we aren't able to offer fully remote working.

Blue Light Card is an equal opportunities employer. We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team where different perspectives and experiences help us grow, innovate, and better reflect the communities we serve. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. In the event of a high number of applications, we'll prioritise candidates who meet both the essential and desirable criteria for the role.

rows.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!

As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.

YourParkingSpace joined forces with Arrive on our joint mission to make cities more livable, together. YourParkingSpace is one of the UK’s fastest-growing parking technology providers, changing the way people park. Our on-demand marketplace connects drivers to thousands of spaces, while our comprehensive suite of B2B solutions transforms parking assets into connected mobility hubs.

The role

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we use data to drive growth and business impact. You’ll translate complex datasets into strategic insights and actionable recommendations that move the business forward. This is a hands-on role where you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams across Commercial, Product and Operations to ensure stakeholders have the right data, insights and metrics to make confident decisions. You’ll own analytics projects end-to-end, from understanding the initial business problem through to extracting and analysing data, developing visualisations and communicating meaningful recommendations.

How To Make An Impact

Lead end-to-end analytics projects, from scoping stakeholder requirements to data extraction, analysis in SQL, visualisation and presentation of actionable insights. Partner closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Product and Operations to identify strategic opportunities for growth and improvement. Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical frameworks that enable teams to make informed, data-driven decisions. Help define and maintain consistent business metrics and KPIs. Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes. Challenge assumptions and requirements to ensure we're solving the right business problems. Continuously monitor and improve data quality, ensuring stakeholders can trust the insights they use. Proactively explore data to uncover emerging trends, risks and opportunities. 

Your background

A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience. 2+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics or a similar analytics role. Advanced SQL skills, with the ability to independently extract, manipulate and analyse complex datasets. Experience using Tableau or another mainstream BI/data visualisation tool, such as Power BI, Looker, Metabase or Sisense. Strong commercial awareness and an ability to connect analysis with meaningful business outcomes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. A proactive approach, with the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions and take ownership. Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning complex business requirements into meaningful insights. 

The role is based in London, UK, with a hybrid working model requiring three days per week in the office.

About Arrive

Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

Join us at Entrust 

At Entrust, we’re shaping the future of identity centric security solutions. From our comprehensive portfolio of solutions to our flexible, global workplace, we empower careers, foster collaboration, and build solutions that help keep the world moving safely. 

  

Get to Know Us

Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Ownership & Continuous Improvement

At Entrust, you'll have the opportunity to work with industry-leading technologies that help secure identities, payments, and data around the world. You'll be part of a collaborative team where your insights directly influence customer success and product performance.

We believe in empowering our employees through continuous learning, career growth, and meaningful work that makes a global impact.

Whether you’re remote, hybrid, or on-site, we offer flexible options that fit your lifestyle.  Collaboration: Here, your voice matters. Our teams thrive on sharing ideas, brainstorming solutions, and working together to build a better tomorrow.

Ready to Make an Impact? 

If you’re excited by the prospect of innovating, growing your career, and collaborating in a dynamic environment, Entrust is the place for you. Join us in making a difference. Let’s build a more secure world—together. 

  

Apply today!

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

To help fuel that growth, we’re looking for Data Scientists to join our Pricing & Underwriting Department, the strategic engine behind Prima's growth.

As part of this global team, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping our strategy and strengthening our competitive edge. Using data, analytical thinking, machine learning and business acumen, you’ll help predict the future and set the right prices, keeping our offering both attractive and sustainable. You’ll work with your data science tools and skills to bring real-world impact, collaborating with cross-functional teams to turn insights into action and fuel innovation across the company and its different branches.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details.

What You’ll Do

Leverage data to identify risks, opportunities and key pricing drivers, turning complex information into actionable insights that influence strategic decision making; Leverage Machine Learning and advanced analytics to develop risk and pricing models that power real-time insurance pricing for millions of customers; Contribute directly to the company’s growth and long-term success through innovative modelling, experimentation and commercially impactful insights. 

What We’re Looking For

Strong academic background in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering (Maths, Physics and Computer Science specialisations), Data Science, Computer Science or Statistics; Strong quantitative, logical and analytical abilities, a solid foundation in statistics, probability and advanced analytics, and a curious, proactive and innovative mindset focused on solving complex problems; Fluency in English, both spoken and written. 

Nice-to-Have

Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, and drive new ideas; Possess a solid foundation in code development and machine learning, ideally in Python; Know how to create, manipulate and analyse large datasets. 

£80,000 - £160,000 a year

Please note: this is the same position as the one referred as “Data Scientist” on our career site, posted with different job titles to reach STEM students and graduates who might not know a Data Scientist role suits them.

Why you'll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.

💵 Competitive compensation: Benefit from competitive salaries, starting from £80k up to £160k, with clear opportunities to grow as you do.

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

rows.title: Social Insights Analyst, Studios

Combining social listening, audience analysis and cultural intelligence, you will uncover meaningful insights that inform marketing strategy, campaign optimisation, commercial decision-making and long-term planning.

Working across a wide range of Studios releases and the broader entertainment landscape, you'll transform complex social and cultural signals into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders across the business. You'll partner with colleagues across Studios Intelligence, Global Studios teams, external partners and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure audience perspectives remain at the heart of decision-making.

If selected for one of these roles, you will report to the Manager, Social Listening & Research.

These roles will be based in our London Hammersmith office, 4 days a week, with either a Monday or Friday working from home.

You'll join a team grounded in our Disney values: acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration, and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day.

We are committed to welcoming and respecting a broad range of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

rows.title: Quantitative Research Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Aspect Capital is an award-winning systematic hedge fund based in London. We manage over $9 billion of client assets. Research sits at the core of our investment process, playing a critical role in the success of our business.

rows.title: Marketing Data Analyst (Bangkok Based, Relocation provided)

rows.title: Junior Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
On average it takes 5 minutes to apply for this role.

Kick-start your career in the online gaming world and experience the very latest in technology and innovation.

Do you see yourself as one of those “out-of-the-box thinkers”, “Technical masterminds”, “Outstanding creatives”, or “Mind-boggling number crunchers”? If so, we want to welcome you to the Betway family and celebrate what makes you unique!

Our global customer base is exploding and we need your skills to support us on this exciting journey! Don’t look back and submit your application before the opportunity passes you by..

Data Exploration

The Junior Data Scientist is responsible for assisting and participating in exploration of untapped data values in our business ecosystem, regardless of data formats, as well as mining external data, with the aim of utilizing them for the purpose of predictive and prescriptive modelling solutions.

Data Validation

This role is responsible for ensuring that the data being used is accurate, reliable, and suitable for the model being built. This includes tasks such as data cleaning, data verification, data transformation and validation methods using both statistical and machine learning methods.

Model Usage

This role assists with marrying business understanding and knowledge with existing, appropriate, predictive and prescriptive model offerings (machine learning and AI) for commercial and/or operational benefits, given a known business challenge.

Model Deployment

The Junior Data Scientist assists in the integration and implementation of relevant models into the applicable business processes through collaboration with relevant technology and/or operations team(s).

Model Evaluation and Monitoring

They assist in model validation, evaluation and monitoring in production.

Team Development & Stakeholder Engagement

The Junior Data Scientist contributes to technical standards, tooling, and best practices across the team. They communicate modelling approaches, trade-offs, and results clearly to non-technical stakeholders, helping with how data science work is understood and adopted across the business.

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities. You may be required to complete other reasonable duties in order to achieve business objectives.

Should you not hear from us within 2 weeks, please assume your application has not been successful.

rows.title: LSE Fellow in Interdisciplinary Social Science

company.name: The London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE)

rows.descriptionText:
LSE is committed to building a diverse, equitable and truly inclusive university

 LSE100: The LSE Course 

 LSE Fellow in Interdisciplinary Social Science 

 Salary is competitive and no less than £44,143 pa inclusive of London allowance 

 This is a full-time, fixed term appointment for two years with potential to extend for a further eight months 

 This post will commence on   4 January 2027 

LSE100, LSE’s flagship interdisciplinary course taken by all first-year undergraduates, is recruiting a creative educator committed to innovative interdisciplinary teaching to join our team. LSE100 is an internationally-recognised, sector-leading course which introduces LSE students to the School’s mission, builds their capacity to tackle complex problems, and explores transformative global challenges.

The successful candidate will teach a minimum of eight fortnightly seminar groups (approximately six classroom hours per week) and contribute to the design and development of course materials, while developing their own research agenda. They will join an enthusiastic community of interdisciplinary educators and will have opportunities to collaborate with colleagues both within LSE100 and across LSE. The successful candidate will also perform administrative duties while fostering a supportive and engaging learning environment for LSE100 students.

LSE100 offers three themes for students to choose from as their focus of study. In 2026/27, these are: How can we control AI ?, How can we transform our climate futures?, and How can we create a fair society? The ability to demonstrate research-informed interest and expertise in teaching across multiple themes is an asset. For this post, we are looking for individuals who have an interest in teaching on our How can we create a fair society? theme, and whose research interests connect to the topics of social division, cohesion and/or polarisation.

Candidates should have completed or be close to completing a PhD in a social science or related discipline. Relevant teaching and assessment experience particularly in an interdisciplinary context, the ability to work closely with and learn from colleagues, and excellent communication and organisational skills, are also essential. The other criteria used in shortlisting for this post can be found in the person specification on LSE’s recruitment system.

Please note that at least one of the referees for this application should be someone who has overseen or managed the candidate’s teaching.

We offer an occupational pension scheme, generous annual leave, and excellent training and development opportunities.

For further information about the post, please see the how to apply document , job description and the person specification.

 To apply for this post, please go to   www.jobs.lse.ac.uk   .  If you have any technical queries with applying on the online system, please use the “contact us” links at the bottom of the LSE Jobs page. Should you have any queries about the role, please email LSE100@lse.ac.uk .

 The closing date for receipt of applications is 8 November 2026 (23.59 UK time). Regrettably, we are unable to accept any late applications. Interviews are expected to take place on the LSE campus on 19 and 20 November 2026. 

An LSE Fellowship is intended to be an entry route to an academic career and is deemed by the School to be a career development position. As such, applicants who have already been employed as an LSE Fellow for three years in total are not eligible to apply. If you have any queries about this please contact the HR Division.

rows.title: Principal Data Scientist, Experimentation
rows.descriptionText:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

At Tripadvisor experiences, the only thing we love more than travel is data. We slice it, we dice it, and we use it to empower our decision making.

What You Will Do

As a Principal Data Scientist you will be a leading individual contributor responsible for how experimentation works across the organisation.

You will lead through technical depth, setting the standards others work to and raising the quality of measurement and decision-making across the function.

You will build the capability that lets teams experiment well without central support: the standards, tooling and protocols that make good practice the default, and a strategy for how it develops over time.

Both the speed and the reliability of decision-making should improve as a result. You will also take on the measurement questions we cannot currently answer well, where traffic is thin or the outcomes that matter take months to appear.

You Will

Set the technical standard for experimentation across Product Data Science, from conventional A/B testing to quasi-experimental and Bayesian methods, and make it practical through protocols, frameworks and tooling.Partner with Product, Engineering and Data Platform teams to improve experimentation velocity without sacrificing rigour.Critically assess how experimentation and the decisions that follow it affect platform health and growth, and make that relationship visible to leadership.Own the measurement approach for Viator's most complex questions, where standard experimentation is insufficient and the method has to be designed rather than selected.Develop and validate the statistical methods the organisation relies on, including simulation-based verification that they behave correctly before teams depend on them.Act as the final technical authority on measurement validity, adjudicating disputed results and determining what the evidence does and does not support.Standardise recurring analytical and experimentation processes across the function, using automation and AI capabilities where they materially improve consistency, throughput or quality.Design and land methodological improvements with organisation-wide impact, such as variance reduction for difficult metrics, approaches for low-traffic surfaces, proxy and surrogate metrics for long-horizon outcomes, and designs that hold up where users compete for shared supply.Grow the technical depth of the wider team by reviewing designs, mentoring senior data scientists, and improving how people reason about measurement.Advise on where experimentation is the wrong tool and define what should be done instead.

Skills & Experience

Experience: Extensive experience in data science or a similar quantitative role, with a proven track record of supporting and influencing a product organisation.Statistical & Experimentation Expertise: Authoritative command of experimentation in all its forms, from experimental design and variance reduction to causal inference, bandits and Bayesian methods. You should be able to develop and validate methodology, not only apply it.Technical & Modelling Expertise: Expert level proficiency in Python and SQL. Deep, hands-on experience with statistical modelling, (quasi) experimentation, multi-arm bandits, and a wide range of machine learning techniques such as regression, classification and clustering.Product Acumen: Demonstrated ability to define, implement and operationalise crucial product and feature-level metrics from scratch.Partnership & Enablement: Demonstrated ability to improve how other teams work by providing guidance, tooling and protocols, increasing both the speed and the quality of their experimentation rather than absorbing the work yourself.Decision Impact & Platform Health: Ability to critically assess how product decisions affect platform health and growth over time, and to bring that perspective into how experiments are designed and interpreted.Standardising at Scale: Experience standardising processes, frameworks or methods across multiple teams, including the use of AI and automation to make good practice the default.Cross-Functional Partnership: Proven ability to build strong relationships and drive outcomes across Product, Engineering, Data Platform and other central functions, often without direct authority.Critical Thinking: Leader in critical thinking, with a demonstrated habit of establishing whether a result is trustworthy before establishing what it means.Communication: Exceptional ability to explain measurement, method and uncertainty clearly to technical and non-technical audiences at every level.Education: Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

You could be an especially great fit if you have:

Experience with experimentation in a two-sided marketplace, where interference between users and finite shared supply complicate measurement.Experience building and validating proxy or surrogate metrics for long-horizon outcomes, and a clear view of how far they can be trusted.Experience with Bayesian and hierarchical approaches, particularly for low-traffic surfaces or pooling evidence across many small markets.Experience building or materially improving experimentation platforms, measurement frameworks, self-service capabilities or data products.Experience in a high-scale technology company, marketplace, e-commerce business or travel technology organisation, and familiarity with the seasonality and long purchase cycles that come with them.Breadth in statistical modelling and machine learning, such as regression, classification, clustering and bandits, alongside your experimentation depth.Experience applying AI, Large Language Models, agentic AI or automation to improve analytical productivity and decision-making effectiveness.A reputation for raising the standard of thinking and decision-making in every team you join.Experience with SaaS experimentation tools such as Statsig, Eppo or GrowthBook, or with an in-house platform.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

rows.descriptionText:
Intelligence Researcher (Arabic / Farsi Linguist)Location: Central London (Hybrid)Salary: Competitive, dependent on experienceWorking Pattern: Monday to Friday, hybrid working with three days per week in our London office
About UsPraetorian Connections Ltd (PCL) is a leading provider of language-enabled open source intelligence (OSINT) supporting geopolitical, security, and risk-focused decision making.Our Intelligence Teams deliver timely, accurate, and insightful reporting across complex global portfolios, combining linguistic expertise, regional understanding, structured research methods, and rigorous analytical tradecraft.
We are looking for talented Intelligence Researchers with fluency in Arabic or Farsi to join our growing Intelligence Team. French language skills would be considered an advantage. If you are analytical, detail-oriented, passionate about global affairs, and enjoy working in a collaborative, fast paced environment, we would like to hear from you. At PCL, you will join a mission driven team where your language skills and analytical judgement directly contribute to high-impact intelligence products used to understand complex global developments.
The RoleAs an Intelligence Researcher, you will play a key role in identifying, translating, analysing, and reporting on open source information in support of our clients’ intelligence requirements.Working under the guidance of an Intelligence Manager and Regional Collection Manager, you will conduct structured research, assess information from a range of sources, and produce clear, concise written reporting that meets PCL’s editorial and analytical standards.
This is an opportunity to develop your skills as an intelligence professional while contributing to meaningful work covering geopolitical, security, and socio-economic developments.
Key ResponsibilitiesOpen-Source Research & Collection-Conduct structured open-source research in Arabic or Farsi in response to defined intelligence requirements.-Identify, assess, and collect information from credible sources, prioritising primary and near-primary material.-Translate and summarise non-English language material accurately and effectively.-Monitor relevant political, security, economic, and social developments.Reporting & Analysis-Produce clear, concise written reports in English aligned with internal editorial standards.-Communicate the relevance, context, and implications of collected information.-Support the delivery of regular intelligence reporting and bespoke research tasks.-Contribute to the development of analytical products, including timelines, maps, and other visual outputs where required.Data & Information Management-Maintain accurate records of sources, references, and research findings.-Support internal databases and information management processes.-Apply robust source validation principles and highlight any quality concerns.Team Contribution-Participate actively in team meetings, briefings, and knowledge sharing sessions.-Support wider team priorities and ad hoc research requirements.-Maintain professional standards and follow internal policies relating to responsible data use and online conduct.
About YouYou are a curious, reliable, and detail oriented researcher with strong language skills and an interest in understanding complex information environments.You enjoy investigating information, identifying patterns, and communicating insights clearly to support decision making.
Essential Skills & AttributesFluency in Arabic or Farsi (written and spoken).Strong written English, with the ability to produce clear and structured reporting.Strong translation and summarisation skills.Experience conducting research using open sources, academic resources, media, databases, or similar information environments.Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to reviewing information.Ability to assess source credibility and identify reliable information.Strong organisational skills and ability to manage deadlines.Interest in geopolitical, security, regional, or socio-economic issues.Collaborative and professional approach with a willingness to learn and receive feedback.
Desirable Skills & ExperienceFrench language capability.Previous experience in intelligence, OSINT, risk analysis, investigative research, journalism, or regional analysis.Experience using structured research methodologies or information management systems.Familiarity with source evaluation and analytical techniques.This is an excellent opportunity for both early career researchers and those looking to develop further within the intelligence sector.
Why Join PCL?At PCL, you will become part of a collaborative and growing intelligence organisation where your research and language skills directly contribute to high impact analysis. We are committed to continuous learning and professional development, building expertise through collaboration and shared knowledge, providing opportunities for progression within a growing organisation, and supporting our people through a positive and inclusive working environment.
Additional InformationCandidates must have the right to work in the UK at the time of application. We are unable to sponsor visa applications for this role.Hybrid working arrangement with three days per week required in our Central London office.Staff may work remotely for 3-4 weeks during designated PCL remote working periods in the summer and Christmas periods. Working from abroad is not permitted.Access to internal training opportunities to support professional development.Clear career pathways are available, subject to business needs and role availability.Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a written exercise as part of the recruitment process.

At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. What we look forReasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. What we offerIncredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland).

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply

rows.title: Research Fellow (Econometrics and Validation)

company.name: The London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE)

rows.descriptionText:
LSE is committed to building a diverse, equitable and truly inclusive university

 The Inclusion Initiative (TII) 

 Department of Psychological and Behavioural Science 

 Research Fellow (Econometrics and Validation) 

 Salary from £53,949 to £62,160 pa inclusive with potential to progress to £69,073 pa inclusive of London allowance 

 Funding is available to support this position for 1 year, starting Autumn 2026 

The Inclusion Initiative (TII) at LSE uses behavioural science and rigorous quantitative research to help organisations build more inclusive workplaces. Its Growth and Governance (G&G) Hub is dedicated to measuring and driving progress on race inclusion in large listed companies.

The Hub has assembled every annual report published by FTSE 350 companies over a seven-year period and built the first large, expert-calibrated measure of how those companies write about diversity. Around 20 diversity and inclusion specialists hand-labelled more than 25,000 passages to create a ground truth; a large language model was then tested against that ground truth and tuned until it matched the experts as closely as the experts matched one another. That model now scores the full corpus, producing a comparable, independently produced measure for every report. The first company reports to be published concern race and ethnicity.

Further information about The Inclusion Initiative is available at www.lse.ac.uk/tii .

Applications are invited for a Research Fellow to lead the quantitative validation of the Hub's measures and to write that work up for publication. You will report to Dr Grace Lordan, Director of TII.

You will assemble and link firm-level data from external sources, including financial performance, workforce composition and diversity, and governance characteristics, and establish the relationship between the Hub's measures and those variables using panel methods appropriate to a multi-year corpus. You will test the construct validity, robustness and stability of the measure and its components, propose improvements, and contribute to peer reviewed papers and published methodology that open the measure to external scrutiny.

Candidates Should Have

 a PhD in economics, econometrics, quantitative social science or a closely related subject, or expect to have submitted their PhD thesis by the post start date; a solid background in applied econometrics, in particular panel data methods; A track record or trajectory of peer-reviewed publications; demonstrable expertise in research on diversity and inclusion, including a strong grounding in race and ethnicity in workplace, labour market or organisational settings; experience of constructing and linking large firm-level datasets from multiple sources, including firm-level, financial or administrative data, and advanced programming skills in Stata, R and/or Python.

We offer an occupational pension scheme, generous annual leave, hybrid working, and excellent training and development opportunities. The successful candidate is expected to be in the office in London a minimum of two days per week as chosen by the Director.

For further information about the post, please see the how to apply document , job description and the person specification .

 To apply for this post, please go to   www.jobs.lse.ac.uk   .  If you have any technical queries with applying on the online system, please use the “contact us” links at the bottom of the LSE Jobs page. Should you have any queries about the role, please email TII@lse.ac.uk

 The closing date for receipt of applications is 18 October 2026 (23:59 UK time). Regrettably, we are unable to accept any late applications.

You will find workers for our platform (FreeFlexers) wherever we need them most, whether that’s a new location or a new type of job for our clients. Temper makes its money from both sides of the business; clients and the workers, you will own the FreeFlexer side of the business and directly impact Temper’s revenue from day one. This internship is designed as a stepping stone to a permanent role for exceptional performers.

Note: you must be available to work from early November onwards to apply.

🧩 The challenge 
Work with our account managers and sales team to find out which shifts our clients need filled in each new location. We operate in hospitality, logistics and retail, so you’ll be finding a wide range of FreeFlexers: bartenders, waiters, event crew, chefs, drivers, retail assistants and more.Follow our proven playbook to find and onboard FreeFlexers in new locations across the UK.Be the first friendly voice our applicants hear from Temper. Reach out by phone, email and other channels, help them set up their Temper profile and get them excited for their first shift.When the usual approach doesn’t work, quickly put together a plan to reach FreeFlexers using a mix of online and offline channels. Test new ideas, whether that’s local partnerships with schools and colleges, community events or something we haven’t tried yet, and see what works.Run our ambassador programme and motivate existing FreeFlexers to refer their friends.Find creative ways to keep new FreeFlexers engaged and coming back for shifts, through events, perks, CRM tools and other channels.

🤝 Your Temper team

You’ll join our UK Marketplace Success team and help drive Temper’s growth in new UK locations. You’ll also work with our Marketplace Success team in the Netherlands to exchange ideas and learn from what’s worked there. Day to day, you’ll work closely with the wider UK team, including account managers and sales reps, to make sure we’re finding the right FreeFlexers for our clients. You’ll be in touch with almost everyone in the business, which makes this a great role for seeing how Temper works from every angle.The role is hybrid, with a minimum two days in the office each week; the rest of the time, you can work wherever you like. We work hard and win hard. You’ll have the freedom to test your own ideas and take ownership of your work, backed by a team that celebrates success and moves quickly together.

👩 💻 How we work
At Temper, we embrace a dynamic hybrid work model that blends the best of both worlds: the energy of our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and London, and the flexibility to work from home. We believe in empowering our team to thrive in a way that suits them best. Need a change of scenery? You'll find the support and flexibility to make the most of your talents at Temper.
💪 What makes you a great fit:
You’re confident and comfortable on the phone, and happy to make plenty of calls in a day.You’re organised and persistent, and can follow a process and work through a list without losing momentum.You love solving problems and enjoy coming up with fresh ideas when the standard approach isn’t working.You’re data-driven. You use data and AI tools to spot issues, solve them and present innovative solutions, and you’ll have access to Claude to help you do it.You have a strong drive to succeed and can show where you’ve gone the extra mile, whether in work, sport, education or elsewhere.You’re happy to roll up your sleeves and do whatever needs doing, even beyond your core responsibilities.You’re available to start in early November, 4-5 days a week, and are based in London or able to travel regularly.
⭐ Nice to have...Experience in a phone-based role, such as sales, recruitment or customer service.Experience in promotions or marketing.Are comfortable using Looker and ClaudeExperience or knowledge of software such as Asana and Salesforce
🎁 What we offer:
Work closely with experienced professionals in a supportive and collaborative team environment.Hands-on exposure to a fast-growing scale-up at our centrally located London office.Flexible working hours to fit around your academic commitments.Paid lunch and travel expenses when visiting the office.Laptop and the gear you need.Compensation of £2000 per month.
🚀 We are Temper
Are you passionate about helping people adjust work to fit their lives, not the other way around? At Temper, our mission is to revolutionize the labor market with technology, making it fairer, more accessible, and efficient. We empower the new generation of workers who crave flexibility and control over when and where they work— by providing them with a solution right at their fingertips!
What makes our platform successful is that it is built around our users’ needs - We do it for them! We take pride in our user-centric approach, constantly evolving to meet their demands and exceed expectations. Our goal is to give businesses a tool that lets them easily connect with great people looking for flexible shift work.
At Temper, every team member has the opportunity to make a significant impact. Our core value, "We Own It," drives our culture (quite literally, as you will see in our equity plan). We believe in empowering you to take ownership and responsibility, so that together, we can take Temper to the next level.
Our unique culture is proudly embodied by our colleagues at Temper. With over 20 nationalities represented, we embrace remote work across more than 10 countries, alongside our bustling offices in Amsterdam and London. Twice a year, we come together to connect, share knowledge, and foster our vibrant community.
Join us on this exciting journey as we redefine the future of work! Your passion and dedication will shape the way millions approach their careers worldwide.—----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Apply now! rows.descriptionText:
About Lendable
Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 peopleAmong the fastest-growing tech companies in the UKProfitable since 2017Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman SachsLoved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to
Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutionsBuild the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About The Role
We’re building the most advanced, data-driven operating model in fintech. As part of Lendable’s Operations Science & Strategy team, you’ll sit at the intersection of analytics, data science, and AI engineering - using data, LLMs, and automation to transform how our Operations teams work at scale.

You’ll work directly with senior operations leadership working on special projects to diagnose demand drivers, uncover commercial opportunities, build KPI frameworks, and deploy automation that materially reduces our cost-to-serve while improving customer outcomes.

If you’re technical, curious, and love owning problems end-to-end, this is the role for you.

What You’ll DoWhat We’re Looking For
 Automation & AI EngineeringUse Python and LLM APIs (e.g. OpenAI) to design and deploy automation that replaces manual CS/FS processes.Build prototypes, test with real operations data, and scale the successful ones into production workflows.Partner with PMs and engineers to operationalise AI-driven solutions across Operations. Demand Analytics & StrategyAnalyse key operations demand drivers (contact per customer, reason drivers, seasonality, servicing behaviour).Identify levers to reduce avoidable demand and improve customer outcomes.Build analytical models that drive decision-making around cost optimisation and resourcing. KPI & Funnel IntelligenceBuild clear, robust KPI frameworks and funnel views across customer journeys.Translate data into commercial insight, operational efficiency recommendations, and productivity tracking.Create metrics that scale across new geographies, products, and teams. Work With Senior LeadershipWork directly with Ops Directors, Heads of CS/FS/Fraud/Complaints, and the COO on strategic initiatives.Turn raw data into narrative-driven recommendations that are simple, actionable, and commercially grounded.Own analytics for high-impact projects end-to-end.

Must-Have Skills
2-3 years of hands-on experience using Python in a professional setting.Highly numerate with strong analytical reasoning Ability to independently structure analysis, build prototypes, and deliver insights.Experience communicating data-driven recommendations to non-technical business stakeholders.

Nice-to-Haves
STEM DegreeExperience with dbt or modern data stacks.Familiarity with LLMs, APIs, or interest in building AI automation.Exposure to product, strategy, or operations environments.Thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.Comfortable wearing multiple hats Analyst, Data Scientist, AI Engineer, PM.Highly motivated, entrepreneurial mindset, and excited by building the strongest operating model in fintech.

Why Join
Work on high-visibility, high-impact projects that directly shape the future of Lendable’s operations.Build automation and analytics used daily by hundreds of agents and thousands of customers.Collaborate with a small, sharp, and ambitious team that moves fast.Real ownership: if you build it, you’ll see it shipped and scaled.

Interview process

Screening Call + Python Questions

Live Technical Python Interview

Final interviews with 2 senior leaders

Life at Lendable
Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companiesFlexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sitesSocials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office wallsHealth coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health coverRetirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plansEmployee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team membersOffice meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locationsSustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

rows.descriptionText:
Join us at Entrust 

At Entrust, we’re shaping the future of identity centric security solutions. From our comprehensive portfolio of solutions to our flexible, global workplace, we empower careers, foster collaboration, and build solutions that help keep the world moving safely. 

  

Get to Know Us 

Headquartered in Minnesota, Entrust is an industry leader in identity-centric security solutions, serving over 150 countries with cutting-edge, scalable technologies. But our secret weapon? Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future. 

Help Shape Exceptional Customer Experiences Through Data

At Entrust, we're committed to enabling trusted identities, secure payments, and data protection for organizations worldwide. As a Customer Performance Analyst, you'll play a key role in ensuring our products consistently deliver exceptional performance for our customers.

This is an exciting opportunity for a naturally curious and analytical professional who enjoys solving complex problems, uncovering insights from data, and partnering with cross-functional teams to drive meaningful outcomes. You'll become a trusted advisor on product performance, helping identify trends, resolve customer-impacting issues, and improve the overall customer experience.

What You'll Do

As a Customer Performance Analyst, you'll combine data analytics, customer engagement, and cross-functional collaboration to proactively improve product performance and customer satisfaction.

Customer Support & Performance Insights

Develop a deep understanding of Entrust products and performance metrics.Analyze customer performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks.Provide evidence-based recommendations to help customers achieve their objectives.Build strong relationships with customers through clear, timely, and empathetic communication.

Data Analysis & Problem Solving

Investigate large and complex datasets to uncover actionable insights.Translate ambiguous problems into structured analyses and meaningful recommendations.Challenge assumptions and proactively identify root causes of unexpected results.Drive investigations through to resolution, ensuring stakeholders are informed throughout.

Product Performance Monitoring

Monitor key product performance indicators and identify emerging issues.Escalate concerns and coordinate with engineering, product, and support teams when required.Help establish best practices for proactive performance management and reporting.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with Support Engineers, Software Engineers, Product Managers, Customer Success Managers, and other stakeholders.Communicate technical findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.Act as the central point of coordination for customer-impacting performance issues.

Ownership & Continuous Improvement

Take ownership of investigations from initial problem definition through to resolution.Demonstrate sound judgment regarding when to escalate issues and when to independently drive solutions.Continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, reporting, and customer outcomes.

Required Qualifications

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to derive insights from large datasets.Experience using Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, or similar tools for data analysis and reporting.Excellent written and verbal communication skills.Ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.Comfortable working in both structured and ambiguous environments.Self-motivated with a proactive, "can-do" attitude and a growth mindset.Collaborative team player who thrives in cross-functional environments.Fast learner with a passion for continuous development.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline or another field with a strong analytical focus.Experience with Looker or similar business intelligence and analytics platforms.Working knowledge of SQL.Previous experience in a data analytics, business analytics, or performance analysis role.Exposure to technology organizations, particularly working alongside Engineering, Machine Learning, or Product teams.

Why Join Entrust?

At Entrust, you'll have the opportunity to work with industry-leading technologies that help secure identities, payments, and data around the world. You'll be part of a collaborative team where your insights directly influence customer success and product performance.

We believe in empowering our employees through continuous learning, career growth, and meaningful work that makes a global impact.

At Entrust, we don’t just offer jobs – we offer career journeys. Here is what you can expect when you join our team: 

Career Growth: Whether you’re a budding developer or a seasoned expert, we’re invested in your professional journey. With learning-forward initiatives and exciting challenges, your growth is our priority.  Flexibility: Life is all about balance. Whether you’re remote, hybrid, or on-site, we offer flexible options that fit your lifestyle.  Collaboration: Here, your voice matters. Our teams thrive on sharing ideas, brainstorming solutions, and working together to build a better tomorrow.  

We believe in securing identities—but it doesn’t stop there. At Entrust, we’re passionate about valuing all identities. Our culture is built on diversity, inclusion, and respect. From unconscious bias training for our leaders to global affinity groups that connect colleagues across the globe, we’re creating a community where everyone is encouraged to be themselves. 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

If you’re excited by the prospect of innovating, growing your career, and collaborating in a dynamic environment, Entrust is the place for you. Join us in making a difference. Let’s build a more secure world—together. 

  

Apply today! 

For more information, visit www.entrust.com.  Follow us on, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube

rows.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!

As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.

YourParkingSpace joined forces with Arrive on our joint mission to make cities more livable, together. YourParkingSpace is one of the UK’s fastest-growing parking technology providers, changing the way people park. Our on-demand marketplace connects drivers to thousands of spaces, while our comprehensive suite of B2B solutions transforms parking assets into connected mobility hubs.

The role

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you’ll play a key role in shaping how we use data to drive growth and business impact. You’ll translate complex datasets into strategic insights and actionable recommendations that move the business forward. This is a hands-on role where you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams across Commercial, Product and Operations to ensure stakeholders have the right data, insights and metrics to make confident decisions. You’ll own analytics projects end-to-end, from understanding the initial business problem through to extracting and analysing data, developing visualisations and communicating meaningful recommendations.

How To Make An Impact

Lead end-to-end analytics projects, from scoping stakeholder requirements to data extraction, analysis in SQL, visualisation and presentation of actionable insights. Partner closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Product and Operations to identify strategic opportunities for growth and improvement. Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical frameworks that enable teams to make informed, data-driven decisions. Help define and maintain consistent business metrics and KPIs. Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes. Challenge assumptions and requirements to ensure we're solving the right business problems. Continuously monitor and improve data quality, ensuring stakeholders can trust the insights they use. Proactively explore data to uncover emerging trends, risks and opportunities. 

Your background

A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience. 2+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics or a similar analytics role. Advanced SQL skills, with the ability to independently extract, manipulate and analyse complex datasets. Experience using Tableau or another mainstream BI/data visualisation tool, such as Power BI, Looker, Metabase or Sisense. Strong commercial awareness and an ability to connect analysis with meaningful business outcomes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. A proactive approach, with the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions and take ownership. Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning complex business requirements into meaningful insights. 

The role is based in London, UK, with a hybrid working model requiring three days per week in the office.

About Arrive

Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

About the Role & Team

At The Walt Disney Company, our stories connect with audiences around the world. Behind every successful release is a deep understanding of audience behaviour, cultural trends and evolving conversations. The Studios Intelligence team provides the audience, market and commercial insight that helps shape strategic decision-making across Disney's Studios business throughout EMEA.

We are currently looking for two Social Insights Analysts to join the Studios Intelligence team. In these roles, you will play a key part in helping Disney understand how audiences engage with our films, franchises and campaigns online. Combining social listening, audience analysis and cultural intelligence, you will uncover meaningful insights that inform marketing strategy, campaign optimisation, commercial decision-making and long-term planning.

Working across a wide range of Studios releases and the broader entertainment landscape, you'll transform complex social and cultural signals into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders across the business. You'll partner with colleagues across Studios Intelligence, Global Studios teams, external partners and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure audience perspectives remain at the heart of decision-making.

If selected for one of these roles, you will report to the Manager, Social Listening & Research.

These roles will be based in our London Hammersmith office, 4 days a week, with either a Monday or Friday working from home.

You'll join a team grounded in our Disney values: acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration, and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day.

What You Will Do

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation throughout the application and interview process, in performing essential job functions and in accessing employment benefits and opportunities. Please contact us if you require accommodation.

rows.title: Data Analysis & Insights Project Intern (TikTok Shop) - 2026 Start - 2027 Start
rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities

The TikTok commerce team builds the solutions that help businesses engage audiences, inspire product discovery, and create commercial experiences on a platform where brands and merchants connect meaningfully with creators and communities.

We work closely with merchants, creators, and partners to support sustainable business growth while keeping the experience safe and trusted for the community. As the business scales across global markets, we take on complex challenges across content, commerce, trust, and the differing needs of each local market.

You will help shape the future of AI-native commerce, where discovery, entertainment, and buying happen in the same place.

About The Team

The e-Commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-Commerce experience to our users.

As a Project Intern, you will contribute to impactful short-term projects and gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, professional environment. This internship offers the opportunity to develop practical skills, apply your knowledge to real-world challenges, and explore your career interests.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

Responsibilities

 Support project-based goal tracking by monitoring key metrics across merchant and product performance, including sample supply, content output, and sales contribution. Analyze data to identify high-potential merchants and products, helping define the incubation profile and pathway for affiliate-focused sellers. Track and report on sample supply and content creation trends, identifying gaps and opportunities to optimize resource allocation. Assist in preparing weekly reports and analytical materials to summarize business performance and highlight key trends. Contribute to case study development by analyzing merchant and product performance, providing data-backed insights to support Account Managers in merchant outreach and pitch preparation. Help synthesize best practices and develop actionable pathways for merchants to optimize their affiliate investments. Support the consolidation of hit product cases by gathering data and insights from cross-functional teams, including policy resources, merchant BD inputs, and match-making incubation cases. Assist in quantifying the value of hit products by analyzing metrics such as sustained GMV growth contribution, merchant tier upgrades, and overall store GMV impact. Help document and communicate the methodology behind hit product incubation—for example, the correlation between sample investments, content volume, creator partnerships, and product success—to educate merchants and Account Managers on best practices.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s)

 Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree Available to start immediately until the end of the year Highly interested in the e-Commerce industry, with strong curiosity and the ability to learn quickly, and understand the short video/content and live broadcast ecosystems of TikTok. Proficient in Excel/Lark Sheets, with basic data analysis skills

Preferred Qualification(s)

 Be mindful of data and be able to proficiently use at least one data visualization analysis tool. Previous experience in influencer affiliate, content strategy, or e-Commerce operations will be highly valued. Programming or coding skills are a plus; interest in leveraging internal and external tools and models to explore AI-powered solutions for operational work is highly preferred.

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

rows.title: BI Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Blue Light Card. Individually great, together unstoppable

The Role and the Team

We're looking for a BI Analyst to join us on a 12-month fixed-term contract, focused on metrics governance and enablement. Reporting to the BI Lead, you'll be part of a small, closely connected team and work with colleagues across every function, including senior stakeholders, to agree what our key measures mean and who owns them. You'll then build the data models and reporting that bring those measures to life and help people use self-serve analytics with confidence.

It's a hands-on role for someone who loves building, and who equally enjoys working with people to turn business questions into clear answers. You'll work mainly in SQL, dbt and Lightdash, alongside Claude and other AI-assisted development, in a fast-paced, supportive, AI-first environment with plenty of room to take ownership.

What You'll Do

Support our metrics governance programme by helping stakeholders agree consistent definitions and clear ownership of key measuresBuild and maintain data models and dashboards end to end, from the first business question to a finished product colleagues can use with confidenceScope, build, test and deliver dbt and SQL work, using AI-assisted development where it helps and checking the output carefullyDocument and test the data behind each key measure, and keep definitions and supporting documentation current so knowledge is shared rather than held by one personDeliver regular business reporting with accuracy and care, and keep our analytics tools reliable and easy to useCoach colleagues who are not data specialists, explaining concepts simply and sharing good practice so teams can act on data without waiting on the Data teamPartner with stakeholders across the business, including senior stakeholders, to understand their priorities and turn them into clear, reliable measures and reportingTurn open-ended business problems and ad hoc questions into clear analysis and recommendations that guide next steps, and keep people informed of progress, risks and any support needed

Our Culture

Our mission is simple: make heroes happy. Our members are real-life heroes who keep us all safe, cared for, and thriving. It's what gets us up in the morning, what makes us want to think bigger, and create something that truly matters. By focusing on their happiness, we create amazing experiences, deliver unrivalled discounts, innovative products, and world-class service.

We promote hybrid working, and value in-person collaboration so encourage time in our offices – either the HQ in Leicestershire, or London, Holborn office. The frequency and office location will vary depending on the role and team. We aim to be flexible, but we aren't able to offer fully remote working.

We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team where different perspectives and experiences help us grow, innovate, and better reflect the communities we serve. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. In the event of a high number of applications, we'll prioritise candidates who meet both the essential and desirable criteria for the role.

25 days annual leave plus public holidays and an additional day off for your birthdayA Moments that Matter day – one extra day of leave each year to use for something that matters to youBuy and sell holiday scheme of up to 5 daysA volunteering/fundraising day – one paid day each year to give something back to the communityAnnual company bonus scheme – linked to both company and individual performanceYour own Blue Light Card and exclusive access to thousands of discountsPersonal growth fund of £450 per year to invest in your developmentPrivate Medical Insurance that includes cover for pre-existing conditionsAuto-enrolment pension scheme via salary sacrifice, with 100% of employer NI savings reinvested into your pensionEnhanced Maternity, Partner, Adoption and Shared Parental LeaveHealthcare cash-back planColleague Assistance Programme – 24/7 confidential support whenever you need itHybrid working and flexible hoursEV charging and free parking onsite at HQRelaxed dress code and modern office space (games area, chill-out areas, book club, free drinks and well stocked snack drawers!)On-site gym including free HIIT and stretch classes at HQ

Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled Data Analyst to deliver accurate, timely, and insightful management reporting for internal stakeholders and clients.

In this role, you will gather, validate, and analyse data from various sources to create clear and actionable insights that inform strategic and operational decision-making for our Sipcom business.

Salary & Benefits

The budgeted salary for this role is between £45,000 - £55,000 a year, depending on experience.

Click here for the list of benefits.

Hybrid working

We recognise the benefits that remote and flexible working brings.

We operate a hybrid working policy that allows our employees to balance time in the office and time from home. Each team within our organisation can decide how to implement this policy. If you have any questions after applying, please reach out to our recruitment team.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities include:

Design and Maintain Reports: Create and manage user-friendly Power BI reports and dashboards to support business decision-making.Data Analysis: Analyse data from multiple sources to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, translating findings into actionable insights.Data Validation: Ensure data accuracy and reliability by validating reporting data and investigating discrepancies.Stakeholder Collaboration: Work with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and develop practical dashboards and outputs.Automation of Processes: Enhance efficiency by improving and automating manual reporting processes using tools like Power BI, Excel, and Power Automate.Reporting and Presentation: Present findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and support operational performance through meaningful data insights.

What Success Looks Like

Timely Delivery of Reports: Successfully design and deliver a minimum of 5 key Power BI reports and dashboards that meet stakeholder requirements within the designated timelines.Data Accuracy Improvement: Achieve a data accuracy rate of at least 95% by validating and reconciling discrepancies in reporting data.Stakeholder Engagement: Establish strong working relationships with key stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and feedback on dashboard usability.Automation of Reporting Processes: Automate at least 3 manual reporting processes, resulting in improved efficiency in data reporting.Insight Generation: Identify and present significant trends or risk areas through data analysis, leading to actionable insights for operational improvement.Customer Satisfaction Reporting: Develop and deliver a comprehensive customer satisfaction report, highlighting key metrics and trends to enhance service delivery.

Qualifications & Experience

The ideal candidate for this role will have:

Proven experience in a Reporting Analyst, Data Analyst, Data Scientist, or similar analytical role, with strong problem-solving skills to interpret data and present actionable insights.Strong practical knowledge of Microsoft Power BI, Azure Synapse Analytics, SQL Server Reporting, and related tools, with experience in designing and maintaining accessible dashboards and reports.Experience and confidence in extracting, cleansing, transforming, and analysing data from various sources, coupled with a solid understanding of data quality, governance, and reporting controls.Ability to gather and translate reporting requirements from stakeholders into practical dashboards and outputs, ensuring alignment with business needs.Experience in automating reporting processes using tools like Power Automate, enhancing efficiency and reducing manual effort in data reporting.

This role will require you to undergo the Security Clearance (SC) process once in role, so for that reason we will ask you to confirm if you are a British passport holder with 5 years residency in the UK when you apply for this position.

As one of Microsoft's leading partners in the UK, specialising in Azure, Security, Dynamics 365, and Microsoft 365, we have a proven track record of success in delivering transformational IT services.

The successful candidate will teach a minimum of eight fortnightly seminar groups (approximately six classroom hours per week) and contribute to the design and development of course materials, while developing their own research agenda. They will join an enthusiastic community of interdisciplinary educators and will have opportunities to collaborate with colleagues both within LSE100 and across LSE. The successful candidate will also perform administrative duties while fostering a supportive and engaging learning environment for LSE100 students.

LSE100 offers three themes for students to choose from as their focus of study. In 2026/27, these are: How can we control AI ?, How can we transform our climate futures?, and How can we create a fair society? The ability to demonstrate research-informed interest and expertise in teaching across multiple themes is an asset. For this post, we are looking for individuals who have an interest in teaching on our How can we create a fair society? theme, and whose research interests connect to the topics of social division, cohesion and/or polarisation.

Candidates should have completed or be close to completing a PhD in a social science or related discipline. Relevant teaching and assessment experience particularly in an interdisciplinary context, the ability to work closely with and learn from colleagues, and excellent communication and organisational skills, are also essential. The other criteria used in shortlisting for this post can be found in the person specification on LSE’s recruitment system.

Please note that at least one of the referees for this application should be someone who has overseen or managed the candidate’s teaching.

We offer an occupational pension scheme, generous annual leave, and excellent training and development opportunities.
