rows.title: Research Fellow (Econometrics and Validation)

company.name: The London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE)

rows.descriptionText:
LSE is committed to building a diverse, equitable and truly inclusive university

 The Inclusion Initiative (TII) 

 Department of Psychological and Behavioural Science 

 Research Fellow (Econometrics and Validation) 

 Salary from £53,949 to £62,160 pa inclusive with potential to progress to £69,073 pa inclusive of London allowance 

 Funding is available to support this position for 1 year, starting Autumn 2026 

The Inclusion Initiative (TII) at LSE uses behavioural science and rigorous quantitative research to help organisations build more inclusive workplaces. Its Growth and Governance (G&G) Hub is dedicated to measuring and driving progress on race inclusion in large listed companies.

The Hub has assembled every annual report published by FTSE 350 companies over a seven-year period and built the first large, expert-calibrated measure of how those companies write about diversity. Around 20 diversity and inclusion specialists hand-labelled more than 25,000 passages to create a ground truth; a large language model was then tested against that ground truth and tuned until it matched the experts as closely as the experts matched one another. That model now scores the full corpus, producing a comparable, independently produced measure for every report. The first company reports to be published concern race and ethnicity.

Further information about The Inclusion Initiative is available at www.lse.ac.uk/tii .

Applications are invited for a Research Fellow to lead the quantitative validation of the Hub's measures and to write that work up for publication. You will report to Dr Grace Lordan, Director of TII.

You will assemble and link firm-level data from external sources, including financial performance, workforce composition and diversity, and governance characteristics, and establish the relationship between the Hub's measures and those variables using panel methods appropriate to a multi-year corpus. You will test the construct validity, robustness and stability of the measure and its components, propose improvements, and contribute to peer reviewed papers and published methodology that open the measure to external scrutiny.

Candidates Should Have

 a PhD in economics, econometrics, quantitative social science or a closely related subject, or expect to have submitted their PhD thesis by the post start date; a solid background in applied econometrics, in particular panel data methods; A track record or trajectory of peer-reviewed publications; demonstrable expertise in research on diversity and inclusion, including a strong grounding in race and ethnicity in workplace, labour market or organisational settings; experience of constructing and linking large firm-level datasets from multiple sources, including firm-level, financial or administrative data, and advanced programming skills in Stata, R and/or Python.

We offer an occupational pension scheme, generous annual leave, hybrid working, and excellent training and development opportunities. The successful candidate is expected to be in the office in London a minimum of two days per week as chosen by the Director.

For further information about the post, please see the how to apply document , job description and the person specification .

rows.title: Principal Data Scientist, Experimentation
rows.descriptionText:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

At Tripadvisor experiences, the only thing we love more than travel is data. We slice it, we dice it, and we use it to empower our decision making.

What You Will Do

As a Principal Data Scientist you will be a leading individual contributor responsible for how experimentation works across the organisation.

You will lead through technical depth, setting the standards others work to and raising the quality of measurement and decision-making across the function.

You will build the capability that lets teams experiment well without central support: the standards, tooling and protocols that make good practice the default, and a strategy for how it develops over time.

Both the speed and the reliability of decision-making should improve as a result. You will also take on the measurement questions we cannot currently answer well, where traffic is thin or the outcomes that matter take months to appear.

You Will

Set the technical standard for experimentation across Product Data Science, from conventional A/B testing to quasi-experimental and Bayesian methods, and make it practical through protocols, frameworks and tooling.Partner with Product, Engineering and Data Platform teams to improve experimentation velocity without sacrificing rigour.Critically assess how experimentation and the decisions that follow it affect platform health and growth, and make that relationship visible to leadership.Own the measurement approach for Viator's most complex questions, where standard experimentation is insufficient and the method has to be designed rather than selected.Develop and validate the statistical methods the organisation relies on, including simulation-based verification that they behave correctly before teams depend on them.Act as the final technical authority on measurement validity, adjudicating disputed results and determining what the evidence does and does not support.Standardise recurring analytical and experimentation processes across the function, using automation and AI capabilities where they materially improve consistency, throughput or quality.Design and land methodological improvements with organisation-wide impact, such as variance reduction for difficult metrics, approaches for low-traffic surfaces, proxy and surrogate metrics for long-horizon outcomes, and designs that hold up where users compete for shared supply.Grow the technical depth of the wider team by reviewing designs, mentoring senior data scientists, and improving how people reason about measurement.Advise on where experimentation is the wrong tool and define what should be done instead.

Skills & Experience

Experience: Extensive experience in data science or a similar quantitative role, with a proven track record of supporting and influencing a product organisation.Statistical & Experimentation Expertise: Authoritative command of experimentation in all its forms, from experimental design and variance reduction to causal inference, bandits and Bayesian methods. You should be able to develop and validate methodology, not only apply it.Technical & Modelling Expertise: Expert level proficiency in Python and SQL. Deep, hands-on experience with statistical modelling, (quasi) experimentation, multi-arm bandits, and a wide range of machine learning techniques such as regression, classification and clustering.Product Acumen: Demonstrated ability to define, implement and operationalise crucial product and feature-level metrics from scratch.Partnership & Enablement: Demonstrated ability to improve how other teams work by providing guidance, tooling and protocols, increasing both the speed and the quality of their experimentation rather than absorbing the work yourself.Decision Impact & Platform Health: Ability to critically assess how product decisions affect platform health and growth over time, and to bring that perspective into how experiments are designed and interpreted.Standardising at Scale: Experience standardising processes, frameworks or methods across multiple teams, including the use of AI and automation to make good practice the default.Cross-Functional Partnership: Proven ability to build strong relationships and drive outcomes across Product, Engineering, Data Platform and other central functions, often without direct authority.Critical Thinking: Leader in critical thinking, with a demonstrated habit of establishing whether a result is trustworthy before establishing what it means.Communication: Exceptional ability to explain measurement, method and uncertainty clearly to technical and non-technical audiences at every level.Education: Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

You could be an especially great fit if you have:

Experience with experimentation in a two-sided marketplace, where interference between users and finite shared supply complicate measurement.Experience building and validating proxy or surrogate metrics for long-horizon outcomes, and a clear view of how far they can be trusted.Experience with Bayesian and hierarchical approaches, particularly for low-traffic surfaces or pooling evidence across many small markets.Experience building or materially improving experimentation platforms, measurement frameworks, self-service capabilities or data products.Experience in a high-scale technology company, marketplace, e-commerce business or travel technology organisation, and familiarity with the seasonality and long purchase cycles that come with them.Breadth in statistical modelling and machine learning, such as regression, classification, clustering and bandits, alongside your experimentation depth.Experience applying AI, Large Language Models, agentic AI or automation to improve analytical productivity and decision-making effectiveness.A reputation for raising the standard of thinking and decision-making in every team you join.Experience with SaaS experimentation tools such as Statsig, Eppo or GrowthBook, or with an in-house platform.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

We tackle the most complex problems in quantitative finance, by bringing scientific clarity to financial complexity.

From our London HQ, we unite world-class researchers and engineers in an environment that values deep exploration and methodical execution - because the best ideas take time to evolve. Together we’re building a world-class platform to amplify our teams’ most powerful ideas.

Join a research team where curiosity meets scale. You’ll investigate foundational questions, uncover market insights and push the boundaries of what's possible - all with the support of near-limitless compute and world-class peers.

Take the next step in your career.

10-week summer programme (21st June - 27th August 2027)09:00-17:30 working hoursBased in Central London

The role

You’ll translate complex datasets into strategic insights and actionable recommendations that move the business forward. This is a hands-on role where you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams across Commercial, Product and Operations to ensure stakeholders have the right data, insights and metrics to make confident decisions. You’ll own analytics projects end-to-end, from understanding the initial business problem through to extracting and analysing data, developing visualisations and communicating meaningful recommendations.

How To Make An Impact

Lead end-to-end analytics projects, from scoping stakeholder requirements to data extraction, analysis in SQL, visualisation and presentation of actionable insights. Partner closely with stakeholders across Commercial, Product and Operations to identify strategic opportunities for growth and improvement. Develop and maintain dashboards and analytical frameworks that enable teams to make informed, data-driven decisions. Help define and maintain consistent business metrics and KPIs. Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes. Challenge assumptions and requirements to ensure we're solving the right business problems. Continuously monitor and improve data quality, ensuring stakeholders can trust the insights they use. Proactively explore data to uncover emerging trends, risks and opportunities. 

Your background

A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics or another quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience. 2+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics or a similar analytics role. Advanced SQL skills, with the ability to independently extract, manipulate and analyse complex datasets. Experience using Tableau or another mainstream BI/data visualisation tool, such as Power BI, Looker, Metabase or Sisense. Strong commercial awareness and an ability to connect analysis with meaningful business outcomes. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. A proactive approach, with the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions and take ownership. Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning complex business requirements into meaningful insights.

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 peopleAmong the fastest-growing tech companies in the UKProfitable since 2017Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman SachsLoved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

rows.title: Data scientist
rows.descriptionText:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilitiesDesign and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks.Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems.Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company.Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking.Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends.

What we look forReasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offerIncredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland).

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. Job Description

Role Purpose

The Privacy Analyst position is part of the Legal Privacy team that reviews and provides guidance based on business requests for the collection and use of personal data in compliance with global privacy regulations. In this position you will support the development and maintenance of NBCUniversal’s Legal Privacy program.

Responsibilities:

Review technical and operational documentation to understand how personal data is collected, used and shared and assist in the application and documentation of relevant legal requirements and NBCU guidelines. Help business data users understand their obligations and requirements related to personal data, including by supporting the preparation of training materials and practical guidance. Review and comment on Privacy Impact Assessments, including helping confirm personal data flows and whether supporting documentation has been provided by the business to facilitate Privacy Legal review. Liaise with all Business verticals across the NBCUniversal portfolio including working with corporate functions such as Privacy Operations, Cyber Security, Marketing, and others. Work with the Privacy Operations team and Privacy Legal on Consent Management Platforms, cookie and tracking documentation, Individual Rights Requests, and documentation relating to privacy risk and mitigation. Support various other privacy and security-related projects as assigned.

Bachelor’s degree requiredExperience summarizing complex information into business-friendly terms requiredExperience working with privacy and security-related matters requiredIAPP Designation (CIPP/CIPM) preferredEligibility Requirements

Exceptional verbal and written communication skillsProven research and analytical skills. Knows how to use resources and seeks out new sources of informationProven ability to quickly understand key business drivers, products and processesProven ability to build relationships and foster a collaborative atmosphereComfort working cross-functionally with Legal, Privacy Operations, Cyber Security, Marketing, and business teams to gather information and drive privacy-related processes forward. Ability to learn quickly and exercise independence, initiative, and sound judgment while operating with minimal supervision. Proven ability to prioritize competing deadlinesStrong attention to detail and accurate documentation for privacy reviews, risk assessments, and operational processes.

Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled Data Analyst to deliver accurate, timely, and insightful management reporting for internal stakeholders and clients.

In this role, you will gather, validate, and analyse data from various sources to create clear and actionable insights that inform strategic and operational decision-making for our Sipcom business.

Salary & Benefits

The budgeted salary for this role is between £45,000 - £55,000 a year, depending on experience.

Click here for the list of benefits.

Hybrid working

We recognise the benefits that remote and flexible working brings.

We operate a hybrid working policy that allows our employees to balance time in the office and time from home. Each team within our organisation can decide how to implement this policy. If you have any questions after applying, please reach out to our recruitment team.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities include:

Design and Maintain Reports: Create and manage user-friendly Power BI reports and dashboards to support business decision-making.Data Analysis: Analyse data from multiple sources to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, translating findings into actionable insights.Data Validation: Ensure data accuracy and reliability by validating reporting data and investigating discrepancies.Stakeholder Collaboration: Work with stakeholders to define reporting requirements and develop practical dashboards and outputs.Automation of Processes: Enhance efficiency by improving and automating manual reporting processes using tools like Power BI, Excel, and Power Automate.Reporting and Presentation: Present findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and support operational performance through meaningful data insights.

rows.title: BI Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Blue Light Card. Individually great, together unstoppable

The Role and the Team

We're looking for a BI Analyst to join us on a 12-month fixed-term contract, focused on metrics governance and enablement. Reporting to the BI Lead, you'll be part of a small, closely connected team and work with colleagues across every function, including senior stakeholders, to agree what our key measures mean and who owns them. You'll then build the data models and reporting that bring those measures to life and help people use self-serve analytics with confidence.

It's a hands-on role for someone who loves building, and who equally enjoys working with people to turn business questions into clear answers. You'll work mainly in SQL, dbt and Lightdash, alongside Claude and other AI-assisted development, in a fast-paced, supportive, AI-first environment with plenty of room to take ownership.

What You'll Do

Support our metrics governance programme by helping stakeholders agree consistent definitions and clear ownership of key measuresBuild and maintain data models and dashboards end to end, from the first business question to a finished product colleagues can use with confidenceScope, build, test and deliver dbt and SQL work, using AI-assisted development where it helps and checking the output carefullyDocument and test the data behind each key measure, and keep definitions and supporting documentation current so knowledge is shared rather than held by one personDeliver regular business reporting with accuracy and care, and keep our analytics tools reliable and easy to useCoach colleagues who are not data specialists, explaining concepts simply and sharing good practice so teams can act on data without waiting on the Data teamPartner with stakeholders across the business, including senior stakeholders, to understand their priorities and turn them into clear, reliable measures and reportingTurn open-ended business problems and ad hoc questions into clear analysis and recommendations that guide next steps, and keep people informed of progress, risks and any support needed


What You'll Bring

Hands-on experience building and maintaining data models in a modern analytics stack, such as dbt, in a professional settingStrong SQL and data modelling skills, with the ability to scope, build, test and deliver your own workExperience building dashboards and reports in a BI tool, such as Lightdash, Looker or TableauComfort working with stakeholders at all levels, including senior stakeholders: asking the right questions, explaining clearly and building agreement togetherThe ability to turn an open-ended business problem into clear analysis and a recommendation others can act on, while managing multiple prioritiesExperience of coaching or building confidence in colleagues who are not data specialistsUse of AI tools to work faster and more accurately, with good judgement on checking the outputExperience of metrics governance, working with data in a digitally native or fast-paced environment, or working in an AI or machine learning setting would be a bonus


Our Culture

Our mission is simple: make heroes happy. Our members are real-life heroes who keep us all safe, cared for, and thriving. It's what gets us up in the morning, what makes us want to think bigger, and create something that truly matters. By focusing on their happiness, we create amazing experiences, deliver unrivalled discounts, innovative products, and world-class service.

We don't just follow the usual path - we look for smarter, bolder ways to deliver real impact. We take ownership, move fast, and work shoulder to shoulder to build something special.

The frequency and office location will vary depending on the role and team. We aim to be flexible, but we aren't able to offer fully remote working.

Blue Light Card is an equal opportunities employer. We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team where different perspectives and experiences help us grow, innovate, and better reflect the communities we serve. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. In the event of a high number of applications, we'll prioritise candidates who meet both the essential and desirable criteria for the role.

25 days annual leave plus public holidays and an additional day off for your birthdayA Moments that Matter day – one extra day of leave each year to use for something that matters to youBuy and sell holiday scheme of up to 5 daysA volunteering/fundraising day – one paid day each year to give something back to the communityAnnual company bonus scheme – linked to both company and individual performanceYour own Blue Light Card and exclusive access to thousands of discountsPersonal growth fund of £450 per year to invest in your developmentPrivate Medical Insurance that includes cover for pre-existing conditionsAuto-enrolment pension scheme via salary sacrifice, with 100% of employer NI savings reinvested into your pensionEnhanced Maternity, Partner, Adoption and Shared Parental LeaveHealthcare cash-back planColleague Assistance Programme – 24/7 confidential support whenever you need itHybrid working and flexible hoursEV charging and free parking onsite at HQRelaxed dress code and modern office space (games area, chill-out areas, book club, free drinks and well stocked snack drawers!)On-site gym including free HIIT and stretch classes at HQ

We move cargo that positively impacts society worldwide. Whatever people need, wherever they are. At IAG Cargo we open the skies and fly the world to bring people the things they really need.  

We are the logistics and cargo brand of International Airlines Group (Aer Lingus, British Airways, Iberia, Level and Vueling). Powered by five airlines, our reach is truly global – but it’s the impact we make that defines us. At IAG Cargo, we believe in keeping the world’s economies turning, and do everything with determined attitudes, curious minds, collaborative actions and heartfelt pride. Join us at our globally recognised logistics business, that is Trusted to Deliver.

About The Role

The Operations Performance Analyst is a key driver of operational effectiveness across Worldwide Operations, combining analytical expertise with hands-on support for performance improvement and business change initiatives. The role works closely with operational teams to deliver meaningful performance insights, identify and quantify the impact of operational disruptions, strategic initiatives and improvement projects on key business KPIs, and support data-driven decision making. The Operations Performance Analyst is responsible for ensuring timely, accurate and actionable data is available to support operational delivery, developing performance metrics and reporting, and translating insight into practical actions that drive measurable improvements in performance, cost, customer experience and productivity. The role also leads or supports operational improvement projects, works with stakeholders across the business to realise benefits, and provides near real-time and historical performance insight to support continuous improvement and delivery of the Worldwide Operations strategy

What You’ll Do

Work with all Worldwide Operations teams to agree and deliver an appropriate suite of operational metrics underpinning performance, cost, customer experience and employee targets.Ensure accurate, timely and relevant data and insight is provided to continuously improve operational performance (including KPIs, SLAs, and productivity metrics).Analyse performance data trends and conduct root cause analysis to identify prioritised opportunities for improvement.Identify trends, risks, and opportunities for performance improvement.Develop and maintain dashboards that provide real-time visibility into operational performance.Drive improvements through more efficient reporting using automation.Identify gaps in data availability and propose practical solutions.Partner with operational teams to develop, implement and track performance improvement initiatives, ensuring actions are delivered and benefits realised.Scope and lead or support improvement projects as required.Provide hands-on support to operational and strategic projects, helping to identify issues, coordinate actions and drive delivery of business objectives.Contribute to the definition, elaboration, communication and implementation of the Worldwide Operations strategy, taking into account trends, technology and business data.Represent Worldwide Operations across IAG Cargo to ensure operational data requirements are clear and delivered.Act as the interface between Worldwide Operations and the IAG Cargo Data & Analytics teams to support provision and validation of data, metric development and data visualisation.Ensure adherence to the governance structure for regular review of operational performance across all areas.Contribute to the provision of reporting on performance data to the IAG Cargo Executive Team via weekly and monthly packs and narratives and contribute to business reviews.Analyse and quantify the impact of operational disruptions, business initiatives and improvement projects on key performance indicators, using data-driven insight and scenario analysis to support decision making and prioritisation.

It's All About You

What you’ll bring to IAG Cargo:

We are looking for a strategic thinker with an investigative mindset, strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate insight into action. We are not necessarily looking for deep expertise in any particular analytical tools. What we are looking for is someone who can learn new tools quickly, enjoys investigating complex operational issues with a calm and methodical approach, can assess data quality and business impact, and is able to deliver value through practical, incremental improvements. You should be comfortable with ambiguity and have the resourcefulness and curiosity to uncover solutions, influence stakeholders and drive positive outcomes, even when the tools are not yet perfect and the data is incomplete.

You should have excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders and operational teams alike. Experience in performance analysis, business improvement, project delivery or operational problem-solving is essential, ideally within transportation, logistics, supply chain or transformation environments. You should be collaborative, proactive and comfortable working hands-on with teams across the business to identify opportunities, support decision making, implement improvements and deliver measurable operational benefits.

Skills And Experience

Hold a 2:1 degree or above (or equivalent) in Data Analytics, Business, Operations Management, or a related field.Have relevant experience in data or business analysis.Have proficiency in MS Office (particularly Excel), SQL and BI tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau).Have the right to live and work full-time in the UK indefinitely.Be able to pass a Criminal Record Check.

It Would Be Helpful, But Not Essential To Have

Experience with Lean, Six Sigma or other process improvement methodologies.Knowledge of Python as well as AI application to data analysis.Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., AWS, Snowflake).Background in air cargo or complex operational environments.

We’ll treat you right

Wherever you work within IAG Cargo, you’ll play a part in helping us deliver what the world needs and join a diverse and inclusive business that’s making a difference.

As well as a competitive salary, bonus, we offer a range of benefits to support our colleagues, which include:

A hybrid environment with 3 days a week in the office and two from home.From the day you join us, you’ll get access to brilliant staff travel benefits including unlimited basic and premium standby tickets on British Airways and group airlines. You’ll also receive up to 30 discounted ‘Hotline’ airfares per year for yourself, friends, and family.Flexible bank holiday policy- Individuals not on shift have the flexibility to swap the statutory public holidays, with the days you choose to take off instead.All our colleagues get access to LinkedIn learning and Rosetta Stone Language coursesFor health and wellbeing we offer a free onsite gym facility as well as access to the UNMIND app and a community of Mental Health First AidersAccess to discounts on Apple, Cinema tickets and loads of other goodies through Perks at work

Diversity and Inclusion

Our recruitment procedures positively support our diversity and inclusion agenda.

All candidates are considered strictly on their merits in relation to the criteria for the role, treated fairly and consistently, and have their individual needs responded to throughout the process.

rows.title: Industrial Placement - Statistical Programming, Biostatistics & Data Science
rows.descriptionText:
Industrial Placement Opportunities – Pharmaceutical Industry· White City, London · 12 Months · Starting Summer 2027 · £27,500 per annum·
Available Placement OpportunitiesWe are working with a large client in the pharmaceutical space who are looking to take on 4 industrial placements for students actively working towards their degree. This position is only suitable for those currently going into their first or second year of university. You will not be considered if you are starting your third year. The available positions are as follows:Statistical ProgrammersBiostatisticiansData Scientists 
Once you have applied, your CV will be reviewed and, if suitable, a LinkedIn message will be sent to you with screening form to complete. The deadline for the applications is October 25th, 2026. We look forward to receiving your application soon!-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------What if your placement year wasn't just watching from the sidelines but about working hands on with clinical data contributing analytical work to support healthcare research?
That's exactly what you'll do. Over 12 months, you'll join a close-knit team of programmers, biostatisticians and data scientists where your work matters. You'll get the resources, data and global reach of one of the world's leading healthcare companies with the support of a growing community of professionals based in London.
About the OrganisationOur client is a leading global healthcare company with one of the most exciting product pipelines in the industry today. Their mission is to improve patients' lives through innovative medicines and healthcare solutions, delivered by diverse and engaged talent.
Creativity and diversity are encouraged, effort is recognised, success is celebrated, and people feel valued and listened to.
We're proud to offer this new UK placement programme to invest in the next generation of scientific and analytical talent because the people who join us as students today are the experts who will shape the healthcare systems of tomorrow.
About the Placement ProgrammeThis is a 12-month industrial placement starting in Summer 2027, based at our modern UK offices in White City, London. You'll be part of Advanced Quantitative Sciences (AQS), a team of programmers, biostatisticians and data scientists who contribute their expertise across every stage of drug development.
This role is expected to be primarily office-based at our modern, collaborative workplace in the heart of White City, London. Being together in our friendly office is how you'll build relationships, learn quickly from experienced colleagues, and feel part of the team from day one.
Placement RolesStatistical programmers transform raw clinical trial data into reliable, meaningful outputs that support drug development and regulatory submissions. You'll develop programming skills to build the datasets, tables and figures that help address real healthcare challenges.Biostatisticians work across the entire drug develop lifecycle helping to design studies and analyse clinical trial data. You'll work alongside experienced statisticians to turn complex data into clear insights.Data Scientists explore data, apply innovative methods to generate new insights from healthcare and clinical datasets. You'll experiment with modern approaches to uncover what the data is really telling us.
What You'll Be DoingWorking hands-on with real clinical trial and healthcare dataSupporting live medicines development programmes that affect real patientsUsing SAS and R and getting exposure to emerging AI toolsCollaborating with experienced colleagues and international, global teamsLearning and applying new analytical and statistical techniquesPresenting your findings and contributing to real team decisions and recommendations Managing aspects of meaningful projects under the guidance of experienced colleaguesWhat You'll GainPractical programming, statistical and analytical techniques applied to real dataStrong, transferable programming skills (SAS, R and more)An understanding of how drug development works at a large pharmaceutical companyCommunication and presentation skills that make complex data clearTeamwork and collaboration within cross-functional, international teamsConfidence, professional judgement and the ability to work independentlyYou'll leave with a year of real experience, a strong professional network, and skills you can take anywhere.
Who We're Looking ForWe're looking for curious, analytical people who love solving problems and want to learn.You'll need to have completed at least two years of your undergraduate degree before starting, as this placement is typically undertaken after your second year and before your final year of study. You must remain enrolled at your university throughout the placement year.
You'll thrive here if you have:Genuine curiosity and willingness to learnStrong analytical thinking and problem-solving skillsGood attention to detailThe ability to collaborate and communicate clearlyAn interest in healthcare, data and innovation
We welcome students studying Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science and Computer Science degrees — but if you're studying another quantitative or analytical subject and you're excited by this work, we'd genuinely love to hear from you. Some familiarity with a programming language such as R, SAS or Python is a plus, but your enthusiasm to learn is what matters most.
Diversity, Equity & InclusionYou'll be able to show up as yourself. We know the best ideas come from people who think differently, and we're building a team that reflects the world we serve. Whatever your background, identity or story, you'll be welcomed, respected and encouraged to speak up. If you need any adjustments during the application process to help you do your best, just let us know.
Ready to turn data into a difference? Apply today.
Additional Information Please ensure that you are willing and able to live within commutable distance of the company site before applying. This placement is based in White City, London and whilst we support hybrid working, we expect our students to be in the office a minimum of four days per week. Working patterns may be subject to change in line with business needs and company policies. For the duration of your contract, you will be employed by SRG, who are acting as the recruitment agency for this role. Final round: In-person assessment centre – 13th November 2026

rows.title: Social Insights Analyst, Studios
rows.descriptionText:
Job Requirements

About the Role & Team

At The Walt Disney Company, our stories connect with audiences around the world. Behind every successful release is a deep understanding of audience behaviour, cultural trends and evolving conversations. The Studios Intelligence team provides the audience, market and commercial insight that helps shape strategic decision-making across Disney's Studios business throughout EMEA.

We are currently looking for two Social Insights Analysts to join the Studios Intelligence team. In these roles, you will play a key part in helping Disney understand how audiences engage with our films, franchises and campaigns online. Combining social listening, audience analysis and cultural intelligence, you will uncover meaningful insights that inform marketing strategy, campaign optimisation, commercial decision-making and long-term planning.

Working across a wide range of Studios releases and the broader entertainment landscape, you'll transform complex social and cultural signals into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders across the business. You'll partner with colleagues across Studios Intelligence, Global Studios teams, external partners and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure audience perspectives remain at the heart of decision-making.

If selected for one of these roles, you will report to the Manager, Social Listening & Research.

These roles will be based in our London Hammersmith office, 4 days a week, with either a Monday or Friday working from home.

You'll join a team grounded in our Disney values: acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration, and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day.

What You Will Do

As a Social Insights Analyst, you will help translate online conversations and audience behaviour into insight that drives action across Disney's Studios business. Responsibilities include:

Analysing social listening, owned social, video and platform data to understand audience conversation, sentiment, engagement, content performance and emerging trends.Configuring, testing and refining social listening queries to ensure accurate and reliable data capture across campaigns, titles and markets.Monitoring online communities, competitor activity, platform developments and cultural conversations to identify opportunities, risks and relevant audience trends.Delivering insight across recurring social intelligence programmes as well as responding to fast-paced ad hoc stakeholder requests.Translating complex data and social signals into clear, compelling insight presentations, reports and executive summaries.Identifying implications for campaign strategy, audience targeting, creative development and content positioning.Evaluating campaign performance and audience response to marketing activity, content and creative assets.Contributing social and cultural insight to broader audience, market and commercial analysis across the Studios Intelligence team.Producing accurate, high-quality reporting, dashboards and analysis for a wide range of stakeholders.Maintaining and validating datasets, dashboards and measurement frameworks to ensure reliable reporting across EMEA markets.Collaborating with internal partners, global teams and external vendors to support business priorities.Helping evolve social listening methodologies, reporting practices, data visualisation approaches and AI-enabled ways of working.Staying informed about developments across social platforms, emerging tools and industry best practice.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience analysing social, digital or audience data to understand online behaviour, audience conversation and content performance.Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, with the ability to identify trends, patterns and actionable insights from complex datasets.Ability to translate data and analysis into clear, engaging and impactful recommendations for a variety of audiences.Excellent written and verbal communication skills.Strong organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.A collaborative approach and the ability to build effective working relationships across teams and stakeholders.Curiosity about entertainment, digital culture, audience behaviour and emerging trends.A proactive mindset with a passion for learning, innovation and continuous improvement.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience using social listening platforms and social intelligence tools.Familiarity with Boolean query building.Experience creating dashboards and data visualisations.Knowledge of measurement frameworks and digital performance reporting.Interest in AI-assisted analytical approaches and emerging technologies.

Admission is subject to availability, capacity restrictions, applicable rules, block-out dates, and eligibility requirements.Access to a wide range of Disney discounts on Disney merchandise, Disney Food & Beverage, Disney Resort Hotels, Disney Cruise Line, Adventures by Disney, National Geographic Expeditions, and more. Offerings are subject to availability and may be seasonal, and subject to applicable rules, restrictions, and eligibility requirements.Excellent parental and guardian leave policiesEmployee Resource Groups including WOMEN @ Disney, Disney Mosaic, Disney PRIDE, ENABLED and TRUST

We strive to build a workforce that reflects the diversity of our audiences and the communities we serve, creating an environment where everyone can thrive and belong. We are committed to welcoming and respecting a broad range of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation throughout the application and interview process, in performing essential job functions and in accessing employment benefits and opportunities. Please contact us if you require accommodation.

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

rows.title: Data Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Job Type

Permanent

Build a brilliant future with Hiscox

As a Data Scientist at Hiscox, you will take on a high-impact role, acting as a critical thinker and problem solver for the business. You’ll apply your core technical skills and innovative thinking to tackle complex challenges, identify opportunities, and help shape data-driven decision-making across the London Market.

You’ll operate across a wide variety of business functions, managing multiple priorities and delivering both ad hoc analysis and predictive/prescriptive models. Your work will contribute directly to building Hiscox’s data culture and enabling evidence-based decisions in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Communicating the business value of your analytical solutions to stakeholders will be a key part of your role.

You’ll be part of an award-winning team, recognised for its pioneering collaboration with Google to deliver the market’s first AI-enhanced lead underwriting solution. This achievement reflects the team’s commitment to innovation, impact, and excellence in applying data science to real-world insurance challenges.

As a Data Scientist, you’ll work within a wider technical team whose efforts span multiple business functions, bringing a multi-disciplinary approach to problem solving and analysis.

This is an ideal role for someone who is passionate about using analytics to influence decisions and is keen to continue learning and delivering value through data. You’ll be expected to conceptualise new approaches, communicate your vision to stakeholders, and see ideas through to implementation.

Key Responsibilities

Leveraging industry standards, emerging methodologies and empirical research to develop critical inputs to business information and helping business leaders develop innovative approaches to driving their business. Working on the end-to-end data solution including understanding complex business challenges, designing solutions, working with large and small data sets (including 3rd party and internal data of a wide variety), using cutting-edge machine learning or Generative AI techniques Work collaboratively with data scientists and other technical disciplines including product and business teams Work closely with other members of the data and analytics community at Hiscox, contributing to delivering value though the use of a range of analytics techniques. 


Person Specification

Degree in a STEM or closely related field or equivalent experience. A further degree is a plus. Practical data science experience, applying analytical techniques to solve business problems and deliver valuable insights. Experience of data science in finance or insurance is advantageous but not required. Experience conducting data analysis, experimentation, and model development to address business challenges. Comfortable using generative AI technologies, including AI-assisted coding tools, to accelerate research, development, and problem-solving, while maintaining a thorough understanding of the methods, code, and outputs produced.Able to critically review, validate, and take ownership of AI-assisted work, ensuring solutions are accurate, explainable, and fit for purpose, while working effectively both independently and as part of a team.


Skills

Experience using statistical analysis, machine learning, generativeAI, and data science techniques to identify trends, generate insights, and support business decision-making. Experience with analytical tools, programming languages, and databases, such as Python and SQL. Working knowledge of generative AI techniques and technologies, including large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering techniques, AI-assisted coding tools, and agentic AI workflows. Interest in a broad range of data science, machine learning, and AI techniques, with an eagerness to learn about emerging technologies and industry best practice. A strong grounding in statistical concepts and their practical application. Experience working both independently and collaboratively within small, cross-functional teams to deliver analytics and data science projects. Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts and insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Willingness to learn and apply engineering best practices, including version control, testing, code review, and reproducible development workflows.Exposure to cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is advantageous but not essential. Knowledge of the insurance industry is beneficial but not required. 


Work with amazing people and be part of a unique culture

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

This is your chance to contribute to strategic initiatives that strengthen compliance, simplify systems, and elevate quality culture across manufacturing and commercial operations.

Who are we looking for?

Currently studying an Undergraduate or Masters in Business, Management, Computer Science or related disciplines.

2026-10-23

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. rows.title: Data Analysis & Insights Project Intern (TikTok Shop) - 2026 Start - 2027 Start
rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities

The TikTok commerce team builds the solutions that help businesses engage audiences, inspire product discovery, and create commercial experiences on a platform where brands and merchants connect meaningfully with creators and communities.

We work closely with merchants, creators, and partners to support sustainable business growth while keeping the experience safe and trusted for the community. As the business scales across global markets, we take on complex challenges across content, commerce, trust, and the differing needs of each local market.

You will help shape the future of AI-native commerce, where discovery, entertainment, and buying happen in the same place.

About The Team

The e-Commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-Commerce experience to our users.

As a Project Intern, you will contribute to impactful short-term projects and gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, professional environment. This internship offers the opportunity to develop practical skills, apply your knowledge to real-world challenges, and explore your career interests.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

Responsibilities

 Support project-based goal tracking by monitoring key metrics across merchant and product performance, including sample supply, content output, and sales contribution. Analyze data to identify high-potential merchants and products, helping define the incubation profile and pathway for affiliate-focused sellers. Track and report on sample supply and content creation trends, identifying gaps and opportunities to optimize resource allocation. Assist in preparing weekly reports and analytical materials to summarize business performance and highlight key trends. Contribute to case study development by analyzing merchant and product performance, providing data-backed insights to support Account Managers in merchant outreach and pitch preparation. Help synthesize best practices and develop actionable pathways for merchants to optimize their affiliate investments. Support the consolidation of hit product cases by gathering data and insights from cross-functional teams, including policy resources, merchant BD inputs, and match-making incubation cases. Assist in quantifying the value of hit products by analyzing metrics such as sustained GMV growth contribution, merchant tier upgrades, and overall store GMV impact. Help document and communicate the methodology behind hit product incubation—for example, the correlation between sample investments, content volume, creator partnerships, and product success—to educate merchants and Account Managers on best practices.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s)

 Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree Available to start immediately until the end of the year Highly interested in the e-Commerce industry, with strong curiosity and the ability to learn quickly, and understand the short video/content and live broadcast ecosystems of TikTok. Proficient in Excel/Lark Sheets, with basic data analysis skills

Preferred Qualification(s)

 Be mindful of data and be able to proficiently use at least one data visualization analysis tool. Previous experience in influencer affiliate, content strategy, or e-Commerce operations will be highly valued. Programming or coding skills are a plus; interest in leveraging internal and external tools and models to explore AI-powered solutions for operational work is highly preferred.

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

rows.title: Group Safety, Security, Health & Environment Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
About DFT Operator

Join Our Team at DFTO

DFTO is the government’s public sector rail owning group. Its purpose is to bring all currently privately-owned train operators into public ownership in advance of the creation of Great British Railways in 2027 - and deliver improvements in the here and now by unifying and integrating train operations under common public ownership.

DFTO has over 30,000 employees, runs over 11,000 services a day and delivers over 930 million customer journeys across its networks every year. 7,000 people joined the railway family in the last year

Major improvements are being delivered by DFTO train operators (TOCs) that are already under public ownership - these are LNER, Northern, TransPennine Express (TPE), Southeastern, South Western Railway (SWR), c2c, Greater Anglia, WM Trains, GTR. and Chiltern.

We work closely with the DfT but operate independently with our own governance and leadership teams. Our priority is ensuring efficient, dependable rail services for everyone.

Primary Purpose Of Job

To provide analysis and reporting for the safety, health & environment analysis and reporting team.

Key Responsibilities

Undertake analysis of Group TOC and rail industry safety, health & environment indicators, metrics and benchmarking to produce management reports to time and of the required standard.Support the Group Safety, Security, Health & Environment Director with general administration, calendar management, meeting preparation and briefing, particularly in respect of their role chairing quarterly TOC SHE Committee meetings.Support the development and implementation of key performance indicators, targets and metrics for safety, health & environment performance across Group TOCs, whilst respecting each TOC’s bespoke safety management system and their responsibility for TOC safety, priorities and risk profilesContribute to the development of data collection methodologies and assurance mechanisms, co-ordinating Group wide activities, encouraging data sharing, best practice and rail industry collaboration. Undertake data assurance activities; verify data requirements undertake analysis, review and interpret analysis, support Group audit activity relating to Safety, Security, Health & Environmental matters and make recommendations.Working with other DFTO teams gather safety, security, health & environmental data regarding new TOCs joining the Group, and assist the teams in such TOCs with their transition to the Group.Undertake information management and record-keeping.Provide timely responses to enquiries and requests.Deliver data analysis projects within time, quality and cost parameters.Support project delivery, including monitoring and reporting on progress and generating project documentation.

Knowledge, Skills, Experience & Technical Qualifications

Excellent communication and analytical skills, with proven ability to present informationEffectively and appropriately.Excellent general IT skills.Experience of extracting information and reporting from multiple sources, including databases.Experience of dealing with customers effectively.Educated to GCSE level or equivalent relevant work experience.

key Deliverables 

Produce accurate and insightful safety, health and environment (SHE) reporting, identifying trends and providing management information to support decision-making.Develop, monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs) and industry benchmarks tomeasure and improve safety performance.Lead assurance activities to validate the accuracy, quality and integrity of safety data across the organisation.Support compliance with rail industry safety regulations, standards and best practice throughanalysis, reporting and recommendations.Build effective relationships with internal teams, Train Operating Companies (TOCs) and externalstakeholders to share best practice and support safety improvement initiatives.Deliver high-quality data analysis and assurance outputs with a strong focus on accuracy andattention to detail.Coordinate and support group-wide safety initiatives, transition activities, governance forums andcommittee meetings.Prepare clear, concise reports, briefings and recommendations for senior stakeholders, supportinginformed decision-making.

Vacancy Details

Duration: Fixed Term up to 31st October 2027 contract/secondment

Location: We currently have offices in London Waterloo, Leeds, Birmingham

Salary: £33.772 to £37,231

Closing date: 28/10/2026

DFTO Locations:

DFTO currently have office locations in London, Birmingham and Leeds and individuals can be based from any of the three locations. Whilst we do offer hybrid working there are sometimes demands to travel to the other office locations.

DFTO Benefits

Annual Leave: Starting at 25 days and rising to an additional day per year of service completed within the first 5 completed years up to a maximum of 5 additional (30 days)

DC Pension Scheme: 10% Employer contribution, 5% Employee contribution

Opportunities to learn and network across the wider industry

Additional Information…

Disclaimer: Candidates applying for this position on a secondment basis must inform their line manager prior to submitting their application. This is to ensure transparency and facilitate any necessary discussions regarding workload and responsibilities. 

About our people and the recruitment process - We're an inclusive employer of choice and we welcome applications from everyone! We encourage our colleagues to work flexibly, as we know traditional working patterns don't always fit. If you want to consider working flexibly, just let us know and we'll do our best to help and invest in your career with us, whilst you have a healthy work life balance.

Contact: If you have any questions or reasonable adjustments, please contact Dean.palmer@dftoperator.co.uk

Please do not email any CV's to us, your application must be made by clicking the 'Apply' button.

rows.title: Machine Learning Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Why Faculty? 

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About The Team

In our Professional and Financial Services Business unit, we bring everything we have learned in more than a decade of Applied AI, and use it to help our clients navigate a rapidly changing landscape.

We develop and embed AI solutions which help financial institutions become more efficient, enhance customer experience, and find the commercial upside in uncertain markets. Within the constraints of a highly regulated industry, we see so much opportunity for impactful innovation and are proud to set the gold-standard for marrying technical excellence with safe deployment.

About The Role

Join us as a Machine Learning Engineer to deliver bespoke, impactful AI solutions for our diverse Financial Services clients.

You will be instrumental in bringing machine learning out of the lab and into the real world, contributing to scalable software architecture and defining best practices. Working with clients, and cross-functional teams, you'll ensure technical feasibility and timely delivery of high-quality, production-grade ML systems.

What You'll Be Doing

Building and deploying production-grade ML software, tools, and infrastructure.Creating reusable, scalable solutions that accelerate the delivery of ML systems.Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, and commercial leads to solve critical client challenges.Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions to ensure project feasibility and impact.Defining and implementing Faculty’s standards for deploying machine learning at scale.Acting as a technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex ML concepts for stakeholders.

Who We're Looking For

You understand the full machine learning lifecycle and have experience operationalising models built with frameworks like Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.You possess strong Python skills and solid experience in software engineering best practices.You bring hands-on experience with cloud platforms and infrastructure (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture and security.You've worked with container and orchestration tools such at Docker & Kubernetes to build and manage applications at scaleYou are comfortable with core ML concepts, including probability, statistics, and common learning techniques.You're an excellent communicator, able to guide technical teams and confidently advise non-technical stakeholders.You thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy the autonomy to own scope, solve and delivery solutions

Our Interview Process

Talent Team Screen (30 mins)Pair Programming Interview (90 mins)System Design Interview (90 mins)Commercial Interview (60 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

rows.title: MS AD / Entra ID Engineer - Active Directory (6-month contract)
rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: MS AD / Entra ID Engineer - Active Directory

Role type: Contractor (6 months)

Department:Authentication/MFA & Directory Services - CIO

Location: London (Hybrid)

Company Overview

Nomura is a financial services group with an integrated global network. By connecting markets East & West, we service the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through our four business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking) and Banking.

Driven by the insights of some 28,000 people worldwide, we put our clients at the center of everything we do, delivering unparalleled access to, from and within Asia. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com

Overview

We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Active Directory / Entra ID Engineer to join Authentication and Directory Services Engineering function. The position focuses on designing and delivering enterprise-scale device management and identity solutions, bridging on-premises Active Directory with Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD). The successful candidate will work within the Authentication/MFA and Directory Services team and must demonstrate proven expertise in identity and security solution implementation.

Role Description

 Engineer solutions for Authentication / Directory Services / MFA infrastructure components  Design and implement global identity solutions for hybrid environments (on-premises and cloud)  Collaborate effectively within a multi-platform global engineering team  Present technical solutions and recommendations to management stakeholders  Adhere to established change control procedures and governance frameworks  Contribute to the continuous improvement of identity and access management practices

 Demonstrate an ability to work well as part of a global team, and on their own when required.  Strong oral and written communication.  Enthusiastic, eager and personable.  Ability to cope well under pressure.

 Subject-matter expert knowledge of Active Directory technologies, including:  Tiered Administration Models  Organizational Unit (OU) design and implementation  Group Policy management and deployment  DHCP and DNS integration  Active Directory enterprise design principles  Subject-matter expert knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and related cloud identity services  Deep understanding of Active Directory and Entra ID security frameworks  Comprehensive knowledge of Microsoft best practices for securing privileged access  Proficiency in developing automation scripts and PowerShell solutions to drive operational efficiencies 

Professional Skills

 Proven ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a global team  Strong verbal and written communication skills with confidence presenting to senior management  Self-motivated with a collaborative team-player approach  Enthusiastic, personable, and professional demeanour  Ability to perform effectively under pressure and meet tight deadlines  Strong adherence to change control procedures and operational discipline

 Subject-matter expert knowledge of Windows Server technologies and administration  Experience designing and deploying PowerShell security controls in enterprise environments  Experience of Ping AM / Ping DS Identity product set  Knowledge of regulatory requirements (PRA, FCA) relating to operational resilience
