rows.title: Machine Learning Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
Why Faculty? 

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About The Team

In our Retail & Consumer Business Unit, we bring everything we have learned in more than a decade of Applied AI and use it to help leading retailers, consumer brands, marketplaces, and digital commerce businesses navigate a rapidly evolving landscape.

We develop and embed AI solutions that help organisations better understand their customers, optimise operations, improve forecasting and decision-making, and unlock new opportunities for growth. From supply chains and merchandising to marketing, personalisation, and customer experience, we work with clients to deliver measurable commercial impact through AI. We are proud to combine technical excellence with practical deployment, ensuring solutions create value in complex, real-world environments.

About The Role

Join us as a Machine Learning Engineer to deliver bespoke, impactful AI solutions for our diverse Retail & Consumer clients.

You will be instrumental in bringing machine learning out of the lab and into the real world, contributing to scalable software architecture and defining best practices. Working closely with clients and cross-functional teams, you’ll ensure the technical feasibility and successful delivery of high-quality, production-grade ML systems that drive tangible business outcomes.

What You’ll Be Doing

Building and deploying production-grade ML software, tools, and infrastructure.Creating reusable, scalable solutions that accelerate the delivery of AI and machine learning systems across retail and consumer use cases.Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, product teams, and commercial leads to solve critical client challenges.Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions to ensure project feasibility, scalability, and commercial impact.Defining and implementing Faculty’s standards for deploying machine learning systems in production.Acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex ML concepts into actionable business outcomes.Applying machine learning to challenges such as demand forecasting, customer analytics, personalisation, pricing, marketing optimisation, inventory management, and operational efficiency.Supporting clients in adopting AI capabilities that improve customer experiences and drive sustainable growth.

Who We’re Looking For

You understand the full machine learning lifecycle and have experience operationalising models built with frameworks such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.You possess strong Python skills and solid experience in software engineering best practices.You bring hands-on experience with cloud platforms and infrastructure (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture and security.You’ve worked with containerisation and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes to build and manage applications at scale.You are comfortable with core ML concepts, including probability, statistics, experimentation, and common machine learning techniques.Experience working with retail, consumer, ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, or customer data is beneficial but not essential.You’re an excellent communicator, able to guide technical teams and confidently advise non-technical stakeholders.You thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy the autonomy to own scope, solve challenging problems, and deliver impactful solutions.

Our interview process

Talent Team Screen (30 mins)Pair Programming Interview (90 mins)System Design Interview (90 mins)Commercial Interview (60 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

rows.title: AI Developer in Education
rows.descriptionText:
The University of Law is looking for an AI Developer in Education to join our Technology Enhanced Learning and Teaching team and play a hands-on role in shaping how AI is used across the University.

We’re looking for someone who can look at a problem, understand what we are trying to achieve, and then work out whether AI is the right solution and, if it is, build it, test it, improve it and make it work at scale.

You’ll sit at the intersection of AI development, software engineering and education, working closely with our academic and learning design teams to turn ideas into practical AI-powered tools and experiences. You’ll also work directly with our key AI technology partners, helping to shape development priorities, troubleshoot issues and make sure we are getting real value from the technology we invest in.

This is an opportunity to join a University that is actively exploring what AI can do for education, while having the technical expertise and influence to help determine what should actually be built and how it should work.

What will you be doing?

Education

You’ll take technical ownership of the development, configuration and optimisation of AI tools used across our educational provision. This will include:

Designing, developing and maintaining Topics, Agents and Workflows within our generative AI platform, turning educational and business requirements into functional solutions.Building, testing and refining AI-powered learning experiences, using user feedback and evidence to continually improve them.Exploring emerging AI technologies and leading technical pilots and proof-of-concept projects — assessing not just whether something can be done, but whether it delivers meaningful value.Integrating AI platforms with University systems, including Blackboard Ultra, student information systems and other digital learning technologies.Working with APIs, LLMs and data integrations to create solutions that are secure, reliable and fit for purpose.Acting as a technical expert for our key AI platforms and technology partners, understanding their capabilities, limitations and development roadmaps.Troubleshooting technical issues and identifying practical ways to improve the performance, usability and reliability of our AI tools.Helping successful ideas move beyond experimentation and into sustainable solutions that can be used across the University.Producing clear technical documentation and guidance that can be understood by both technical and non-technical colleagues.Working closely with academic, learning design and professional services teams to understand their needs and translate them into effective technical solutions.Ensuring our AI development meets the University's requirements around security, accessibility, data protection and academic integrity.

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for someone with a strong technical foundation who is genuinely curious about what AI can do and equally interested in whether it should be used and what difference it will make.

You’ll Have

Demonstrable experience developing, configuring and maintaining AI tools or software applications.Strong programming skills in one or more relevant languages, such as Python or JavaScript, alongside experience working with AI/ML technologies.Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering and AI platforms, including chatbot or agent-based frameworks.Experience working with APIs, system architecture and data integration.Strong technical problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate, test and resolve complex issues.Experience communicating technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences and working effectively with a wide range of stakeholders.Experience producing clear, practical technical documentation.A strong understanding of data security, GDPR and technical compliance.A willingness to experiment with emerging technology, while applying sound judgement about what is genuinely useful and scalable.

Experience working within higher education would be valuable, as would experience in a legal education environment, but we are particularly interested in people who can demonstrate strong technical development experience and a track record of turning new technology into practical solutions.

To view the full job description click here and its associated roles and responsibilities

Why this role?

AI in education is moving quickly. This role gives you the opportunity to be right in the middle of that change.

You’ll have the freedom to explore new technologies, work with AI platforms and technology partners, and collaborate with people across the University to solve real problems. At the same time, you’ll have the opportunity to influence how AI develops beyond individual projects helping us understand what works, what doesn’t, and how successful solutions can be taken further.

If you enjoy building things, solving problems, experimenting with new technology and working with people to turn ideas into something tangible, we’d like to hear from you.

This is a full-time, permanent position and is home-based. Closing date for application is midnight 6th November 2026

Why join us?

Along with a competitive starting salary of £56,000, you’ll enjoy:

We provide a generous annual leave entitlement of 30 daysPrivate Medical Scheme and Life AssuranceContributory Pension SchemeOpportunity for professional development, including course sponsorship and fee discountsSeason Ticket Loans and Student Discounts

Our Approach

We are committed to ensuring our workforce is reflective of our diverse student population, striving to increase the representation of age, disability, gender identity and expression, religion, race, sex, sexual orientation, and socio-economic background of our employees.

We’re also committed to providing adjustments to those who may require support with the recruitment process - please contact the ULaw Talent Acquisition Team at talentacquisition@law.ac.uk.

Please note: For this opportunity, you must be able to prove you have the right to work in the UK - if in doubt please visit the Employers' right to work checklist - GOV.UK. Please note we are not a licensed sponsor.

rows.title: Energy Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Application Deadline:  8 November 2026Department: Grid Connections & Engineering Location: EdinburghCompensation: £45,500 / year

Description

As an energy analyst, you will deliver robust wind resource and energy yield assessments across our renewable energy portfolio. The successful candidate will provide technical guidance in delivering bankable assessments, supporting investment decisions and improving modelling methodologies across the business.

The successful candidate will ensure assessments meet bankability standards and will support technical due diligence, turbine selection, and layout optimisation activities. The role requires strong analytical capability, attention to detail, and a solid understanding of industry methodologies and uncertainty frameworks.

This is an enormously exciting opportunity to join a high growth business and play a key role in its continued success.


Key Responsibilities

Data collection, analysis and interpretation of measured wind data from met masts, lidar and Sodar to ensure maximum data coverage;Designing, reviewing and implementation of wind measurement campaigns of our greenfield wind developments including met masts and remote sensing technologies;Design and analyse solar and battery storage developments;Calculation of energy yield assessments, technical losses and uncertainties;Modelling of wind flow using linear wind flow models (WAsP) and CFD (WindSim);Develop, maintain and create python (or any other code) tools to improve analysis of wind data or energy yield assessment;



Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Knowledge & SkillsAbility to work well in a team environment to deliver on team goals;Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English;Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously while keeping projects on time;Strong analytical skills and the ability to collaborate effectively as part of a wider team;Proactive and willing to seek improvements to workflows and processes while staying up to date with the best practices in energy yield assessments.Experience & QualificationsA qualification in a highly numerate discipline e.g. engineering, physics, mathematics;Experience using industry software such as WindPro, WAsP, WindFarmer, Windographer, PVRated;Experience in wind resource assessment and energy yield modelling;Experienced in the use of Microsoft Office including Excel, Word and Powerpoint;Knowledge of programming languages such as Python or R;

Benefits

Hybrid work structure (3 days in office and 2 days working from home).Ability to work core hours and take time back in lieu throughout the week.Fridays are allocated as ‘no meeting’ days to ensure down time at the end of the week.28 days annual leave, plus bank holidays.Private Medical Insurance from day 1 with cover for immediate family including spouse or partner and children, including direct mental health pathways and support.Annual pay review and discretionary bonus.Employer pension contributions up to 7%.Electric car scheme via salary sacrifice.Cycle to Work SchemeTech scheme – discounts on latest technology including laptops, phones, iPads for personal useLife assurance cover and income protection.Travel insurance.Suite of enhanced policies and provisions to support colleagues through all the moments that matter.Regular team socials, activities, sporting events and charity fundraisers.

rows.title: Commercial & Energy Analyst (Edinburgh or Munich)
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Exergy3 is a Scottish deep tech company developing and commercialising a high-temperature Thermal Energy Storage (TES) system for industrial decarbonisation. Our technology converts surplus electricity into stored heat, delivered as process steam or hot air directly into industrial plant, displacing natural gas and reducing industrial carbon emissions without requiring customers to redesign their processes.

We are looking to hire a Commercial & Energy Analyst to be based in either Edinburgh or Munich to support the company as we scale commercially.

Heat is half the problem. We're fixing it.

Industrial heat is one of the hardest-to-crack sources of emissions on the planet. At Exergy3, we're building the technology to change that, and we need a sharp commercial mind to help turn breakthrough tech into a business that scales.

As our Commercial & Energy Analyst, you'll be the data engine behind commercial decisions. You'll bring the market analysis, financial insight and energy-sector intelligence that shape our strategy, sharpen our pricing, uncover new opportunities and drive our growth. Your work won't sit in a folder: it will decide which deals we chase, how we price them and where we go next.

We're a start-up, so no two weeks look the same. If you can be flexible to both customer and company needs, and can be ready to jump in and support any area of the business, this is the role for you.

Responsibilities

Conduct market analysis on energy pricing, supply-demand trends, regulation, and competitors to inform business decisionsBuild and maintain financial models to assess project viability, pricing strategies, investments, and commercial risksAnalyse complex datasets, track KPIs, and generate actionable insights for senior managementMonitor energy sector developments, including renewables, energy transition, policy changes, and emerging technologiesSupport business development through bid writing, contract evaluation, commercial negotiations, and opportunity assessmentIdentify financial, regulatory, market, and commercial risks and recommend mitigation strategiesCollaborate flexibly across the business to support customer and company needs

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience2-5 years of experience in a commercial or energy analyst roleExperience with financial modelling, data analysis, and reporting tools, with strong proficiency in Microsoft ExcelFamiliarity with energy markets, pricing mechanisms, and broader industry trendsProfessional proficiency in EnglishEligibility to work in Germany or the United Kingdom

Nice to have

Experience within the energy sector or a related industryUse of emerging AI tools and their application to modelling and analysisFamiliarity with Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, or other energy-market data platformsExperience presenting complex data clearly to senior management and colleaguesProfessional proficiency in German

Benefits

Competitive salary (£44,000-£55,000/ €52,000-€65,000)Stock options34 days annual leave (UK) inc. public holidays Company pension (5%)Hybrid working - 2-3 days in office35 hour working weekPersonal learning allowanceUp to 15 days of remote work from abroad each year Cycle to Work scheme/JobRad Additional benefits to be disclosed at interview stage

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Salary: £43,000 - £48,000

Leonardo UK operates a grade-based salary framework with broad bands. The salary range shown reflects the approved grade band for this role, or a narrower hiring range published within that band, and is benchmarked against the external market. Exceptions above the standard range are managed through governance controls to protect internal equity.

Your Impact

We have an excellent opportunity for a Procurement Data Analyst to join the UK Category Management Organisation within the Procurement & Commercial Function of the Electronics Division. The successful candidate will report to the Head of Direct UK Category Management.

What You Will Do

Liaise with internal and external stakeholders to gather, understand and report forecast data to enable sourcing and contract activities.Establish and develop Power BI reports.Develop and maintain inflation reports.Develop, manage and report Procurement key performance indicators. Create data dashboards, graphs and visualisations for category strategies and business reviews. Collate and analyse spend and performance related data. Determine and implement actions accordingly.Gather, analyse and report supply risk data in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.Act as point of contact for Procurement reporting, supporting data requests from the Procurement team.Establish strong relationships with stakeholders.Ability to work independently and with teams to meet requirements and deadlines.Knowledge of design and build quality datasets that enable stakeholders to make decisions, provide business recommendations and solutions.Provide supplier and market intelligence information and analysis to enable effective long-term decision-making and manage risk.Set up and maintain automated data processes.Identify, evaluate and implement solutions to support large volume data validation and cleansing.Monitor and audit data quality.Design and carry out surveys and analyse survey data.Focus on leading indicators and improving the function through effective analysis and reporting.Mine and analyse large datasets, draw valid inferences and present them successfully to management.Active participation in cross business working to support development of data management processes and process policies.

What You Will Bring

Good knowledge in analytics and reporting covering complex range of sub disciplines including – process, performance and supplier risk management.MS Office proficient, with expert level in MS Excel and Power BI.Extensive SAP user experience.Methodical and diligent with good planning abilities.Excellent interpersonal/communication and presentation skills, including the proven ability to influence at all levels, internally and externally.Able to work unsupervised and can operate well as part of a team.An understanding of Supply Chain and Procurement principles, techniques and practicesSelf-motivated, able to identify & drive key issues.Demonstrate collaborative and supportive behaviours. The ability to build strong and trusted relationships to achieve objectives.

Security Clearance

This role is subject to pre-employment screening in line with the UK Government’s Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS). rows.title: AI Runtime Engineer
rows.descriptionText:
About Modular

At Modular, a Qualcomm company, we’re on a mission to revolutionize AI infrastructure by systematically rebuilding the AI software stack from the ground up. Our team, made up of industry leaders and experts, is building cutting-edge, modular infrastructure that simplifies AI development and deployment. By rethinking the complexities of AI systems, we’re empowering everyone to unlock AI’s full potential and tackle some of the world’s most pressing challenges.

If you’re passionate about shaping the future of AI and creating tools that make a real difference in people’s lives, we want you on our team. You can read about our culture and careers to understand how we work and what we value.

About The Role

ML developers today face significant friction when deploying trained models. They work in a fragmented space with incomplete, patchwork solutions that require extensive performance tuning and model-specific optimizations. At Modular, we are building the next-generation AI platform that will radically improve how developers build and deploy AI models.

A core part of this offering is a platform that enables customers to achieve state-of-the-art performance across model families and frameworks. As an AI Runtime Engineer, you will own a runtime that operates on various CPU, GPU, and accelerator hardware platforms, optimizing performance for diverse customer AI models.

LOCATION: Candidates based in the United Kingdom are welcome to apply. This role will be based in our Edinburgh office (minimum 3 days per week on-site) with relocation assistance provided for eligible candidates. All new hires complete onboarding in-person.

What You Will Do

Design and develop runtime and cross-stack optimizations to improve CPU, GPU, and accelerator efficiency, addressing issues such as CPU overhead, caching, and data locality across multiple devices.Work with vendor-specific networking libraries to unlock high performance data transfer for multiple topologies.Collaborate with the compiler, kernels, serving, and models teams to design core technologies that achieve state-of-the-art end-to-end performance on various CPU and GPU hardware.Collaborate with the customer success team and engage with customers to understand their performance requirements and use cases.Collaborate with tooling and infrastructure teams to design systems for automated performance analysis and benchmarking.

What You Bring To The Table

 2+ years of experience working on high-performance computing systems.Experience in C++ programming and complex software systems.Experience with CPU or GPU runtime optimizations and performance analysis on CPUs, GPUs, or AI accelerators.Proficiency with one or more profiling tools (CPU or GPU).Creativity and curiosity for solving complex problems, a team-oriented attitude that enables you to work well with others, and alignment with our culture.

Helpful, But Not Required

Experience with ML graph optimizations, parallel / distributed programming, heterogeneous ML computation, and/or code generation.Exposure to MLIR, LLVM, and/or the Mojo programming language.Advanced degree in Computer Science or a related area is a plus.

Please note that specific benefit packages may vary based on your location, you can read more about benefits offered by Qualcomm here. Competitive Compensation. We offer very strong compensation packages, including RSU grants. We want people to be focused on their best work and believe in tailoring compensation plans to meet the needs of our workforce. Team Building Events. We organize regular team onsites and local meetups in Los Altos, CA as well as different cities. Traveling 2-4 times a year is expected for all roles.

rows.title: Software Engineer - Customer Facing Applied AI
rows.descriptionText:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship.

This role may require occasional work outside standard business hours to accommodate client time zones and up to 15% travel to client sites, including occasional overnight and multi-day engagements.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You'll Do

Build AI-powered agents and tools end-to-end: identify the problem with clients and domain experts, prototype quickly, evaluate rigorously, and ship to productionDesign and implement LLM integrations including prompt engineering, function calling, structured outputs, and retrieval-augmented workflowsDefine evaluation criteria and build test harnesses for AI systems where correctness is ambiguous and domain-specificWork directly with clients to understand their workflows, validate AI behavior, and iterate toward production qualityPartner with core engineering teams to generalize client-specific work into product featuresContribute to shared AI infrastructure (agent frameworks, tool integrations, deployment pipelines)Monitor and maintain production AI systems with attention to reliability, cost, and performance

Who You Are

Prior professional software engineering experienceProfessional experience with Python (the team's primary language)Experience working with LLM APIs (Claude, GPT, or similar) including function calling and structured outputsComfort with SQL for data exploration and building data-grounded AI workflowsExperience with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar)You've built something from zero to one. You're drawn to figuring out what to build, not just building what's specified.A bias for action. You ship quickly, learn from feedback, and iterate.You see projects through from prototype to production and care about what the client experiences, not what the code doesBS/MS in Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

Experience building agentic systems (multi-step tool use, agent orchestration, durable workflows)Experience with additional backend languages (Java is valuable in our environment)Familiarity with financial data (portfolios, transactions, securities, accounting)Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container-based deploymentsExperience with evaluation frameworks or methodologies for measuring AI system quality

Our Values 

Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

rows.descriptionText:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About The Role

As a Data Quality Specialist you will be a critical component of our autonomous vehicle data pipeline. You will ensure the integrity and quality of data collected from our test vehicles, which is essential for training and improving our self-driving systems. Your meticulous review and verification processes will help maintain high data standards and facilitate the development of more accurate and reliable autonomous driving algorithms.

At Applied Intuition, You Will

Review and validate data collected from test drives to ensure completeness, accuracy, and relevanceDevelop and implement automation scripts to streamline data verification processesIdentify anomalies, inconsistencies, and quality issues in collected datasetsAssist with data annotation and labeling to support machine learning model trainingDocument quality standards and create comprehensive reports on data quality metricsCollaborate with engineering teams to improve data collection methodologiesSupport the continuous improvement of data verification workflows

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

2+ years experience in data analysis, quality assurance, or related technical fieldFamiliarity with data annotation tools and workflowsExperience with data validation techniques and quality control processes for AV domainAttention to detail and analytical mindsetExperience with sensor data (LiDAR, radar, camera) from autonomous vehiclesStrong problem-solving abilities and communication skillsA minimum of a Bachelor's degree in STEM or a related field.

Nice To Have

Experience with data visualization toolsPrior experience in autonomous vehicle or automotive industriesProgramming skills in Python or similar languages for automation script developmentExperience with LinuxExperience with software tools/services like Slack, Jira, and ConfluenceExperience with Google Workspace

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.

Please reference the job posting’s subtitle for where this position will be located.

is an early-career engineering role within the Chief Data & AI Office focused on developing data pipelines, AI-powered applications, and cloud-based data services that support the bank’s business, operational, reporting and analytics priorities. rows.title: Computer Vision Intern, Fall/Winter 2026
rows.descriptionText:
Mill is a waste prevention technology company reimagining what it means to eliminate waste, starting with food. We build smart systems and infrastructure for homes, businesses, and municipalities that transform food scraps from landfill-bound waste into valuable resources, including chicken feed. Tens of thousands of Mill’s residential food recyclers are already helping households divert millions of pounds of food scraps every year, paving the way for our upcoming launch of Mill Commercial—the industry’s first end-to-end solution for managing, understanding, and preventing food waste in commercial environments (e.g. grocery, restaurants, food services). At Mill, we are passionate about building easy-to-use, beautifully designed technologies that keep food in the food system and out of landfills.

The role

We're looking for a candidate who wants hands-on experience applying their research inside a fast-moving company. As a Computer Vision Intern, you'll work directly with Mill's Computer Vision team on real production problems — from dataset curation and model training to the pipelines and experiment tooling that make our CV systems reproducible and fast to iterate on.

You'll be mentored by senior members of our Computer Vision team and see your work reach real devices and users. This is a hybrid role based in San Bruno, CA.

What you'll work on

Build and improve computer vision models — detection, segmentation, and classification — for material and food recognition and related tasksCurate, explore, and QA large image/video datasets, surfacing failure modes, duplicates, and labeling issuesDevelop and scale training pipelines and experiment-tracking/reporting so experiments are reproducible and results are easy to compare — i.e., help build the "experiment harness" the team relies onDesign and run rigorous model evaluations and contribute to how we measure progressCollaborate with engineering and data teams to move promising results toward productionDocument your methods and share findings with the team

What you'll bring

rows.title: Content Operations & Curation
rows.descriptionText:
About NewsBreak

Founded in 2015, NewsBreak is the Content Intelligence platform shaping the future content economy. With over 40 million monthly active users, our flagship platform delivers highly personalized local news and information powered by advanced AI, recommendation systems, and adtech.

Recognized by Fast Company as #32 on the Top Workplaces for Innovators, we're proud to be Great Place to Work® certified and home to a dynamic team of technologists, product innovators, and business leaders who are passionate about solving meaningful challenges at scale.

Together, we reached unicorn status in 2021, and we remain committed to continuing this high-growth trajectory with the right team to fulfill our mission: building the infrastructure layer for content intelligence.

If you’re inspired to dream big, innovate fast, and make a difference, we’d love to hear from you! For more information, visit www.newsbreak.com/about

About The Role

NewsBreak is building ReelBee, an open short-drama distribution platform where any qualified creator or studio can self-publish, earn a transparent revenue share, and get real US audience insights. This is a CEO-sponsored, company-level initiative. As a Content Operations & Curation specialist (Senior Specialist / Lead level), you will be the hands-on engine of our title-selection system: reviewing, tagging and queuing titles, running tests, and turning performance data into decisions. We are hiring 2 people for this role, in parallel in the SF Bay Area (Mountain View) and Beijing. Bilingual (English and Mandarin) required.

What You'll Do

Review and tag 40–60 new titles every week; verify AI-extracted tags (genre, character archetype, hook, paywall point, source tier) and judge quality and compliance, including common AI-drama issues such as lip-sync, hands and scene consistencyManage the weekly test queue: combine selection-system scores with your own judgment, track 72-hour scorecards (CTR, CPI, first-3-episode completion, unlock rate, first-purchase rate) and recommend which titles move to scaleRun post-launch operations for winning titles (recommendation slots, push, in-app distribution, creative direction); review performance and build a playbook of what works with our usersSend title-level and creative-level performance reports to content partners every week, collect their feedback and help steer supply directionSupport supply BD with sample evaluation and trial-batch review for new suppliers; maintain catalog metadata qualityTrack industry charts and TikTok short-drama trends; publish a weekly genre and hit-title brief, and calibrate your own picks against US charts and our performance data

What We're Looking For

2+ years of content operations, editorial, review or title-selection experience at a short-drama, web-fiction, short-video or content platform; short-drama platform experience (domestic or overseas) preferredHeavy short-drama viewer: familiar with top titles on ReelShort, DramaBox and similar apps, and able to quickly judge whether a title's hook, pacing and paywall design workData-savvy: read completion curves, drop-off episodes and payment conversion and turn them into operating actions; strong Excel/Sheets skills; BI dashboards or SQL a plusHigh throughput: keep judgment quality and pace at dozens of titles per weekFluent written and spoken English and Mandarin; able to review English-language series and subtitles and communicate with US partnersProficient with AI tools (LLM summarization/tagging, AI subtitles, AI voice detection) to raise efficiency

Nice to have

Short-drama acquisition, rights or distribution experienceTikTok/YouTube short-drama channel operations experienceAI short-drama production or QC experience

Pay may vary based on a number of factors including job-related skills, level, experience, geographic location and relevant education or training. At NewsBreak, we design our overall rewards package to attract top talents. Depending on the position, the role may also be eligible for discretionary bonus and options. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

$90,000 - $130,000 USD

Job Details

Job Description:

What if your next project helped power the future of technology?

At Intel, you'll do more than learn, you'll contribute. You’ll work side-by-side with industry leaders, gain hands-on experience on meaningful projects, and help solve real-world challenges that affect billions of people worldwide. From advanced semiconductor manufacturing to AI-powered innovations, you'll play a role in technologies that redefine how the world works, learns, and connects.

What makes Intel unique is the opportunity to see the entire technology lifecycle in action. Unlike many companies where hardware, software, and manufacturing operate separately, Intel brings them together, giving you exposure to everything from research and design to advanced semiconductor manufacturing and global deployment.

Whether you're tackling engineering challenges, improving operations, analyzing data, advancing next-generation technologies, or supporting global customers, you'll build valuable skills while contributing to innovations that enable a more sustainable and connected future.

Bring your curiosity, make an impact, and see where your ideas can take you at Intel.

Within Intel's sales and marketing groups, you'll combine your education with immersive, applied learning to understand how Intel brings technology solutions to customers, partners, and markets around the world.

Support marketing communications, sales strategy, brand positioning, customer engagement, or business operations. rows.title: Internal Audit and SOX Manager
rows.descriptionText:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

As the Manager of SOX and Internal Audit, you will have a key role in managing financial reporting risk across our fast-growing business. This is your moment to lead with impact and help transform the audit function by putting AI at its core. Join us in Santa Clara, CA, and be a member of a team dedicated to outstanding performance and careful implementation!

What You'll Be Doing

Be responsible for the end-to-end SOX 404 lifecycle and for assigned business process areas, including design assessment, risk assessment, walkthroughs, test planning, control testing, and reporting to management.Partner with process owners to assess risks, determine the control response, and drive the resulting narratives, flowcharts, and control builds to completion.Promote the adoption of AI in the Internal audit and SOX function by applying AI and analytics to risk assessment, documentation, testing, sampling, and evidence review.Review risks and controls associated with AI-powered business processes, ensuring the deployed AI and automation are regulated and sufficiently monitored.Evaluate control deficiencies, quantify potential impact, conclude on severity, and drive remediation to closure, presenting issues clearly to Accounting and Finance control owners.Drive continuous improvement and automation across the program by finding opportunities to streamline, standardize, and rationalize controls.Support and evaluate the efforts of offshore testers, giving coaching and feedback to maintain quality and audit-ready documentation.Build SOX proficiency across the business by developing and delivering mentorship and training that makes compliance requirements practical for control owners.Assist with operational audits and special projects as assigned.

What We Need To See

Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or equivalent experience. Active CPA required.8+ overall years in Big 4 and/or large public company environments, with broad hands-on SOX and internal audit experience covering core business processes.2+ years in a leadership role.Strong knowledge of GAAP, COSO, PCAOB standards, and Sarbanes-Oxley requirements, with good judgment in applying them to real-world business situations.Proven capability to manage complex workstreams autonomously, establish direction without formal authority, and influence process owners.Experience reviewing the work of others and raising quality standards within a team.Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with keen attention to detail.Strong ability to convey complex issues clearly, making recommendations accessible to executive audiences.Demonstrated critical thinking and curiosity, with a willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Semiconductor or high-growth technology industry experience.Hands-on experience applying AI, automation, or data analytics to audit or controls work.Experience scaling a SOX program through significant business growth, acquisitions, new revenue streams, or ERP/process transformation.Track record of getting results through influence.Familiarity with IT General Controls.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 136,000 USD - 212,750 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 11, 2026.

rows.title: Growth Marketing Lead
rows.descriptionText:
Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 2.5 million patients!

We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round.

About The Role

We're hiring a full-time Growth Marketing Lead to get provider offices responding to us the first time we reach them, and to support the top of our funnel.

When a pharmacy sends us a prescription that needs a prior authorization, we usually need something from the prescriber's office, most often the clinical notes. Many of those offices have never heard of us. We reach them by fax, email, and secure message to their EHR, and our calling team follows up by phone. Whether an office responds to that first contact decides how quickly a patient starts their medication.

You'll join our provider activation team, reporting to our Head of Provider Growth (to our CEO until that role is filled) and working alongside our calling, product, and engineering teams. You'll be our first dedicated marketing hire. Most of your time goes to one funnel, provider activation, and you'll own it end to end. The rest goes to top-of-funnel work with our sales team.

Three Things Define Success In This Role

You own the response rate. You own the faxes, emails, and secure messages we send offices the first time we need something from them: the copy, the timing, the channel mix for different kinds of offices, and the share of first-time offices that respond.You find what works and scale it. You run tests by channel and type of office, add new channels when the numbers support it, and stop what doesn't move response.You ship it yourself, AI-first. You go from an idea to a live test without a review committee. You produce the work personally, using AI tooling to move quickly, and you have the taste to know when something is good enough to go out.

You don't need a healthcare background, but you do need to pick up a complex domain quickly. Startup experience is a strong plus.

What You'll Do

Get first-time provider offices to respond

Own the faxes, emails, and secure messages that reach a provider office the first time we need something from it, and the response rate they produce.Decide timing, copy, and channel mix by type of office (practice size, specialty, history with us), using our outreach playbooks to run a mix and compare results.Work with our calling team so phone and digital touches work together on the same offices.

Test and grow channels

Run tests across channels and copy, read the results, and decide what to keep.Bring in new channels, like text messaging and HCP messaging networks, and run them against the same response number.Make Develop Health familiar to provider offices before our first request arrives, through the places they already look, like EHR marketplace listings and provider-facing pages.Work with product and engineering on what we track, so every response can be traced to the touch that earned it.

Support top of funnel (a smaller share of your time)

Run outbound and nurture campaigns that bring new pharma manufacturers, pharmacies and hubs into conversations with our sales team.

Ship the work

Produce the outreach itself: faxes, emails, messages, the pages offices land on, and leave-behinds for in-person visits.Work AI-first. Most production here is a matter of using the right tools well and knowing when the output is ready to ship.Make it repeatable: reusable templates and playbooks the team can pull from.

What You'll Bring On Day 1

Hands-on ownership of multiple channels. You have personally run the channels you're claiming. You didn't direct an agency to run them.Multi-touch programs measured on response. You've run outbound or lifecycle sequences across more than one channel, measured them on response or conversion, and can show how you decided what to change.Results you can point to. A program you built or scaled, with the starting number, what you changed, and where it ended up.Genuine fluency with current AI tooling. Your workflow should look materially different than it did six months ago. You choose deliberately between tools and can explain the reasoning, and you have automation doing real work on your behalf.Taste. You recognize strong messaging and design, and you can articulate why it works.Quantitative fluency. You decompose a funnel, design a fair test, and know when to stop investing in something.

What You'll Need To Learn Quickly

Our domain: prior authorization, benefit verification, and medication access, and why it matters to providers, pharmacies, and patients.How a provider office works: who opens the fax, who answers the phone, who handles prior authorizations, and what makes them act on a request from someone they don't know.Our product story: the proof points, and how to communicate them plainly and credibly.

Bonus Points

Early marketing hire at a high-growth health-tech or early-stage startup.Exposure to healthcare provider offices or pharmacy operations.Hands-on with SMS, direct mail, or other channels that reach busy offices outside email.

This Might Not Be The Right Fit If

You want to run brand or pipeline marketing full-time. You'll support top of funnel, but most of the job is provider activation, and it's measured on that number.You work primarily through agencies or a team. We need someone with direct, hands-on ownership of the channels they run.You use AI occasionally versus constantly. Our production speed depends on it.

What We Offer

Competitive base salary plus meaningful early-stage equity.High-end design and AI tooling (Figma, Notion, Claude Design, and more).Work that directly accelerates access to medication for hundreds of thousands of patients, with room to grow as the function scales.

Mill is a waste prevention technology company reimagining what it means to eliminate waste, starting with food. rows.title: Growth Marketing Lead
rows.descriptionText:
Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 2.5 million patients!

We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round.

About The Role

We're hiring a full-time Growth Marketing Lead to get provider offices responding to us the first time we reach them, and to support the top of our funnel.

When a pharmacy sends us a prescription that needs a prior authorization, we usually need something from the prescriber's office, most often the clinical notes. Many of those offices have never heard of us. We reach them by fax, email, and secure message to their EHR, and our calling team follows up by phone. Whether an office responds to that first contact decides how quickly a patient starts their medication.

You'll join our provider activation team, reporting to our Head of Provider Growth (to our CEO until that role is filled) and working alongside our calling, product, and engineering teams. You'll be our first dedicated marketing hire. Most of your time goes to one funnel, provider activation, and you'll own it end to end. The rest goes to top-of-funnel work with our sales team.

Three Things Define Success In This Role

You own the response rate. You own the faxes, emails, and secure messages we send offices the first time we need something from them: the copy, the timing, the channel mix for different kinds of offices, and the share of first-time offices that respond.You find what works and scale it. You run tests by channel and type of office, add new channels when the numbers support it, and stop what doesn't move response.You ship it yourself, AI-first. You go from an idea to a live test without a review committee. You produce the work personally, using AI tooling to move quickly, and you have the taste to know when something is good enough to go out.

You don't need a healthcare background, but you do need to pick up a complex domain quickly. Startup experience is a strong plus.

What You'll Do

Get first-time provider offices to respond

Own the faxes, emails, and secure messages that reach a provider office the first time we need something from it, and the response rate they produce.Decide timing, copy, and channel mix by type of office (practice size, specialty, history with us), using our outreach playbooks to run a mix and compare results.Work with our calling team so phone and digital touches work together on the same offices.

Test and grow channels

Run tests across channels and copy, read the results, and decide what to keep.Bring in new channels, like text messaging and HCP messaging networks, and run them against the same response number.Make Develop Health familiar to provider offices before our first request arrives, through the places they already look, like EHR marketplace listings and provider-facing pages.Work with product and engineering on what we track, so every response can be traced to the touch that earned it.

Support top of funnel (a smaller share of your time)

Run outbound and nurture campaigns that bring new pharma manufacturers, pharmacies and hubs into conversations with our sales team.

Ship the work

Produce the outreach itself: faxes, emails, messages, the pages offices land on, and leave-behinds for in-person visits.Work AI-first. Most production here is a matter of using the right tools well and knowing when the output is ready to ship.Make it repeatable: reusable templates and playbooks the team can pull from.

What You'll Bring On Day 1

Hands-on ownership of multiple channels. You have personally run the channels you're claiming. You didn't direct an agency to run them.Multi-touch programs measured on response. You've run outbound or lifecycle sequences across more than one channel, measured them on response or conversion, and can show how you decided what to change.Results you can point to. A program you built or scaled, with the starting number, what you changed, and where it ended up.Genuine fluency with current AI tooling. Your workflow should look materially different than it did six months ago. You choose deliberately between tools and can explain the reasoning, and you have automation doing real work on your behalf.Taste. You recognize strong messaging and design, and you can articulate why it works.Quantitative fluency. You decompose a funnel, design a fair test, and know when to stop investing in something.

What You'll Need To Learn Quickly

Our domain: prior authorization, benefit verification, and medication access, and why it matters to providers, pharmacies, and patients.How a provider office works: who opens the fax, who answers the phone, who handles prior authorizations, and what makes them act on a request from someone they don't know.Our product story: the proof points, and how to communicate them plainly and credibly.

Bonus Points

Early marketing hire at a high-growth health-tech or early-stage startup.Exposure to healthcare provider offices or pharmacy operations.Hands-on with SMS, direct mail, or other channels that reach busy offices outside email.

This Might Not Be The Right Fit If

You want to run brand or pipeline marketing full-time. You'll support top of funnel, but most of the job is provider activation, and it's measured on that number.You work primarily through agencies or a team. We need someone with direct, hands-on ownership of the channels they run.You use AI occasionally versus constantly. Our production speed depends on it.

What We Offer

Competitive base salary plus meaningful early-stage equity.High-end design and AI tooling (Figma, Notion, Claude Design, and more).Work that directly accelerates access to medication for hundreds of thousands of patients, with room to grow as the function scales.

rows.title: Research Scientist - Post-training / RL
rows.descriptionText:
About Us

Epsilon Health is transforming medical imaging and diagnostics by bringing frontier AI into clinical practice. We're tackling some of healthcare's most critical challenges, building technology that directly improves patient outcomes.

This year, we've served over 300,000 patients and now serve 3,000+ daily, working with some of the largest medical institutions in the U.S. By year-end we will interpret 1% of all daily U.S. X-rays.

Our research team brings experience from DeepMind and Meta, powered by one of the industry's most comprehensive proprietary medical imaging datasets, continuously enriched by real-world clinical data. Together, we're building a future where frontier AI helps save millions of lives today, not tomorrow.

Recently out of stealth, we're proudly backed by Jack Altman, Uncork Capital, Renegade Partners, and AlleyCorp, one of NYC's most active healthcare venture firms.

Role Overview

We're seeking a Research Scientist with deep expertise in post-training and reinforcement learning to join our ML Research team. You'll be at the forefront of developing and deploying state-of-the-art multimodal models for clinical use in radiology settings. This role owns every stage after pretraining: supervised fine-tuning, reward modeling, reinforcement learning against verifiable and learned reward signals, reasoning and tool-use training, and inference-time strategy. You'll work with one of the largest and most diverse medical imaging datasets in the industry, advancing the state-of-the-art in grounded report generation, reward design, and inference-time reasoning while maintaining the clinical rigor required for healthcare deployment.

Key Responsibilities

Design reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for report generation, including clinical label and entity-relation matching, grounding IoU, measurement accuracy, and reporting schema compliance. Extend reinforcement learning to unverifiable and noisy objectives such as report quality and clinical usefulness, using learned reward models and radiologist feedback pipelines (RLHF) built on expert preferences and report edits. Run GRPO-family algorithms with complex multi-reward objectives, tuning reward composition and diagnosing reward hacking, entropy collapse, and diversity loss. Train explicit reward models, including multimodal reward models conditioned on the image, with both outcome and process supervision. Train chain-of-thought reasoning over image regions, including evidence localization and verification loops that keep reasoning grounded in the image rather than in language priors. Train multimodal tool use — windowing, zoom and crop, detector and segmentation calls, prior study retrieval — with credit assignment across multi-turn trajectories. Develop inference-time methods including best-of-N sampling against reward models and grounding-aware decoding, and distill the resulting gains back into the policy. Tune output stylization to institutional reporting conventions, keeping style rewards separated from clinical content rewards. Stay current with cutting-edge research in reinforcement learning, reward modeling, and multimodal post-training. Drive research and technical excellence through conference publications and technical blog posts, establishing best practices for post-training medical VLMs at scale. 

Qualifications

2+ years of academia/industry experience in reinforcement learning, post-training, or multimodal machine learningDeep expertise in post-training large language or vision-language models (e.g., Qwen-VL, InternVL, LLaVA, or similar architectures)Strong foundation in modern post-training and reinforcement learning techniques including:Group-relative policy optimization and its successors (GRPO, DAPO, GSPO, CISPO) with multi-reward objectivesReinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, and with noisy, sparse, or learned reward signalsReward model training: pairwise and generative reward models, outcome and process supervisionPreference optimization methods (DPO, IPO, ORPO, KTO) and RLHFInference-time compute scaling, including best-of-N sampling and verifier-guided decodingPractical experience diagnosing and mitigating reward hacking and reward over-optimizationTrack record of implementing complex models from research papers and adapting them to new domainsProficiency in PyTorch or JAX, with experience training large models on multi-GPU/distributed systemsExperience with reinforcement learning infrastructure at scale, including rollout generation (vLLM, SGLang) and frameworks such as verl, TRL, or OpenRLHFExperience with autoregressive language modeling and instruction tuningStrong software engineering skills and ability to write production-quality code

Preferred Qualifications

Publications at top-tier conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, EMNLP, MICCAI)Hands-on experience with medical imaging applications, particularly radiology report generationExperience with agentic or multi-turn reinforcement learning, including credit assignment over tool-use trajectoriesExperience with grounded generation tasks (visual grounding, referring expression comprehension)Knowledge of evaluation methodologies for long-form generation, including factuality assessment and hallucination detectionExperience mitigating catastrophic forgetting of supervised capabilities during reinforcement learningFamiliarity with clinical NLP and medical knowledge representationExperience with model interpretability, explainability, and uncertainty quantification in safety-critical applications

LinkedIn is the world’s largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We’re also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that’s built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

 

Join us to transform the way the world works.



Job Description

This role will be based in San Francisco, New York or Chicago and is not eligible for sponsorship.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team. 

As a Sales Development Representative, you will assist in generating new business by qualifying inbound leads and driving various outbound campaigns but, more importantly, you will focus on the development of the individuals qualifying those leads. Sales Development roles exist in each of the LinkedIn divisions (see below). 

LinkedIn's Talent Solutions (talent.linkedin.com) help companies find and engage the best talent using the world's largest professional network. LinkedIn Talent Solutions provides innovative recruiting tools to help our customers become more successful at talent acquisition. 

LinkedIn Sales Solutions (sales.linkedin.com) help companies accelerate growth by connecting sellers to the world’s most dynamic buyer network. Our data‑driven, relationship‑first tools empower sales teams to engage the right decision‑makers to unlock opportunities, forge stronger customer relationships, and drive predictable revenue.

LinkedIn provides to the customers the opportunity to change the hiring and selling process, through our Corporate Solutions. As a Sales Development Representative, you will assist in generating new business opportunities by qualifying inbound leads and/or driving various outbound campaigns and creating the pipeline for the growing business in the region. 

What You'll Do: 

Qualify and develop inbound and/or outbound sales leads 

Run campaigns to generate new sales prospects 

Complete accurate tracking of communication with current and potential customers in SalesForce.com 

Work with the Account Executive team to design industry-specific outbound efforts and define the best strategy to approach new leads 

Schedule demonstrations between account executives and potential customers

High volume of calls with Decision Makers to identify the "pain", which could be addressed by LinkedIn Corporate Solutions 

Responsible for the majority of the Account Executive pipeline 



Qualifications

Minimum 1 year of experience in sales, business development, recruiting, lead generation or sales operations OR High School Diploma, General Educational Development (GED), or equivalent. 



Preferred Qualifications: 

Experience working with Salesforce.com or other CRM platforms 

Expert knowledge of MS Office (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and Excel) 

Excellent communication, interpersonal, organizational and telephone skills 

Ability to effectively manage time, prioritize tasks and work within deadlines with little supervision 

Ability to analyze business opportunities and read situations well 

Ability to gather and use data to inform decision making and persuade others 

Ability to develop compelling strategies that deliver results with a strong attention to detail 

Ability to work in a fast-paced, startup environment

Communication 

Negotiation 

Analytical skills

rows.title: Content Operations & Curation
rows.descriptionText:
About NewsBreak

Founded in 2015, NewsBreak is the Content Intelligence platform shaping the future content economy. With over 40 million monthly active users, our flagship platform delivers highly personalized local news and information powered by advanced AI, recommendation systems, and adtech.

Recognized by Fast Company as #32 on the Top Workplaces for Innovators, we're proud to be Great Place to Work® certified and home to a dynamic team of technologists, product innovators, and business leaders who are passionate about solving meaningful challenges at scale.

Together, we reached unicorn status in 2021, and we remain committed to continuing this high-growth trajectory with the right team to fulfill our mission: building the infrastructure layer for content intelligence.

If you’re inspired to dream big, innovate fast, and make a difference, we’d love to hear from you! For more information, visit www.newsbreak.com/about

About The Role

NewsBreak is building ReelBee, an open short-drama distribution platform where any qualified creator or studio can self-publish, earn a transparent revenue share, and get real US audience insights. This is a CEO-sponsored, company-level initiative. As a Content Operations & Curation specialist (Senior Specialist / Lead level), you will be the hands-on engine of our title-selection system: reviewing, tagging and queuing titles, running tests, and turning performance data into decisions. We are hiring 2 people for this role, in parallel in the SF Bay Area (Mountain View) and Beijing. Bilingual (English and Mandarin) required.

What You'll Do

Review and tag 40–60 new titles every week; verify AI-extracted tags (genre, character archetype, hook, paywall point, source tier) and judge quality and compliance, including common AI-drama issues such as lip-sync, hands and scene consistencyManage the weekly test queue: combine selection-system scores with your own judgment, track 72-hour scorecards (CTR, CPI, first-3-episode completion, unlock rate, first-purchase rate) and recommend which titles move to scaleRun post-launch operations for winning titles (recommendation slots, push, in-app distribution, creative direction); review performance and build a playbook of what works with our usersSend title-level and creative-level performance reports to content partners every week, collect their feedback and help steer supply directionSupport supply BD with sample evaluation and trial-batch review for new suppliers; maintain catalog metadata qualityTrack industry charts and TikTok short-drama trends; publish a weekly genre and hit-title brief, and calibrate your own picks against US charts and our performance data

What We're Looking For

2+ years of content operations, editorial, review or title-selection experience at a short-drama, web-fiction, short-video or content platform; short-drama platform experience (domestic or overseas) preferredHeavy short-drama viewer: familiar with top titles on ReelShort, DramaBox and similar apps, and able to quickly judge whether a title's hook, pacing and paywall design workData-savvy: read completion curves, drop-off episodes and payment conversion and turn them into operating actions; strong Excel/Sheets skills; BI dashboards or SQL a plusHigh throughput: keep judgment quality and pace at dozens of titles per weekFluent written and spoken English and Mandarin; able to review English-language series and subtitles and communicate with US partnersProficient with AI tools (LLM summarization/tagging, AI subtitles, AI voice detection) to raise efficiency

Nice to have

Short-drama acquisition, rights or distribution experienceTikTok/YouTube short-drama channel operations experienceAI short-drama production or QC experience

The US base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. Pay may vary based on a number of factors including job-related skills, level, experience, geographic location and relevant education or training. At NewsBreak, we design our overall rewards package to attract top talents. Depending on the position, the role may also be eligible for discretionary bonus and options. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

Annual Base Pay Range

$90,000 - $130,000 USD
