rows.title: AI-Native Data Associate - Energy Data
rows.descriptionText:
About Parisi Labs

Parisi Labs builds world models for physical industry, starting with power and energy markets. Products like Ask The Grid run on data that's large, messy, scattered and constantly changing.

The role

We're hiring an early-career data person who works natively with AI agents. You'll own the flow of data into our existing systems: sourcing it, ingesting it, cleaning it, keeping it accurate and extending it.

We aren't looking for someone who sometimes asks ChatGPT for help. We want someone whose default way of working is to direct agents: building and running agent-driven workflows that ingest, clean and reconcile data at scale, and using agents to explore and find new sources we didn't know existed.

What you'll own

Ingest at scale: Use agents and LLM-powered pipelines to pull data from filings, utility and ISO documents, PDFs, websites, APIs and spreadsheets, then structure it. Clean and reconcile: Normalize, de-duplicate, match entities and fix conflicts across sources, using automation instead of hand edits wherever possible. Maintain and extend our systems: Keep existing ingestion pipelines and data stores healthy, add new sources and fields, and fix what breaks. Explore and discover: Use agents to find new datasets and spot gaps, anomalies and patterns worth acting on. Verify everything: Build checks so AI-generated data can be traced back to its source and trusted. Speed is only useful if the data is right. 

What we're looking for

You've built or run agent-driven or LLM-powered data workflows (for example extraction, scraping, classification or entity matching), and you can show how you checked the output. You're comfortable working daily in tools like Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-connected agents or the OpenAI/Anthropic APIs. Working Python and SQL. You can read, write and debug pipeline code even when an agent drafted it. Strong judgment about data quality: you notice when something looks wrong and you go find out why. High agency and comfort with ambiguity. You'd rather build the tool than repeat the task. Students, recent grads and early-career people are encouraged to apply. 

Nice to have

Interest in energy, power markets or physical infrastructureExperience with Airflow, dbt or similar orchestration toolsStartup or self-directed project experience

How to apply

Share one example of real work you completed with AI agents or LLMs: what you built, how you ran it and how you verified the result. A link, repo or short write-up is fine. Finalists complete a short paid practical exercise, and using AI is encouraged.

Compensation & logistics

$65–85K salary (full-time) or $30–40/hr (part-time/contract)NYC or Boston/Cambridge, ~3 days/week onsiteMust be authorized to work in the US

rows.title: Senior Machine Learning Research Scientist
rows.descriptionText:
Use Your Power for Purpose

At Pfizer, our purpose is to deliver breakthroughs that transform patients' lives. Central to this mission is our Research and Development team, which strives to convert advanced science and cutting-edge technologies into impactful therapies and vaccines. Whether you are engaged in discovery sciences, ensuring drug safety and efficacy, or supporting clinical trials, your role is crucial. You will leverage innovative design and process development capabilities to expedite the delivery of top-tier medicines to patients globally.

Role Summary

Pfizer’s Machine Learning and Computational Sciences (MLCS) group is seeking a Senior Machine Learning Scientist to lead independent and collaborative research in computational antibody design and optimization. This position focuses on developing and applying modern computational and machine-learning approaches to accelerate the discovery of next-generation biologic therapeutics. Positioned at the intersection of machine learning, protein science, and therapeutic discovery, the role is ideal for candidates eager to translate foundational AI research into real-world drug design. It offers the opportunity to join an innovative, collaborative environment that supports professional growth through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and the freedom to pursue impactful science.

What You Will Achieve

In this role, you will:

Conduct original research in computational antibody engineering, with an emphasis on sequence- and structure-based generative modeling. Develop and deploy state-of-the-art machine-learning methods for multi-objective, constraint-aware antibody optimization that balances affinity, stability, and developability. Apply proprietary computational frameworks and machine-learning models to predict antibody developability and affinity. Leverage NGS-derived antibody repertoires to inform sequence- and structure-based rational design. Collaborate with computational and experimental researchers across diverse scientific disciplines to identify challenges and opportunities and integrate computational chemistry, molecular modeling, and AI—particularly recent advances in deep learning—to rapidly develop powerful computational solutions. Communicate and explain computational models and machine-learning algorithms to broad scientific audiences across diverse disciplines. Stay current with the relevant scientific literature and proactively identify, evaluate, and adopt promising external methods and tools. Enhance Pfizer’s external visibility and reputation for scientific excellence through publications in high-impact journals and presentations at scientific conferences. 

Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements):

Ph.D. in computational chemistry, the physical or biological sciences, chemical engineering, computer science, or a related discipline. Familiarity with the concepts, techniques, and commonly used tools for sequence analysis and protein structure modeling. Strong background in protein language models and structure-aware predictive and generative modeling. Proficiency in Python and modern scientific computing and machine-learning libraries (e.g., NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, and PyTorch), including model training and evaluation workflows. Experience with compute-intensive machine-learning workloads, including GPU acceleration, high-performance computing environments (e.g., Slurm), performance debugging, and reproducible experiment management. Demonstrated ability to conduct independent research and produce publication-quality scientific work. 

Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements):

Prior experience or demonstrated interest in antibody design or protein engineering.Experience fine‑tuning foundation models using small and biased datasets.Experience training and deploying models in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, or GCP). Strong publication record and demonstrated contribution to the machine learning field.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

The US Card Data Science organization at Capital One leverages our massive wealth of customer data to drive business strategy and deliver world-class customer experiences. Our team builds and deploys sophisticated data science and machine learning models across the entire credit card lifecycle—including marketing, acquisitions, underwriting, and fraud prevention. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. Technical. rows.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
rows.descriptionText:
The Winden Lab at Boston Children’s Hospital is focused on genetic causes of neurodevelopmental disorders. We use human induced pluripotent stem cells from patients with these genetic disorders to generate 2D and 3D neural models to study the underlying molecular, cellular, and circuit mechanisms of the disorder. We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral fellow to lead our studies of non-cell autonomous effects in Tuberous Sclerosis Complex, as well as other emerging neurogenetic disorders.
As a new lab, we are committed to developing an open and collaborative environment to perform cutting-edge science. You will have opportunities to contribute to the design and direction of studies, prepare manuscripts and grants, and mentor junior lab members at many stages. Boston Children's Hospital is a global leader in pediatric healthcare, and the Department of Neurology is the largest Child Neurology department in the country. Affiliated with Harvard Medical School, we provide an unparalleled environment for scientific advancement, fostering collaboration and innovation in pursuit of improving children's health worldwide.
Qualifications· PhD, MD/PhD, or MD with significant research experience· Expertise in molecular and cellular neuroscience techniques· Experience with human induced pluripotent stem cells and 2D and 3D neuronal differentiation· Experience in bioinformatics· Strong track record of prior publications and presentations· Ability to work independently and collaboratively· Excellent written and verbal communication skills

rows.title: Postdoctoral Scientist - Drug Delivery Experimental Fluid Dynamics
rows.descriptionText:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.

Organization Overview

Are you looking to make a significant difference by contributing to the field of pulmonary and nasal drug delivery through experimental fluid dynamics and tissue physiology?

Position Overview

We are seeking an ambitious post-doctoral scientist with strong research and communication skills to contribute to highly visible research projects. Experimental fluid dynamics (EFD) in drug delivery uses physical measurements, flow visualizations, and benchtop models to analyze how fluids and therapeutic particles transport, mix, and deposit inside biological systems or testing devices.

The Postdoctoral Scientist - Drug Delivery Experimental Fluid Dynamics sits at the intersection of pulmonary and nasal tissue physiology, inhaled formulation science, and experimental fluid dynamics, supporting the advancement of next-generation inhalation therapies. The successful candidate will work within a multidisciplinary team to characterize device performance through hands-on benchtop and physiologically representative experimental models, using computational tools to complement and extend those experimental findings — contributing directly to formulation design decisions and preclinical-to-clinical translation strategies.

Key Responsibilities

Design and execute in vitro aerosol characterization experiments using experimental fluid dynamics techniques — physical measurements, flow visualization, and benchtop models — on pulmonary and nasal device platforms, assessing droplet size distribution (laser diffraction, cascade impaction), delivered dose, and delivery efficiency.Apply working knowledge of pulmonary and nasal tissue physiology (airway and mucosal anatomy, mucus rheology, and regional structures relevant to deposition and clearance) to design physiologically representative benchtop and ex vivo experimental models, accounting for anatomical variability and its effects on precision and targeting.Apply and interpret existing computational fluid dynamics (CFD) or physiologically based pharmacokinetic/deposition (PBPK/PBPD) models — including uncertainty quantification and sensitivity analysis — to complement experimental data and predict regional aerosol deposition and IVIVC linkages (MMAD, FPF, delivered dose to in vivo or PK/PD endpoints) across patient-representative airway geometries.Collaborate with formulation scientists, device engineers, and translational scientists to integrate experimental and physiological findings into formulation optimization, design space definition, and actionable insights.Communicate findings through internal technical reports, cross-functional presentations, and peer-reviewed publications, and participate in structured mentorship and professional development programming within Lilly’s postdoctoral research community. 


Basic Qualifications

rows.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow- Molecular mechanisms of aging and accelerated aging in the human brain
rows.descriptionText:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Position Overview

The Mavrikaki Lab at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (BIDMC) and Harvard Medical School is seeking a highly motivated and creative junior Postdoctoral Research Fellow to lead high-impact studies investigating the molecular mechanisms driving brain aging and cognitive decline.

Our laboratory integrates spatial transcriptomics, multi-omic approaches, advanced molecular biology, and in vivo mouse models to resolve key pathways underlying brain aging. Building upon our recent landmark work—including spatial transcriptomic and microRNA atlases of the adult lifespan human prefrontal cortex—the successful candidate will drive research exploring how specific cell populations regulate age-related cognitive function.

Key Responsibilities

 Multi-Omics & Molecular Profiling: Design and execute multi-omic pipelines (including spatial transcriptomics and bulk RNA-seq) alongside targeted tissue validation assays (RNAscope, RT-qPCR, immunohistochemistry). In Vivo Rodent Studies: Lead rodent research utilizing stereotaxic viral deliveries, targeted manipulations, and behavioral phenotyping focused on cognitive assessment. In Vitro Target Validation: Contribute to the design of cell-based assays to functionally validate candidate molecular targets. Leadership & Mentorship: Collaborate across interdisciplinary teams, mentor junior laboratory members, and take a primary role in manuscript preparation, data presentation, and grant development.

Qualifications & Requirements

 Education: Ph.D. in Neuroscience, Molecular Biology, or a closely related discipline. 0-2 years of postdoctoral research experience. Technical Expertise:Required: Strong foundational expertise in molecular biology techniques.Highly Preferred: Direct experience with rodent stereotaxic surgeries, and aging research.Preferred: Experience with in situ tissue analysis (RNAscope/spatial assays) or multi-omic datasets. Track Record: First-author publication record in peer-reviewed journals demonstrating productivity, critical thinking, and rigorous scientific execution. Professional Attributes: Exceptional written and verbal communication, strong organizational capabilities, and a collaborative mindset tailored to an interdisciplinary research environment.

What We Offer

 Vibrant Environment: Direct integration into a dynamic, well-funded research system at BIDMC and Harvard Medical School. Affiliation with both BIDMC and Harvard Medical School. Cutting-Edge Resources: Access to state-of-the-art core facilities, human tissue resources, advanced spatial transcriptomics infrastructure and bioinformatics support. Career Development: Personalized mentorship dedicated to scientific independence, fellowship application preparation, and career trajectory planning.

Job Description

Primary Responsibilities:

 Abides by the institutional policies of BIDMC relating to health and safety, equality of opportunity and data storage and management. (essential) As a member of the research team, actively pursues research under the supervision of a principal investigator while developing skills for independent work. (essential) Receives training in and performs duties contributing to the investigational work of the team including formulation of research questions and design, conduct of experiments, and evaluation of results. (essential) Prepares and publishes scientific manuscripts under direction of PI. (essential) Develops expertise in desired lab skills/informatics/ physics/clinical research. Develops proficiency with research tools and equipment. Develops ability to work with more independence as the fellowship progresses (essential) Develops new ideas that promote current research; brings new expertise to the research program. (essential) teaching skills and provide supervision of students and their projects when appropriate. (essential) Engages in collaborative meetings with other research groups. Attends and leads scientific seminars. (essential) Learns to identify, acknowledge and correct deficiencies in one's own performance. (essential) Under the direction of PI, pursues/secures independent funding near the end of the fellowship. (essential)

Required Qualifications

Doctoral Degree or M.D.0-1 year of postdoctoral research experience in academic or industrial lab setting, and/or teaching assistantship in a university setting, and/or residency, and/or clinical duties beyond that of the qualifying doctoral degree.

Competencies

Decision Making: Ability to make decisions that are guided by general instructions and practices requiring some interpretation. May make recommendations for solving problems of moderate complexity and importance.

Problem Solving: Ability to address problems that are varied, requiring analysis or interpretation of the situation using direct observation, knowledge and skills based on general precedents.

Independence of Action: Ability to follow precedents and procedures. May set priorities and organize work within general guidelines. Seeks assistance when confronted with difficult and/or unpredictable situations. Work progress is monitored by supervisor/manager.

Written Communications: Ability to summarize and communicate in English moderately complex information in varied written formats to internal and external customers.

Oral Communications: Ability to comprehend and communicate complex verbal information in English to medical center staff, patients, families and external customers.

Knowledge: Ability to demonstrate in-depth knowledge of concepts, practices and policies with the ability to use them in complex varied situations.

Team Work: Ability to lead collaborative teams for larger projects or groups both internal and external to the Medical Center and across functional areas. Results have implications for the management and operations of multiple areas of the organization.

Customer Service: Ability to provide a high level of customer service and staff training to meet customer service standards and expectations for the assigned unit(s). Resolves service issues in the assigned unit(s) in a timely and respectful manner.

Physical Nature Of The Job

Light work: Exerting up to 20 pounds of force frequently to move objects. Some elements of the job are sedentary, but the employee will be required to stand for periods of time or move throughout the hospital campus.

Pay Range

$60,000.00 USD - $75,564.00 USD

Actual compensation is determined based on several factors, that may include seniority, education, training, relevant experience, relevant certifications, geography of work location, job responsibilities, or other applicable factors permissible by law.

rows.title: AI-Native Data Associate - Energy Data
rows.descriptionText:
About Parisi Labs

Parisi Labs builds world models for physical industry, starting with power and energy markets. Products like Ask The Grid run on data that's large, messy, scattered and constantly changing.

The role

We're hiring an early-career data person who works natively with AI agents. You'll own the flow of data into our existing systems: sourcing it, ingesting it, cleaning it, keeping it accurate and extending it.

We aren't looking for someone who sometimes asks ChatGPT for help. We want someone whose default way of working is to direct agents: building and running agent-driven workflows that ingest, clean and reconcile data at scale, and using agents to explore and find new sources we didn't know existed.

What you'll own

Ingest at scale: Use agents and LLM-powered pipelines to pull data from filings, utility and ISO documents, PDFs, websites, APIs and spreadsheets, then structure it. Clean and reconcile: Normalize, de-duplicate, match entities and fix conflicts across sources, using automation instead of hand edits wherever possible. Maintain and extend our systems: Keep existing ingestion pipelines and data stores healthy, add new sources and fields, and fix what breaks. Explore and discover: Use agents to find new datasets and spot gaps, anomalies and patterns worth acting on. Verify everything: Build checks so AI-generated data can be traced back to its source and trusted. Speed is only useful if the data is right. 

What we're looking for

You've built or run agent-driven or LLM-powered data workflows (for example extraction, scraping, classification or entity matching), and you can show how you checked the output. You're comfortable working daily in tools like Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-connected agents or the OpenAI/Anthropic APIs. Working Python and SQL. You can read, write and debug pipeline code even when an agent drafted it. Strong judgment about data quality: you notice when something looks wrong and you go find out why. High agency and comfort with ambiguity. You'd rather build the tool than repeat the task. Students, recent grads and early-career people are encouraged to apply. 

Nice to have

Interest in energy, power markets or physical infrastructureExperience with Airflow, dbt or similar orchestration toolsStartup or self-directed project experience

How to apply

Share one example of real work you completed with AI agents or LLMs: what you built, how you ran it and how you verified the result. A link, repo or short write-up is fine. Finalists complete a short paid practical exercise, and using AI is encouraged.

Compensation & logistics

$65–85K salary (full-time) or $30–40/hr (part-time/contract)NYC or Boston/Cambridge, ~3 days/week onsiteMust be authorized to work in the US

rows.title: AI Foundations - Software Engineer - Research Internship 2027
rows.descriptionText:
Introduction

Join the pioneering AI Foundations Research team at IBM Research and contribute to shaping the future foundations of artificial intelligence. Our group of scientists, engineers, and designers is dedicated to conducting end-to-end research that delivers real-world AI impact through a rigorous, responsible, and open innovation framework. We are the team behind IBM's Granite open-source models, and our work spans multi-modal (vision, speech, language, code) and multi-lingual systems, data quality, data generation, novel model architectures, training recipes, governance and trustworthiness, and programming models for interacting with models. As an intern, you will explore cutting-edge research areas, including new algorithms for training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and inference time scaling, alongside pioneering work in generative computing and generative programming for language, code, and other modalities, all within a collaborative environment that bridges fundamental science and transformative engineering.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an AI Software Engineer Intern, you will engage in the full research lifecycle to pioneer new advancements in artificial intelligence. Your role will involve identifying core challenges, designing novel prototype solutions, and validating them through rigorous experimentation. You will develop the robust, scalable infrastructure that powers cutting-edge AI research. Collaborating in small, expert-led teams, you will drive projects from concept to completion — transforming novel algorithms into high-performance, reusable code within modern, distributed frameworks, while contributing to IBM's open innovation initiatives.

High School Diploma/GED

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

As part of the US Card data science organization, this team focuses on the customer management business, and builds top tier machine learning solutions to meet the various needs such as real-time customer behavioral prediction and valuation forecasts. rows.title: GTM Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
MarginEdge is hiring an Analyst to build out go-to-market analytics: pipeline and conversion reporting, coverage and capacity modeling, commission calculation, and the analysis leadership uses to decide where to put money and headcount.

The enticing part of this role is that you own the whole path. You'll help frame the question, write the SQL, build the model, put it in source control, and present the answer — and the version you build is the one the company keeps using. There's no analytics team you hand a spec to. That's the trade: you have to be technical enough to build it, and you get to skip the six weeks of translation.

You'll report to the Director of Data Platform and Analytics and sit inside the data team, with Revenue Operations as your primary stakeholder. Your work gets reviewed by people who care whether the model is sound, and your roadmap comes from what the revenue organization actually needs. You'll work regularly with the Director of Revenue Operations, the CRO, and FP&A — more direct exposure to how revenue decisions get made than this kind of role usually carries.

We care much more about how you think and what you can build than where you've worked. Consulting, finance, RevOps, a BI seat at a smaller company, a science or engineering background you've since pointed at data problems — all fine.

MarginEdge: Where hospitality meets technology

As a team built by former (and current!) restaurant operators, our mission is to bring operators the same energy, attention to detail, and passion that they bring to their guests. Our culture is deeply rooted in service, partially because that’s where so many of our team come from (including everyone on our Business Development team), but also because we believe it is just the right way to run a business. We design our software with profound empathy for the complexity of running a restaurant, and the goal of making the magic just a little easier for operators by taking the complex (read: very annoying) back office tasks off their plate, while empowering them with real-time data.

Our founders share a deep history in both owning and operating restaurants and in building successful tech companies. We are venture-backed and serve 12,000+ restaurants across the US and Canada.

We enable restaurants to make magic while knowing we are doing the same for them.

We have the utmost respect for our clients and because of this, we are unable to hire their current employees.

What type of responsibilities will I have?

Build the analysis that decides things.

Build the analysis behind weekly pipeline reviews, forecast reviews, monthly business reviews, and sales board reporting, and take over more of it as you ramp.Own stage-to-stage conversion reporting: conversion rates, cycle times, and win rates by channel, team, segment, and product.Build assumption-based models for strategic initiatives — new segments, pricing changes, channel bets — with the assumptions parameterized rather than buried in a formula.Help run and extend the coverage and capacity models: work the revenue target back to the pipeline and headcount required, and flag the gap early enough that leadership can act on it.Contribute to the pipeline-based bottoms-up forecast and its reconciliation against the sales team commitment and the top-down model.Investigate the unglamorous questions — why a cohort converted worse than the one before it, why cycle time moved in one segment and not another — and bring them to leadership before you're asked.

Build the thing that answers them next quarter.

Build and maintain the GTM layer of our dbt project: funnel and conversion models, pipeline history, rep and territory attribution.Ship through source control — branch, pull request, review, tests, documentation. Your code gets reviewed, and eventually you'll review other people's.Reconcile Salesforce, subscription billing, and product usage data, and become the person who can explain precisely why they disagree when they do.Help define GTM metrics in our semantic layer, with RevOps as the metric owner, so self-service and agent-based querying return governed numbers rather than someone's best guess.

Use AI as a real tool and check its work.

Use Claude for query drafting, model scaffolding, and analysis iteration, and help RevOps stakeholders get useful work out of it.QA AI output seriously: know what the query actually did, catch the plausible-but-wrong answer, and be able to explain the mechanism behind a finding rather than repeating it.

What qualifications or skills are required?

Demonstrated professional experience doing analytical work where you were expected to structure some of the problem yourself, not just execute a spec.Strong SQL. CTEs, joins, and window functions should be comfortable. More importantly, when a query returns a number that looks wrong, you find out why rather than running it again.Working knowledge of source control — branches, commits, pull requests. You don't need to have worked on a large codebase, but if your instinct is to build in a shared spreadsheet, this role will frustrate you.Enough curiosity about how data gets where it is to reason about where a number came from and when it last landed. You won't own ingestion.Real spreadsheet skill. A lot of what you produce lands in Excel in front of an executive, and you should be able to build a multi-tab model someone else can follow and extend.The ability to say the number is wrong to a room that would prefer it weren't, and an obsession with accuracy that survives deadline pressure.Funnel and SaaS metrics: conversion rate, pipeline coverage, cycle time, gross and net retention, CAC, payback. If you already know what breaks each one, great. If not, you'll learn them here, and you should be able to explain them by month three.

Nice To Haves

dbt — Core, project structure, tests, macros. If you've built tested, version-controlled transformation logic some other way, say so.Trino/Athena or Snowflake. We're mid-migration, so you'd see both.Python for the analysis SQL shouldn't do.Salesforce as a data source, including the parts of it that lie to you.Subscription billing data (Zuora or similar), quota setting, territory design, or sales compensation modeling.Semantic or metrics layer experience (MetricFlow, Cube, or similar).BI development in Preset/Superset, Looker, Tableau, or comparable.

Compensation: The anticipated salary range for this role is $90,000–$110,000 annually. Where a candidate falls within that range depends on a variety of factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus opportunities and our comprehensive benefits package.

What’s it like to work for MarginEdge? 

Imagine the fun of a great restaurant - surrounded by a team of people (including some that you help to manage!) who care about hospitality, care about quality, and care about each other - then subtract the long nights, weekends, drunk customers at the bar...et voila, MarginEdge!

We work hard, we work fast and we fuel our work with a commitment of transparency from leadership, straight talk and trust between teams. We believe that the best people do their best work when they feel empowered - so whether you are remote or in our office (likely eating a catered lunch from our clients in our baller, brand new penthouse HQ in Ballston) you get to work with your manager to call your shot on what works best for you. Did we mention it has a full commercial kitchen and is walking distance (covered walking, that is) from the metro?

Benefits (Shut The Front Door, They Are Amazing)

In order to fuel this rocket ship, we need to build a team as passionate about our work and product as we are. We believe that top talent (that’s you!) should feel deeply connected to their work, appreciated for the time they give to building our organization and have the balance necessary to give their best during work hours and all those after-hours too. We do this by offering a suite of kick ass benefits not only to be competitive and catch the eye of super smart people (that’s you again!) but also provide the foundation for a career you love and a life outside of work you love just as much.

Unlimited Paid Time Off (and we mean it, we encourage your healthy work life balance!)Medical, Dental, Vision, and Short/Long-Term Disability Insurance (preventative care for the win)Health Savings Account with employer match (dependent upon your medical plan selection)Commuter benefits with employer contribution (excluding limos and helos - for now)Generous Life Insurance PlanShort- and Long-term DisabilityCompany-Paid Holidays401(k) and matchingStock Options to buy into everything we are doing to support this industry12-week fully Paid Parental LeaveLunch catered twice a week at our HQ in Arlington (we exclusively cater from our clients, too!A wellness program that sponsors healthy activities such as step challenges and provides discounts to gyms and fitness classes.

Check out our 100% “Recommend to a Friend” rating from anonymous employee reviews on Glassdoor.

Oh, and our recognition in the Washington Post as a top small businesses to work for in 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025!

And most important, what our customers think about our work on Capterra and G2 Crowd.

Our Fine Print is Bold: We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran, marital, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. You be you. While we are proudest of our commitment to exceptional culture and creating a truly excellent work environment, we see our benefits as an extension of that belief. Our benefits package is designed to be exceptionally competitive and a reflection of our commitment to a best-in-class workplace for all.

As a team built by former (and current!) restaurant operators, our goal to bring our clients the same energy, attention to detail and passion that they give their guests. Our culture is deeply rooted in service—partially because that’s where we came from but also because we believe it's the right way to run a business. We design our software with profound empathy for the complexity of running a restaurant.

Our dream is to make the magic just a little easier for operators and their teams. We believe in crazy things like knowing how much waste your kitchen is producing and what your total spend is during the period. Solving these kinds of problems is really freaking hard to do, which is why we develop cutting-edge technology that answers these questions with data science.

rows.descriptionText:
The Opportunity

As a SAP Order to Cash Consultant, Senior Associate, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize their customer relationship management processes within our SAP practice. You will analyze client requirements, implement CRM software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilization of SAP CRM applications. As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client connections and learning how to manage and inspire others. You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and enhancing your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions and embracing ambiguity as opportunities for growth.

In this role at PwC, you will leverage your skills to respond effectively to diverse perspectives and needs, using a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems. You will develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving, interpreting data to inform insights and recommendations. Upholding professional and technical standards, you will contribute to the firm's code of conduct and independence requirements, all while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

Responsibilities

 Analyzing client requirements to implement SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) solutions effectively Managing the integration and utilization of SAP CRM applications to optimize customer relationship processes Providing training and support to clients for seamless adoption of SAP CRM systems Collaborating with clients to enhance customer satisfaction and achieve strategic objectives Utilizing analytical thinking to break down complex concepts and inform insights and recommendations Developing business process improvements and modeling to enhance operational efficiency Building meaningful client connections and anticipating the needs of teams and clients Navigating complex situations to grow personal brand and deepen technical skills Upholding professional and technical standards in alignment with the firm's code of conduct Leveraging business technology and CRM software to drive customer engagement and loyalty

What You Must Have

 At least a Bachelor's degree At least 2 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

 Preference for a Master's or Masters of Business Administration degree in at least one of the following fields of study: Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems Demonstrating proficiency in SAP Cloud for Customer and SAP CRM Utilizing analytical thinking for business process improvement Engaging in customer relationship management and customer satisfaction Applying business technology skills to enhance client solutions Managing deployment and design implementation projects Excelling in customer needs analysis and customer engagement strategies

rows.descriptionText:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.



Job Description

This role will be based in Manassas, VA. 

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is on-site, meaning it will be performed in the specified office on a full-time basis due to the business needs of the team.

This role may require working evening or overnight shifts (3:00 PM - 12:00 AM or 11:00 PM - 8:00 AM).

The Associate Data Center Hardware Engineer is a hands-on technical role focused on ensuring the reliability and performance of LinkedIn's global infrastructure. This position is responsible for executing hardware break-fix activities, providing advanced troubleshooting support, and serving as an escalation point for contracted data center technicians. In addition to performing direct repair work, the role partners with vendors, mentors contract staff, and drives consistency in service delivery across all LinkedIn data center operations.

Responsibilities:

Perform break-fix repairs, including but not limited to replacing failed drives, DIMMs, fans, power supplies, and other server or network hardware components. Troubleshoot and resolve escalated issues from contracted technicians, applying diagnostics and escalating unresolved issues to Data Center Hardware Engineers or LinkedIn engineering teams as needed. Instal new SSD's and NVME's into existing servers. Conduct basic Linux OS and IPMI-level troubleshooting across all server platformsAssist LinkedIn engineers with troubleshooting and resolving autobuild (Linux Kickstart) failures, including - straggler- nodes. Diagnose and resolve physical-layer network connectivity issues. Execute hardware installations and repairs outside the scope of planned quarterly organic growth projects. Actively monitor and engage with the Jira ticket queue, ensuring proper ticket handling and quality resolution by contracted data center technicians. Participate in onboarding new contracted data center technicians, including training on daily operational tasks. Serve as a technical mentor for contracted data center technicians, providing training and guidance to improve quality and consistency. Participate in an on-call rotation to support global data center operations. 

Qualifications

1+ years in a Data Center Engineering Role1+ years of Linux troubleshooting experience1+ years of server hardware troubleshooting experience

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent industry experience. 2+ years in a Data Center Engineering Role2+ years Linux troubleshooting experience. 2+ years server hardware troubleshooting experience.

Hardware Deployment & InstallationProject ManagementTicketing Systems (Jira, ServiceNow)Linux/UnixServer and Network Troubleshooting

rows.title: Vulnerability Research Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
At Two Six Technologies, we build, deploy, and implement innovative products that solve the world’s most complex challenges today. Through unrivaled collaboration and unwavering trust, we push the boundaries of what’s possible to empower our team and support our customers in building a safer global future.

Overview Of Opportunity

We are seeking a Vulnerability Research Analyst to conduct software security evaluations using state-of-the-art AI evaluation harnesses. This position focuses purely on analyzing extracted source code and compiled binaries from specialized COTS/GOTS systems, evaluating automated vulnerability-finding performance, and assessing system resilience without needing direct hardware-level manipulation.

Key Responsibilities & Duties

Perform static and dynamic software vulnerability analysis on pre-extracted COTS/GOTS source code repositories and firmware images.Deploy AI-guided fuzzing and automated vulnerability detection suites to evaluate complex software architectures and identify high-risk logic flaws.Validate automated tool output by tracing execution paths in code to determine root causes and real-world exploitability.Develop custom CodeQL queries, Semgrep rules, and Abstract Syntax Tree (AST)-based detection signatures to codify newly discovered bug patterns and automate regression testing across software evaluations.Present vulnerability perspectives, risk assessments, and testing metrics to program managers, stakeholders, and intelligence community partners.

Qualifications & Skills

Active US Security Clearance of Top Secret/SCI with polygraphDegree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Security, or equivalent practical experience.Experience in vulnerability research, static source code analysis, reverse engineering, or software security audits.Solid understanding of memory management, pointer arithmetic, and common software security flaws in compiled and managed languages.Familiarity with automated static/dynamic code analysis concepts and AI-driven automation tools.

Nice to Have

Experience authoring or tuning custom static analysis rules using CodeQL, Semgrep, or Tree-sitter parsers.Familiarity with firmware emulation tools and frameworks (e.g., QEMU, Unicorn Engine, Avatar2, or Ghidra/IDA emulator plugins) to run extracted binaries without physical hardware.Experience creating or adapting custom test drivers, stubs, and harness interfaces for unit-level software execution.Knowledge of machine learning applications in automated bug discovery, symbolic execution, or AI-assisted code analysis.Prior experience delivering technical vulnerability assessments on DoD or IC defense programs.

Clearance Requirements

Active US Security Clearance of Top Secret/SCI with polygraph.Must be willing to obtain and maintain a Polygraph clearance.

rows.descriptionText:
RELOCATION ASSISTANCE: Relocation assistance may be available

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes

CLEARANCE TYPE: Secret

TRAVEL: Yes, 50% of the Time

Description

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history - from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.

Northrop Grumman Defense Systems has an immediate opening for a Senior Manager to lead Business Development Operations and Customer Engagement Coordination. Location in the Mclean, VA Northrop Grumman Defense Systems site. Considerable travel is required.

Reporting directly to the Director of Strategy and Market Development, for the C2 and Weapons Integration Division, this individual serves as the central lead of team operations and is responsible for establishing and implementing processes to support global capture and business development, coordinates senior customer engagement, assists in development of communications and messaging, as well as serves as a point of contact in cross-functional support. This individual often serves as the Delegate of Authority for the Director at executive level meetings and reviews.

Primary Roles And Responsibilities Include

Capture and Business Development Support

Support business opportunity pipeline by developing and updating Salesforce dashboards and graphics to communicate the business pipeline’s healthConduct analysis and assessments of business opportunity pipeline and make recommendations for improving capture and win ratesAssist in development of presentations and coordination of inputs across the strategy, business development, and capture teamsLeads and coordinates contributions to internal reviews such as Corporate, Sector, and Division Monthly Pipeline Reviews, Capture Health and update reviews, priority win reviewsMaintain awareness of significant policy, program, budget and legislative initiatives effecting corporate goals

Customer Engagement Planning and Preparations

Coordinate, integrate and synchronize division customer engagements in alignment with sector and corporate customer engagement processPrior to customer engagements, ensure senior leaders are prepared with meeting objectives, background, talking points, and logistical details.Assist in planning trade show participation and sponsorship, customer engagements, logistics, and preparation.Ensure division customer engagements are captured in Salesforce with appropriate notes in accordance with NG policy.Support division, sector, and corporate teams in the design, construction and execution of customer analysis plans, strategic customer approach plans, and customer contact plans.

Communications and Messaging

Assists in the development of strategic communications and messaging to customersCreate presentations to articulate processes and plans for the teamHelp develop annual team strategic goals and objectives and present to broader team

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree with 8 years of experience related to Department of War (DoW) business or programs; or Master's Degree with 6 years of experience related to Department of War (DoW) business or programs.The ability to analyze a broad range of issues, and a demonstrated ability in strategic thinking to best influence senior DoW civilian and military decision-makersExperience communicating clearly and succinctly salient details of complex subjects to a senior audienceBusiness development, capture, or technical experienceKnowledge of DoW acquisition, requirements, and budget policies and processesStrong Salesforce and Tableau skills—specifically with dashboard creation and Salesforce data analysisActive Secret Clearance

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in Business Development or government relations related roleIntegrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD) and/or Command and Control (C2) domain, program, or operational experience10 years of experience related to Department of War (DoW) programsKnowledgeable in Customer Relationships Management (CRM) tools (e.g. Salesforce)Proven success with leading project teams or peopleExperience working in a matrix organization or environmentActive Top Secret clearance

Primary Level Salary Range: $175,400.00 - $263,200.00

The above salary range represents a general guideline; however, Northrop Grumman considers a number of factors when determining base salary offers such as the scope and responsibilities of the position and the candidate's experience, education, skills and current market conditions.

Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results. Employees in Vice President or Director positions may be eligible for Long Term Incentives. In addition, Northrop Grumman provides a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, Company paid holidays and paid time off (PTO) for vacation and/or personal business.

Privately held by the Taylor family of St. Louis, Enterprise Mobility together with its affiliate Enterprise Fleet Management manages a diverse fleet of 2.4 million vehicles through a network of more than 9,500 fully-staffed neighborhood and airport rental locations in more than 90 countries and territories.

Seek to improve job performance through self-assessment, skill development, training and goal settingMaintain a regular and reliable level of attendance and punctualityPerform miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned

rows.title: Deputy Chief Engineer Network (Government)
rows.descriptionText:
This is a full-time onsite role based in the location(s) posted and is performed from the designated work location five days per week. No relocation is offered.

AT&T is seeking a Deputy Chief Engineer, Network to provide senior technical expertise supporting the architecture, engineering, integration, and evolution of complex enterprise network and communications solutions for a large-scale federal program.

In this role, you will work closely with the Chief Engineer and multidisciplinary engineering teams to define and maintain end-to-end network architecture, engineering standards, and technology roadmaps across WAN, LAN, transport, cloud connectivity, and software-defined networking environments. You will help ensure network solutions are secure, resilient, scalable, interoperable, and capable of supporting mission-critical operational requirements.

Job Duties/Responsibilities

 Define and evolve end-to-end network architectures, engineering standards, and technology roadmaps across WAN, LAN, transport, cloud, and software-defined networking environments. Architect and integrate SD-WAN solutions, including overlays, underlays, routing, segmentation, policy, orchestration, and secure connectivity. Translate customer, operational, and technical requirements into network architecture, engineering requirements, interface definitions, and implementation strategies. Support the Chief Engineer in establishing network technical direction, engineering standards, architectural principles, and design approaches. Develop standardized network designs, configurations, engineering patterns, and implementation approaches while accommodating site-specific operational and technical requirements. Engineer highly available and resilient network solutions addressing redundancy, diversity, failover, performance, capacity, scalability, and recoverability. Evaluate network architecture alternatives and conduct technical trade studies involving performance, resiliency, security, interoperability, cost, and lifecycle considerations. Develop network migration and transition strategies that minimize operational risk and support modernization of existing infrastructure. Provide technical oversight through high-level and detailed design, integration, test, implementation, migration, and transition to operations. Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to incorporate network security, segmentation, access control, encryption, and applicable security requirements into solution designs. Partner with systems, cloud, transport, infrastructure, operations, and test engineering teams to ensure end-to-end interoperability and design integrity. Establish network capacity and performance requirements and support performance analysis, optimization, and troubleshooting. Review network designs, configurations, engineering documentation, interface definitions, test procedures, and vendor/OEM solutions for technical completeness and architectural alignment. Provide senior technical expertise during network implementation, troubleshooting, performance degradation, and resolution of complex incidents and engineering issues. Evaluate emerging networking technologies, product lifecycle considerations, capacity demands, and technology obsolescence to support long-term network modernization. Partner with test and evaluation teams to ensure all technical solutions are fully tested, verified, and validated against applicable system, design, performance, interface, security, and operational requirements prior to deployment or operational acceptance. Support execution of all applicable Contractor Master Test Plan (CMTP) activities, including test planning, readiness reviews, requirements traceability, test procedure development, defect resolution, regression testing, results analysis, documentation, and closure of technical test findings.

Required Clearance

Customer Specific Clearance (#clearable)

Required Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related technical field. Experience in network engineering, network architecture, telecommunications engineering, or a related technical discipline. Demonstrated experience designing and architecting complex WAN, LAN, SD-WAN, transport, and enterprise network solutions. Strong knowledge of IP networking, routing protocols, network segmentation, resiliency, high availability, traffic engineering, and network performance. Hands-on experience designing and integrating SD-WAN architectures, including underlay and overlay networks, routing, policies, orchestration, and secure connectivity. Experience developing and reviewing network architectures, high-level and detailed designs, configurations, engineering standards, and technical documentation. Demonstrated experience integrating network solutions across multiple technology platforms, service providers, OEMs, and engineering disciplines. Experience with network capacity planning, performance analysis, troubleshooting, and optimization in large-scale environments. Strong understanding of network security principles and the integration of security requirements into enterprise network architectures. Ability to evaluate complex technical alternatives and provide engineering recommendations based on performance, resiliency, scalability, security, interoperability, and lifecycle requirements. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex network architectures and technical decisions to engineering teams, program leadership, customers, and other stakeholders.

Desired Qualifications

 Experience supporting large-scale federal government, telecommunications, or mission-critical networking programs. Experience designing geographically distributed, highly available enterprise WAN environments. Experience with multiple enterprise networking and SD-WAN technologies and OEM platforms. Knowledge of carrier transport services, diverse connectivity, cloud connectivity, and hybrid networking architectures. Experience with network automation, orchestration, monitoring, performance management, and observability platforms. Experience supporting formal engineering lifecycle activities including requirements analysis, design reviews, integration, verification and validation, test, implementation, and operational readiness. Experience developing migration strategies for large-scale network modernization or technology refresh efforts. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

Our Deputy Chief Engineer Network's earn between $143,700 - $276,900. Not to mention all the other amazing rewards that working at AT&T offers. Individual starting salary within this range may depend on geography, experience, expertise, and education/training.

rows.title: Systems Administrator
rows.descriptionText:
Are you ready to shape the future of IT? Join Integris, where integrity meets innovation, and people come first.

At Integris, we don’t just offer jobs, we offer purpose. As a nationally recognized Best Places to Work and a leader in future-ready managed services, we’re redefining how businesses experience IT. Our mission is bold: to empower clients and employees alike through secure, strategic, and scalable technology solutions.

We’re looking for talent that thrives in a culture of clarity, trust, and relentless execution, individuals who believe that IT is not just support, but a strategic advantage. If you’re passionate about innovation, driven by impact, and ready to grow with a company that puts People First, you’ll find your place here.

Job Summary

The Systems Administrator is responsible for administering and supporting desktop, server, networking, virtualization, Microsoft 365, and cloud infrastructure environments while maintaining security best practices. This role provides advanced technical support, addresses escalated issues, and supports the stability and performance of client environments across multiple technologies.

The Systems Administrator serves as the first escalation point beyond the Systems Technician level and is responsible for resolving complex issues efficiently and effectively. This position may execute responsibilities from the service desk, the field, a client site, an Integris office, or a remote home office depending on business and client needs.

This position could participate in an on-call rotation supporting critical systems and operations outside normal business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Participation, availability during assigned periods, and timely response to urgent incidents are essential functions of the role.

The Systems Administrator is expected to provide exceptional customer service through phone, email, remote, and onsite support. This position also plays a critical role in assisting clients, sharing knowledge, mentoring Systems Technicians, and contributing to documentation and process improvement efforts.

Job Responsibilities

Ticket Management

Work assigned tickets in order of SLA.Assess, plan, troubleshoot, and resolve administrator-level issues efficiently and effectively to ensure minimal disruption to customer operations.Serve as the primary escalation resource for the Systems Technician technical team, providing guidance and expertise to resolve complex issues efficiently.Support advanced service desk, field, server, network, cloud, and line-of-business application issues.Escalate complex multi-domain or engineering-level issues to Systems Engineers when appropriate.Provide consultations as needed with internal and external stakeholders by providing technical expertise and knowledge of client environments.Provide consultations with the Systems Technician technical team regarding escalations, aiming to coordinate directly where possible, empower them to solve issues, and act as a mentor.Follow up with Systems Technician escalations, providing insight regarding resolutions.Develop and contribute to processes and knowledge base articles to enhance service desk and shared team efficiency and effectiveness.Demonstrate excellent customer service skills with a focus on professionalism, communication, follow-through, and problem-solving.

Technical Support & Documentation

Provide advanced end-user, server, networking, virtualization, Microsoft 365, and cloud support and troubleshooting.Administer and support client infrastructure environments including servers, workstations, firewalls, switches, wireless access points, virtualization platforms, and cloud technologies.Support Microsoft 365 administration, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune, and Microsoft Entra ID.Troubleshoot advanced networking, connectivity, firewall, VLAN, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and wireless issues.Support backup, disaster recovery, documentation, ticketing, remote management, and monitoring platforms.Collaborate with colleagues and serve as a technical resource to address emergent problems or situations, offering coaching and guidance to the technical team.Demonstrate familiarity with ITIL concepts to ensure adherence to industry best practices.Adhere to all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for tasks, functions, and organizational policies and create SOPs for future use as needed.

Mentorship & Technical Enablement

Provide technical guidance and coaching to Systems Technicians.Assist with onboarding, training, and development of technical team members.Contribute to development of team training materials and knowledge base documentation.Promote responsible and effective use of approved AI tools across the technical team.Share AI-driven productivity techniques and operational improvements with Systems Technicians.Elevate team capability through knowledge sharing and standardization of best practices.

Education/Certification Requirements: 

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred (or equivalent experience)Valid driver’s license.At least one intermediate certification is preferred. Examples including but not limited to:AI-103CCNAMS-102AZ-104AZ-900CompTIA Security+CompTIA Network+
Experience Requirements

3-5 years of progressively responsible experience supporting infrastructure, end- user technologies, networking, virtualization, Microsoft 365, and cloud platforms.Demonstrated success supporting client environments, serving as a technical escalation resource, and resolving advanced infrastructure and end-user support issues.Experience mentoring junior technical staff, providing technical guidance, and contributing to documentation and operational best practices.Experience working within a Managed Services Provider (MSP), consulting, or multi- client IT environment is preferred.

Technical Knowledge & Experience (including, But Not Limited To)

Administration and troubleshooting of Windows Server and Windows Workstation environments.Strong Microsoft 365 administration experience, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune, and related services.Strong understanding of identity and access management, including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, password resets, permissions, and user lifecycle support.Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 security best practices and Zero Trust concepts.Experience administering and troubleshooting virtualization platforms including Hyper-V and VMware.Azure administration and cloud infrastructure support, including virtual machines, storage, backup, and related cloud services.Networking experience including firewall administration, wireless access points, network segmentation, routing concepts, DNS, DHCP, VPN, VLANs, and Layer 2/3/4 switching.Experience with firewall and network platforms including SonicWall, Meraki, WatchGuard, Auvik, or similar technologies.Experience with MSP toolsets and documentation platforms, including ConnectWise, ConnectWise RMM/Automate, IT Glue, or similar technologies.Experience administering backup and disaster recovery solutions, including Datto, Veeam, or similar technologies.PowerShell scripting and automation concepts to improve operational efficiency.Working knowledge of Microsoft Copilot and AI-enabled administration tools.Ability to leverage approved AI solutions to improve troubleshooting, documentation, operational efficiency, and knowledge management.Understanding of security, governance, and data protection considerations related to AI-enabled workplace technologies.Ability to assist clients and internal teams in adopting AI-enabled productivity solutions and best practices.

We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.



Job Description

This role will be based in Manassas, VA. 

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is on-site, meaning it will be performed in the specified office on a full-time basis due to the business needs of the team.

This role may require working evening or overnight shifts (3:00 PM - 12:00 AM or 11:00 PM - 8:00 AM).

The Associate Data Center Hardware Engineer is a hands-on technical role focused on ensuring the reliability and performance of LinkedIn's global infrastructure. This position is responsible for executing hardware break-fix activities, providing advanced troubleshooting support, and serving as an escalation point for contracted data center technicians. In addition to performing direct repair work, the role partners with vendors, mentors contract staff, and drives consistency in service delivery across all LinkedIn data center operations.

Hardware Deployment & InstallationProject ManagementTicketing Systems (Jira, ServiceNow)Linux/UnixServer and Network Troubleshooting

rows.title: Program Support Specialist
rows.descriptionText:
This position is located in the Department of Employment Services (DOES), Office of Unemployment Compensation (OUC). The mission of the Office of Unemployment Compensation is to administer unemployment insurance programs that provide temporary financial assistance to eligible individuals, ensure compliance with program requirements, and support efficient and effective service delivery.

The incumbent provides administrative and programmatic support for the day-to-day operations of the Office of Unemployment Compensation, focusing on areas such as benefits administration, quality assurance, training coordination, and budget monitoring. Responsibilities include: Supporting quality control initiatives by reviewing processes, identifying gaps, and recommending improvements to enhance program efficiency. Coordinating and maintaining training schedules, materials, and records for staff development and compliance purposes. Performing budget-related administrative tasks, including tracking expenditures, preparing reports, and supporting financial reviews. Maintaining accurate program documentation and records, ensuring timely data entry and reporting. Providing general administrative support, including managing correspondence, scheduling meetings, and assisting with audits and compliance reviews. Assignments are generally routine but require the ability to evaluate the impact of problems encountered and propose solutions from among several viable alternatives. The position demands strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively to support the Office of Unemployment Compensation’s mission.

Duties and Responsibilities

Provides assistance and participates in the coordination of special assignments to coordinate and resolve general management matters and other appropriate issues and projects related to the functional responsibilities of the program(s). Coordinates and monitors practices and procedures utilized by the program staff to ensure compliance with all applicable regulations and procedures.

Participates in analytical studies based on examination of management needs. Identifies research and analyzes programs issues or problems; and presenting results. Evaluates current procedures to improve operational efficiency and makes recommendations to improve program(s) activities and services. Recommend administrative strategies or changes in internal operating procedures to incorporate new requirements, and to improve, expedite and eliminate management problems. Generate spreadsheets, charts, summary tables, and statistics used in various reports and presentations. Provides assistance in tracking data or documents in reference to agency or agency program(s). Generates internal and external documents or correspondence that assists in the workflow of the program operation.

Qualifications And Education

Specialized Experience: Experience that equipped the applicant with the particular knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform successfully the duties of the position, and that is typically in or related to the work of the position to be filled. To be creditable, one (1) year of specialized experience must have been equivalent to at least the next lower grade level in the normal line of progression.

Licensures, Certifications, And Other Requirements

None

Work Conditions/Environment

The work is performed in a normal office setting.

Other Significant Facts

Tour of Duty: Monday-Friday 8:30 am- 5:00 pm or Varies

Operating Status: In-Person reporting, flexible and limited telework options available upon position eligibility and operational needs.

Promotion Potential: No known promotion potential

Duration of Appointment: Career Service – Term NTE 13-Months

Pay Plan, Series and Grade: CS-0301-9

Salary: $54,183- $69,770; Based on qualifications and funding

Collective Bargaining Unit (Union): This position is not covered by a Collective Bargaining Unit.

Position Designation: This position has been designated as Security sensitive therefore the incumbent of this position will be subject to enhanced suitability screening pursuant to Chapter 4 of DC Personnel Regulations, Suitability and as such, incumbents of this position shall be subject to criminal background checks, background investigations, and mandatory drug and alcohol testing, as applicable.

Residency Preference: Applicants claiming “Residency Preference” will be required to maintain residency in the District of Columbia for a minimum of seven (7) years. Failure to do so may result in forfeiture of employment.

rows.title: Business Analyst I
rows.descriptionText:
Serve as an intermediary between business and technical areas. Work with internal and external teams to collect, clarify, and translate business and/or technical requirements. Develop applications and solutions.

Essential Functions

 Work with leadership to understand drivers of business performance and create tools and processes to visualize progress towards key goals. Work closely with internal (and/or external) stakeholders to collect, analyze, translate, and document business and/or technical requirements. Identify, document, and standardize work streams and data flows and help promote their use within the business. Create documentation for processes and procedures. Conduct or organize testing/validation of processes and procedures. Measure and monitor project/solution performance. Initiate corrective actions as necessary. Ensure appropriate visibility and communication as it relates to the project/solution. Collect feedback to look for issues and opportunities for improvement. Ensure that all documents are complete and stored appropriately. Demonstrates the guiding principles of Aerostar. Maintain a clean and safe work area. Follow established safety and ergonomic standards. May be called upon to perform comparable duties of a similar or related nature and/or assist in other areas as needed. Learning, understanding, continuously improving, and promoting the division’s quality management system in accordance with ISO standards.

Education And Experience

 Bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, business, or related field. Minimum 1-3 years related experience, or experience in lieu of education.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

 Basic proficiency in data visualization and dashboarding tools expected Foundational knowledge of database queries and APIs required Mathematical and financial analysis skills required Specific experience in SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and advanced Excel features, etc. are beneficial Strong administrative skills. Must be very detail oriented. High level of patience and service. Ability to motivate team members. Team player who is self-motivated and has ability to work with minimal supervision. Ability to communicate effectively with team members and leadership staff. Ability to travel up to 10% of time. Business Analysis certification or formal training preferred.

Physical Requirements: Required to sit, stand, walk, bend, and reach. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Working Conditions: Exposure to a normal office environment. Position may occasionally require entering a production environment, including exposure to noise, fumes, moving machinery, and varied temperatures.

In compliance with state and local laws, the salary range for this role is $70,000 – $90,000. The range provided is a general guideline and good faith estimate representative of all experience levels but is not a guarantee of compensation or salary. TCOM considers several factors when extending an offer including, but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate’s experience, education/training, key skills, internal equity, and current market conditions. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Annual bonuses are designed to reward individual contributions as well as allow employees to share in company results.

Benefits: TCOM offers a variety of benefits, including health and disability insurance, 401(k) match, flexible spending accounts/HSAs, EAP, tuition reimbursement, parental leave, paid time off (PTO), and company-paid holidays. The specific programs, options and eligibility may vary depending on date of hire, classification, and schedule type.

rows.descriptionText:
Capital One's Balance Sheet Management group is seeking a motivated professional for a Senior Analyst role on the Interest Rate Risk Management (IRR) Analytics team. The role provides an excellent opportunity to learn about the bank’s balance sheet, measure and manage interest rate risk, project net interest income in different macro-economic scenarios, and measure fair value of financial instruments.

The Senior Analyst position will participate in shaping Capital One’s long-term business strategy by developing analysis and reports to evaluate the company’s interest rate risk (IRR) and Foreign exchange risk (FX) positions. The individual will also assist in developing critical analyses that drive decision-making for balance sheet and interest rate risk management. The role offers the candidate the opportunity to evaluate emerging trends in the capital markets and banking industry to help shape Capital One’s risk management strategy as well as participate in Capital One’s digital initiative.

Responsibilities:

Partner closely with Lines of Business (LOBs) to understand business trends and modeling assumptions, and implications for interest rate risk\Support and enhance model implementation in Quantitative Risk Management (QRM) , including data pipelines that feed critical risk models. Design, develop, and maintain interactive business intelligence dashboards utilizing Amazon QuickSight or similar tools to communicate complex portfolio metrics to non-technical stakeholders. Leverage emerging generative AI tools to streamline analytics workflows, automate data processing, and enhance overall reporting capabilities. Use SQL and Python to automate manual data extraction and validation workflows. Assist in the preparation of executive-level presentations for senior management and internal partners (ALCO, Board, etc.). Create and maintain high-quality documentation for the modeling framework ,QRM implementations, procedures and analysisEnsure accuracy of portfolio level interest rate risk metrics and communicate key drivers for changes in Market Value and NII sensitivities to senior management and internal partnersAssist in the monthly interest rate risk position reporting of metrics including duration of equity (DOE), economic value of equity (EVE) sensitivity, and NII Sensitivity

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree or military experienceAt least 1 year of experience in financial services or quantitative analysisAt least 1 year of experience using SQL or Python

Preferred Qualifications:

Master's degree in Finance, Financial Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field1+ year of experience in asset liability management (ALM), or 1+ year of experience in fixed income analysis or corporate finance1+ year of Quantitative Risk Management (QRM) or other interest rate risk modeling experience1+ year of data and technology systems, including SQL1 + year using coding languages (Python) to automate workflow1+ year of experience building data visualizations and dashboards (Amazon QuickSight, Tableau, or similar)Certified Financial Analyst designation(CFA) or Financial Risk Management designation (FRM)Strong foundational understanding of Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book (IRRBB) principlesFamiliarity with leveraging LLMs and generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini) for practical coding or business problem-solvingProficiency with ExcelProficiency with PowerPoint
