Summary:

The Junior Data Analyst will support data collection, data cleanup, quality checks, spreadsheets/databases, charts and tables, recurring reports, survey data, and ad hoc analytical requests.

Personnel are assigned in support of DHHQ in Falls Church, VA, but may work from the contractor facility or remotely when authorized.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

Collect, compile, organize, and prepare data from multiple program sources for analysis and reporting.Perform routine data cleanup and quality checks to identify missing, inconsistent, duplicate, or inaccurate information.Enter, update, and maintain program data in spreadsheets, databases, and other approved data systems.Assist with maintaining the SCAADL Microsoft Access database and historical enrollment and participation information.Prepare recurring weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reports using established procedures and reporting formats.Assist with preparing ad hoc reports and data requests, including raw data, charts, graphs, and tables.Develop basic charts, graphs, tables, and other data visualizations to support program reporting and presentations.Assist with analyzing DES and SCAADL program data, including population changes, participation, timeliness, and other established performance measures.Assist with compiling and reviewing data for DES and SCAADL performance reports and other program deliverables.Support survey data activities by collecting, cleaning, organizing, and reviewing survey results for accuracy and completeness.Assist with IDES satisfaction survey activities, including preparing survey data, reports, graphs, and related materials.Pull MEB and PEB cohort lists from VTA and assist with reviewing data for accuracy, completeness, and survey eligibility.Assist with identifying and documenting data quality issues in program-related systems and escalating issues to the appropriate personnel.Assist with system data support activities, including data validation, user acceptance testing, and documentation of identified issues.Maintain documentation and established procedures related to recurring reports and data processes.Assist senior analysts with gathering data, validating information, preparing analytical materials, and responding to Government data requests.Coordinate with team members and Government personnel to obtain and clarify data needed for assigned reporting and analytical tasks.Provide other support as needed.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office.Familiarity with databases, data visualization, or reporting tools.Ability to organize, clean, validate, and analyze data.Ability to prepare accurate charts, tables, spreadsheets, and reports.Strong attention to detail and written communication skills.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, statistics, mathematics, information systems, business, computer science, or a related field preferred.0-2 years of professional, internship, academic, or military experience involving data analysis, reporting, or data management.Tier 1/non-sensitive, with the applicable DHA background investigation and suitability requirements.

Preferred Qualifications (Education, Experience, Skills):

Federal or DoD experience preferred but not required

Pay And Benefits

The salary range for this position is $65,000.00 to $75,000.00 annually.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

rows.descriptionText:
About Us

ProShares now offers one of the largest lineups of ETFs, with over $100 billion in assets. The company is a leader in strategies such as crypto, dividend growth, interest rate hedged bond and geared (leveraged and inverse) ETF investing. ProShares continues to innovate with products that provide strategic and tactical opportunities for investors to manage risk and enhance returns.

Position Summary

Portfolio Analyst is the first step in the Portfolio Manager (PM) career track at ProShares. The PM career track begins at Analyst, Senior Analyst, Associate Portfolio Manager, Desk Head, (Portfolio Manager, and Senior Portfolio Manager) and concludes with Director, Portfolio Management.

Skills

Each step in the PM career track contains a similar series of tasks, skills, and characteristics that are performed at an increasing level of understanding and responsibility as they progress through the track. The Portfolio Analysts play an integral role in three of the essential job functions within the Portfolio Department:

Portfolio Management—With the Desk Head’s oversight, assist with the daily management of ETFs and or Mutual Funds,Portfolio Trading— With the Desk Head’s oversight, places trades within the regulatory requirements, prospectus, internal guidelines and the guidelines of best execution,Portfolio Administration— Review of broad data sets to ensure accurate processing and reporting of the funds.

What You’ll Be Responsible For[1]:

Portfolio Management

Works, under the supervision of the Portfolio Manager, to implement the investment strategy to ensure alignment with stated investment objectives.Collaborate with the portfolio management team by performing data analysis pertaining to portfolio construction, asset allocation, security selection, and portfolio repositioning.Continuously monitor the portfolio and confirm compliance with regulatory requirements.Assist the Portfolio Manager in the development of a tax efficient strategy and implement it throughout the year.Assist the Portfolio Manager in analyzing the daily performance attribution of the funds.Support timely and consistent communication with internal and external stakeholders.

Portfolio Trading

Responsible, under direction, for executing trades authorized by the Portfolio Manager for the rebalancing of the funds.Perform and implement cost benefit analysis in an effort to obtain best execution.Help improve the portfolio trading workflow process.

Portfolio Administration

Report daily portfolio transactions.Reconcile end of day portfolio composition.Verify net asset value of the portfolio.Ensure timely delivery of portfolio performance and characteristics.

What Sets This Role Apart

The ability to work with a top investment firmExposure to multiple investment vehicles in both the ETF and Mutual Fund structureAbility to work, build, develop and improve processes and proceduresUse current trading systemsLiaise with major brokerage firms for trading and execution

What You Bring

Undergraduate degree required in finance, economics, math or related field preferred.One to three years related experience in fund accounting, investment operations preferred.Security or derivative trading and operational experience preferred.

Success At ProShares

Excellent mathematical, quantitative and analytical skills.Excel proficiency required. VBA macro skills desirable.Familiarity with industry standard systems desirable.Attention to detail and strong presentational skills required.Strong organizational skills and ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.

The compensation for this position includes salary and incentive pay. The annual base salary range for this role is $80,000-$100,000 (USD), which does not include discretionary bonus compensation. Total compensation may vary based on experience, role, location, department, and individual performance.

Competitive pay and discretionary bonusPaid time offHealth care benefits (medical, dental & vision)Additional insurance includes basic life, accidental death and dismemberment, supplemental life, disability and legal benefit401(k) retirement plan with matching contributionSpending Accounts (Health Care, Dependent Care, and Transportation)Wellness Programs (fitness reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program)Education assistanceHybrid work scheduleAdditional Programs include peer recognition, corporate matching gift

rows.title: Vulnerability Research Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
At Two Six Technologies, we build, deploy, and implement innovative products that solve the world’s most complex challenges today. Through unrivaled collaboration and unwavering trust, we push the boundaries of what’s possible to empower our team and support our customers in building a safer global future.

Overview Of Opportunity

We are seeking a Vulnerability Research Analyst to conduct software security evaluations using state-of-the-art AI evaluation harnesses. This position focuses purely on analyzing extracted source code and compiled binaries from specialized COTS/GOTS systems, evaluating automated vulnerability-finding performance, and assessing system resilience without needing direct hardware-level manipulation.

Key Responsibilities & Duties

Perform static and dynamic software vulnerability analysis on pre-extracted COTS/GOTS source code repositories and firmware images.Deploy AI-guided fuzzing and automated vulnerability detection suites to evaluate complex software architectures and identify high-risk logic flaws.Validate automated tool output by tracing execution paths in code to determine root causes and real-world exploitability.Develop custom CodeQL queries, Semgrep rules, and Abstract Syntax Tree (AST)-based detection signatures to codify newly discovered bug patterns and automate regression testing across software evaluations.Present vulnerability perspectives, risk assessments, and testing metrics to program managers, stakeholders, and intelligence community partners.

Qualifications & Skills

Active US Security Clearance of Top Secret/SCI with polygraphDegree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Security, or equivalent practical experience.Experience in vulnerability research, static source code analysis, reverse engineering, or software security audits.Solid understanding of memory management, pointer arithmetic, and common software security flaws in compiled and managed languages.Familiarity with automated static/dynamic code analysis concepts and AI-driven automation tools.

Nice to Have

Experience authoring or tuning custom static analysis rules using CodeQL, Semgrep, or Tree-sitter parsers.Familiarity with firmware emulation tools and frameworks (e.g., QEMU, Unicorn Engine, Avatar2, or Ghidra/IDA emulator plugins) to run extracted binaries without physical hardware.Experience creating or adapting custom test drivers, stubs, and harness interfaces for unit-level software execution.Knowledge of machine learning applications in automated bug discovery, symbolic execution, or AI-assisted code analysis.Prior experience delivering technical vulnerability assessments on DoD or IC defense programs.

Clearance Requirements

Active US Security Clearance of Top Secret/SCI with polygraph.Must be willing to obtain and maintain a Polygraph clearance.

rows.title: GTM Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
MarginEdge is hiring an Analyst to build out go-to-market analytics: pipeline and conversion reporting, coverage and capacity modeling, commission calculation, and the analysis leadership uses to decide where to put money and headcount.

The enticing part of this role is that you own the whole path. You'll help frame the question, write the SQL, build the model, put it in source control, and present the answer — and the version you build is the one the company keeps using. There's no analytics team you hand a spec to. That's the trade: you have to be technical enough to build it, and you get to skip the six weeks of translation.

You'll report to the Director of Data Platform and Analytics and sit inside the data team, with Revenue Operations as your primary stakeholder. Your work gets reviewed by people who care whether the model is sound, and your roadmap comes from what the revenue organization actually needs. You'll work regularly with the Director of Revenue Operations, the CRO, and FP&A — more direct exposure to how revenue decisions get made than this kind of role usually carries.

We care much more about how you think and what you can build than where you've worked. Consulting, finance, RevOps, a BI seat at a smaller company, a science or engineering background you've since pointed at data problems — all fine.

MarginEdge: Where hospitality meets technology

As a team built by former (and current!) restaurant operators, our mission is to bring operators the same energy, attention to detail, and passion that they bring to their guests. Our culture is deeply rooted in service, partially because that’s where so many of our team come from (including everyone on our Business Development team), but also because we believe it is just the right way to run a business. We design our software with profound empathy for the complexity of running a restaurant, and the goal of making the magic just a little easier for operators by taking the complex (read: very annoying) back office tasks off their plate, while empowering them with real-time data.

Our founders share a deep history in both owning and operating restaurants and in building successful tech companies. We are venture-backed and serve 12,000+ restaurants across the US and Canada.

We enable restaurants to make magic while knowing we are doing the same for them.

We have the utmost respect for our clients and because of this, we are unable to hire their current employees.

What type of responsibilities will I have?

Build the analysis that decides things.

Build the thing that answers them next quarter.

Build and maintain the GTM layer of our dbt project: funnel and conversion models, pipeline history, rep and territory attribution.Ship through source control — branch, pull request, review, tests, documentation. dbt — Core, project structure, tests, macros. If you've built tested, version-controlled transformation logic some other way, say so.Trino/Athena or Snowflake. We're mid-migration, so you'd see both.Python for the analysis SQL shouldn't do.Salesforce as a data source, including the parts of it that lie to you.Subscription billing data (Zuora or similar), quota setting, territory design, or sales compensation modeling.Semantic or metrics layer experience (MetricFlow, Cube, or similar).BI development in Preset/Superset, Looker, Tableau, or comparable.

rows.title: Information Technology & Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Description

Do you enjoy solving complex problems at the intersection of technology and data to support mission-critical operations?

If so, we are looking for someone like you to join our team at APL.

Recognized as one of Computerworld’s Top Places to Work in IT for seven consecutive years, APL is seeking an Information Technology & Data Analyst to support enterprise IT systems and leverage data to drive informed decision-making across the organization.

This role serves as a critical bridge between business needs and technical solutions, ensuring systems are secure, reliable, and aligned with organizational and mission requirements.

Position Summary

The Information Technology & Data Analyst bridges the gap between data, technology, and policy by transforming complex data into actionable insights and ensuring accurate, policy-aligned data capture. This role designs, develops, and supports dashboards, tools, and IT systems to enable effective data use across the organization.

Responsibilities include analyzing, designing, implementing, and maintaining IT systems, as well as collecting, normalizing, and analyzing complex datasets to identify trends, develop visualizations, and deliver insights that support operational and strategic decision-making.

As An Information Technology & Data Analyst, You Will

Analyze structured and unstructured data to identify trends, risks, and opportunitiesTranslate data findings into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholdersSupport decision-making through reporting, modeling, and visualizationDesign and maintain interactive dashboards (e.g., Power BI or similar tools)Develop lightweight tools, scripts, or workflows to automate data processing and reportingImprove existing systems and processes for efficiency, scalability, and usabilityAnalyze business and operational requirements and translate them into effective technical solutionsSupport the design, implementation, testing, maintenance, and monitoring of IT systems and applicationsMonitor system performance and data quality; identify issues and recommend improvementsInterpret policies, requirements, and standards and translate them into data collection and reporting needsEnsure data is captured accurately, consistently, and in compliance with cybersecurity, privacy, and regulatory requirementsParticipate in risk, change, and configuration management activitiesWork with systems, databases, and APIs to extract and integrate dataSupport system upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh efforts (e.g., ServiceNow GRC, MCN, HCSD, NEXTOPS)Perform queue and task management activities for classified systemsDevelop and maintain system documentation, procedures, and user guidesCollaborate with stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams to support initiativesProvide technical and data-related guidance to users and leadership

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications if you:

Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)Have experience supporting enterprise IT systems and environmentsHave working knowledge of operating systems, networks, databases, and enterprise applicationsDemonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skillsCan communicate technical information effectively to non-technical audiencesHave a strong understanding of data structures, databases, and data workflowsAre able to interpret complex requirements or policies and translate them into technical or data-driven solutionsHave experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similarHold an active Top Secret security clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship. 

You’ll be successful in this role if you demonstrate:

Experience with at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python)Strong technical analysis and systems thinkingExperience developing internal tools or automationsKnowledge of cloud platforms or modern data stacksAttention to detail and disciplined documentation practicesAbility to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environmentA collaborative mindset with the ability to work independentlyFamiliarity with data governance, compliance, or regulatory-driven environmentsExperience working in cross-functional or technical teams

Why Work at APL?

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. rows.title: Manager, Data Science - US Card Customer Management
rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

As part of the US Card data science organization, this team focuses on the customer management business, and builds top tier machine learning solutions to meet the various needs such as real-time customer behavioral prediction and valuation forecasts. We work in a team environment, collaborating closely with cross-functioning teams including the business, engineers, analysts, data science/quants, products.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science.

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 4 years of experience performing data analyticsA PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 1 year of experience performing data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysisAt least 1 year of experience working with machine learningAt least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

rows.title: Information Technology & Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Description

Do you enjoy solving complex problems at the intersection of technology and data to support mission-critical operations?

If so, we are looking for someone like you to join our team at APL.

Recognized as one of Computerworld’s Top Places to Work in IT for seven consecutive years, APL is seeking an Information Technology & Data Analyst to support enterprise IT systems and leverage data to drive informed decision-making across the organization.

This role serves as a critical bridge between business needs and technical solutions, ensuring systems are secure, reliable, and aligned with organizational and mission requirements.

Position Summary

The Information Technology & Data Analyst bridges the gap between data, technology, and policy by transforming complex data into actionable insights and ensuring accurate, policy-aligned data capture. This role designs, develops, and supports dashboards, tools, and IT systems to enable effective data use across the organization.

Responsibilities include analyzing, designing, implementing, and maintaining IT systems, as well as collecting, normalizing, and analyzing complex datasets to identify trends, develop visualizations, and deliver insights that support operational and strategic decision-making.

As An Information Technology & Data Analyst, You Will

Analyze structured and unstructured data to identify trends, risks, and opportunitiesTranslate data findings into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholdersSupport decision-making through reporting, modeling, and visualizationDesign and maintain interactive dashboards (e.g., Power BI or similar tools)Develop lightweight tools, scripts, or workflows to automate data processing and reportingImprove existing systems and processes for efficiency, scalability, and usabilityAnalyze business and operational requirements and translate them into effective technical solutionsSupport the design, implementation, testing, maintenance, and monitoring of IT systems and applicationsMonitor system performance and data quality; identify issues and recommend improvementsInterpret policies, requirements, and standards and translate them into data collection and reporting needsEnsure data is captured accurately, consistently, and in compliance with cybersecurity, privacy, and regulatory requirementsParticipate in risk, change, and configuration management activitiesWork with systems, databases, and APIs to extract and integrate dataSupport system upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh efforts (e.g., ServiceNow GRC, MCN, HCSD, NEXTOPS)Perform queue and task management activities for classified systemsDevelop and maintain system documentation, procedures, and user guidesCollaborate with stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams to support initiativesProvide technical and data-related guidance to users and leadership

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications if you:

Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)Have experience supporting enterprise IT systems and environmentsHave working knowledge of operating systems, networks, databases, and enterprise applicationsDemonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skillsCan communicate technical information effectively to non-technical audiencesHave a strong understanding of data structures, databases, and data workflowsAre able to interpret complex requirements or policies and translate them into technical or data-driven solutionsHave experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similarHold an active Top Secret security clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship. 

You’ll be successful in this role if you demonstrate:

Experience with at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python)Strong technical analysis and systems thinkingExperience developing internal tools or automationsKnowledge of cloud platforms or modern data stacksAttention to detail and disciplined documentation practicesAbility to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environmentA collaborative mindset with the ability to work independentlyFamiliarity with data governance, compliance, or regulatory-driven environmentsExperience working in cross-functional or technical teams

About Us

Why Work at APL?

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL’s campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities at https://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. The referenced pay range is based on JHU APL’s good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level with consideration for internal parity. For salaried employees scheduled to work less than 40 hours per week, annual salary will be prorated based on the number of hours worked. Additional compensation may be provided in the form of a sign-on bonus, relocation benefits, locality allowance or discretionary payments for exceptional performance. rows.title: Vulnerability Research Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
At Two Six Technologies, we build, deploy, and implement innovative products that solve the world’s most complex challenges today. Through unrivaled collaboration and unwavering trust, we push the boundaries of what’s possible to empower our team and support our customers in building a safer global future.

Overview Of Opportunity

We are seeking a Vulnerability Research Analyst to conduct software security evaluations using state-of-the-art AI evaluation harnesses. This position focuses purely on analyzing extracted source code and compiled binaries from specialized COTS/GOTS systems, evaluating automated vulnerability-finding performance, and assessing system resilience without needing direct hardware-level manipulation.

Key Responsibilities & Duties

Perform static and dynamic software vulnerability analysis on pre-extracted COTS/GOTS source code repositories and firmware images.Deploy AI-guided fuzzing and automated vulnerability detection suites to evaluate complex software architectures and identify high-risk logic flaws.Validate automated tool output by tracing execution paths in code to determine root causes and real-world exploitability.Develop custom CodeQL queries, Semgrep rules, and Abstract Syntax Tree (AST)-based detection signatures to codify newly discovered bug patterns and automate regression testing across software evaluations.Present vulnerability perspectives, risk assessments, and testing metrics to program managers, stakeholders, and intelligence community partners.

Qualifications & Skills

Active US Security Clearance of Top Secret/SCI with polygraphDegree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Security, or equivalent practical experience.Experience in vulnerability research, static source code analysis, reverse engineering, or software security audits.Solid understanding of memory management, pointer arithmetic, and common software security flaws in compiled and managed languages.Familiarity with automated static/dynamic code analysis concepts and AI-driven automation tools.

Nice to Have

Experience authoring or tuning custom static analysis rules using CodeQL, Semgrep, or Tree-sitter parsers.Familiarity with firmware emulation tools and frameworks (e.g., QEMU, Unicorn Engine, Avatar2, or Ghidra/IDA emulator plugins) to run extracted binaries without physical hardware.Experience creating or adapting custom test drivers, stubs, and harness interfaces for unit-level software execution.Knowledge of machine learning applications in automated bug discovery, symbolic execution, or AI-assisted code analysis.Prior experience delivering technical vulnerability assessments on DoD or IC defense programs.

Clearance Requirements

Active US Security Clearance of Top Secret/SCI with polygraph.Must be willing to obtain and maintain a Polygraph clearance.

rows.title: Manager, Data Science - US Card Customer Management
rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

As part of the US Card data science organization, this team focuses on the customer management business, and builds top tier machine learning solutions to meet the various needs such as real-time customer behavioral prediction and valuation forecasts. We work in a team environment, collaborating closely with cross-functioning teams including the business, engineers, analysts, data science/quants, products.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 4 years of experience performing data analyticsA PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 1 year of experience performing data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysisAt least 1 year of experience working with machine learningAt least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 3 years of experience in data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience working with AWSAt least 4 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or R for large scale data analysisAt least 4 years’ experience with machine learningAt least 4 years’ experience with SQL

We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.



Job Description

This role will be based in Manassas, VA. 

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is on-site, meaning it will be performed in the specified office on a full-time basis due to the business needs of the team.

This role may require working evening or overnight shifts (3:00 PM - 12:00 AM or 11:00 PM - 8:00 AM).

rows.title: Research Analyst-Behavioral Health
rows.descriptionText:
Job Description

Westat is a leader in research, data collection and analysis, technical assistance, evaluation, and communications. Our evidence-based findings help clients in government and the private sector accelerate advancements in health, education, transportation, and social and economic policy. Our dedication to improving lives through research and our approach to projects grounded in investigative curiosity, statistical and data rigor, adaptive methods, and advanced technology are why clients find exceptional value in our work.

Job Summary

Westat has an immediate opening for a Research Analyst to join our team of leading researchers supporting our continued work on behavioral health and health policy. You will be assisting with projects that address the needs of individuals with mental health conditions and substance use disorders.

In this highly collaborative role, you will work closely with project leadership and multi-disciplinary project teams to help translate science into resources for diverse audiences including federal and state policy makers, clinical service providers, and individuals affected by mental health conditions and substance use disorders. In this role, you will have substantive opportunities to assist with research on behavioral health topics such as behavioral health system transformation, healthcare financing, behavioral health program evaluations, mental health and substance use services, recovery and resilience, substance misuse prevention, overdose prevention, opioid and stimulant use disorders, and advancing access to effective behavioral health care.

We value regular in-person collaboration and preference will be given to candidates who can work 2 days per week at our Bethesda, Maryland office or at one of our other Westat office locations.

Job Responsibilities

 Support all stages of research from study design through data collection and management, analysis, and report writing Conduct literature searches, synthesize research findings, and contribute to writing on health policy and behavioral health topics Assist in synthesizing research findings Conduct data collection efforts, such as administering surveys, interviews, site visits, observation protocols, and acquiring administrative data Provide technical assistance and training to federal grantees and other stakeholders Present evaluation findings to federal clients and other stakeholders Assist with analysis of qualitative or quantitative data

Basic Qualifications

 A master’s degree in public policy or a social science discipline, such as sociology, economics, political science, psychology or in analytical methods such as applied statistics; or a bachelor’s degree in public policy or a social science discipline, such as sociology, economics, political science, psychology or in analytical methods such as applied statistics and 2-5 years of relevant experience Experience with quantitative, qualitative, and mixed-methods evaluation approaches and using analytic software as appropriate Experience using Microsoft Office software (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) to produce visually-appealing reports, tables, graphs, and presentation slides Experience creating data visualizations based on evaluation data US Citizenship is required by contract

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience writing technical reports (such as literature reviews, study plans, methodology reports, summaries of research findings) or contributing to peer-reviewed journal articles Knowledge of public health approaches to evaluate mental health conditions and substance use disorders and service delivery Experience using library databases to identify relevant journal articles and reports and reference management tools to organize sources Experience with data collection, developing analysis plans, and overseeing analyses Experience working on Federal government contracts, especially for the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA) Demonstrated experience working on multiple projects quickly and simultaneously Excellent written, verbal, and organizational skills Ability to take initiative and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced environment

At Two Six Technologies, we build, deploy, and implement innovative products that solve the world’s most complex challenges today. Through unrivaled collaboration and unwavering trust, we push the boundaries of what’s possible to empower our team and support our customers in building a safer global future.

Overview Of Opportunity

We are seeking a Vulnerability Research Analyst to conduct software security evaluations using state-of-the-art AI evaluation harnesses. This position focuses purely on analyzing extracted source code and compiled binaries from specialized COTS/GOTS systems, evaluating automated vulnerability-finding performance, and assessing system resilience without needing direct hardware-level manipulation.

Key Responsibilities & Duties

Perform static and dynamic software vulnerability analysis on pre-extracted COTS/GOTS source code repositories and firmware images.Deploy AI-guided fuzzing and automated vulnerability detection suites to evaluate complex software architectures and identify high-risk logic flaws.Validate automated tool output by tracing execution paths in code to determine root causes and real-world exploitability.Develop custom CodeQL queries, Semgrep rules, and Abstract Syntax Tree (AST)-based detection signatures to codify newly discovered bug patterns and automate regression testing across software evaluations.Present vulnerability perspectives, risk assessments, and testing metrics to program managers, stakeholders, and intelligence community partners.

Qualifications & Skills

Active US Security Clearance of Top Secret/SCI with polygraphDegree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Security, or equivalent practical experience.Experience in vulnerability research, static source code analysis, reverse engineering, or software security audits.Solid understanding of memory management, pointer arithmetic, and common software security flaws in compiled and managed languages.Familiarity with automated static/dynamic code analysis concepts and AI-driven automation tools.

Nice to Have

Experience authoring or tuning custom static analysis rules using CodeQL, Semgrep, or Tree-sitter parsers.Familiarity with firmware emulation tools and frameworks (e.g., QEMU, Unicorn Engine, Avatar2, or Ghidra/IDA emulator plugins) to run extracted binaries without physical hardware.Experience creating or adapting custom test drivers, stubs, and harness interfaces for unit-level software execution.Knowledge of machine learning applications in automated bug discovery, symbolic execution, or AI-assisted code analysis.Prior experience delivering technical vulnerability assessments on DoD or IC defense programs.

Clearance Requirements

Active US Security Clearance of Top Secret/SCI with polygraph.Must be willing to obtain and maintain a Polygraph clearance.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Title: Technical Lab AssociateJob Description

The Technical Laboratory Associate plays a key role in supporting laboratory-based research, process development, and manufacturing support functions. This position focuses on hands-on testing, analytical evaluation, and verification of materials to ensure consistency with defined requirements. The role includes quality testing, investigation of process variation, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to maintain performance and compliance standards. The successful candidate will be organized, analytical, and comfortable working in a dynamic lab setting both independently and as part of a team.

Responsibilities

Carry out laboratory testing to support research projects and manufacturing operations.Execute quality verification and certification testing on internally produced and customer-provided materials.Investigate and resolve process inconsistencies through bench-scale testing and data evaluation.Work closely with production personnel and supervisory staff to evaluate and approve finished materials.Communicate with external clients and suppliers regarding analytical results and material certifications.Collect, document, and manage data generated from both in-house and third-party testing activities.Generate and distribute technical summaries and test reports to internal teams and external partners.Support internal audit activities and assist with adherence to laboratory quality systems and procedures.

Essential Skills

Associates or Bachelors degree in Chemistry, Materials Science, or a related physical science discipline.At least one year of hands-on laboratory experience in an educational, industrial, or research environment.Demonstrated ability to plan, perform, and document experiments with minimal supervision.Experience analyzing experimental data and preparing clear, well-organized technical reports.Capable of interpreting written specifications and developing test plans to verify compliance.Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly present technical information.Proven ability to work effectively both independently and within cross-functional teams.Professional communication style when working with leadership, colleagues, customers, and suppliers.Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Hands-on experience with analytical instrumentation such as FTIR, DSC, TGA, chromatography, or related techniques.Familiarity with regulated quality systems such as ISO or GMP standards.Previous involvement in materials testing, quality labs, or manufacturing support operations.

Work Environment

The role is primarily laboratory-based and involves routine interaction with chemicals, analytical equipment, and standard safety practices. The position may require standing for extended periods and occasional handling or lifting of materials (30-50 pounds). The work environment is within a foam manufacturing facility that operates under a union.

Job Type & Location

This is a Contract position based out of Jessup, MD.

Pay And Benefits

The pay range for this position is $28.00 - $28.00/hr.

Full time

Hybrid model

Job Summary

One Trust Cybersecurity Architect GRC will design and enhance governance risk and compliance frameworks that protect enterprise assets and data while aligning with regulatory expectations and business strategies. The role focuses on OneTrust enablement risk management practices and integration of controls into cards and payments processes where relevant within a hybrid work model for a large global organization.

Design comprehensive governance risk and compliance architectures that align enterprise security objectives with regulatory obligations and industry best practices while supporting sustainable business growth and resilience across global operations. -Develop and maintain integrated risk management methodologies that use OneTrust and other approved tools to continuously identify assess and prioritize technology and business risks across applications infrastructure and data flows. -Configure and optimize OneTrust capabilities to support policy management risk registers issue tracking and automated workflows enabling efficient handling of cybersecurity GRC activities across diverse stakeholder groups.

exposure compliance status and remediation progress using data generated from OneTrust and complementary risk tools. -Guide cross functional teams through formal risk assessments and control testing cycles ensuring that identified gaps are analyzed prioritized and resolved within agreed timelines and that lessons learned inform future design decisions. -Collaborate with technology and business teams in cards and payments functions when applicable to translate transaction processing requirements and regulatory constraints into secure architectures with robust governance mechanisms. -Coordinate hybrid model working practices for GRC initiatives by defining collaboration routines documentation standards and review cadences that support effective outcomes without requiring travel. -Drive continuous improvement of cybersecurity GRC processes by evaluating emerging threats regulatory changes and technology advancements and by proposing pragmatic enhancements that strengthen enterprise defenses and trust. -Provide structured guidance and knowledge sharing to risk owners system architects and product teams on practical application of GRC principles so that responsibilities are clear and actions lead to measurable reduction in risk. -Champion alignment of cybersecurity GRC activities with the organization purpose by promoting practices that protect customer data support secure digital services and contribute to broader societal confidence in technology driven transactions. -Coordinate day shift activities among stakeholders so that GRC projects risk reviews and compliance reporting are delivered on schedule and support reliable business operations in all served regions

rows.title: Marketing and Social Media Project Coordinator
rows.descriptionText:
Location: Telecommute

Job Type: Contract

Compensation Range: $34 - 36 per hour

Our client, a prominent HR professional association, is seeking an entry level Marketing/Social Project Coordinator (Contract-to-Hire) to fill an immediate resource gap on their marketing team. Reporting directly to the VP of Marketing, this individual contributor will serve as an essential project management and execution engine across a wide variety of marketing initiatives. The position is highly hands-on and tactical, designed for an energetic, organized "sponge" who is eager to learn, wear multiple hats, and take daily operational work off the leadership team's plate. For a high-performing candidate who demonstrates a bias for action and a passion for B2B communications, there is a distinct path for this contract role to convert into a permanent, full-time position.

Responsibilities:

Project Management & Organization: Serve as the central coordinator for over 25 concurrent marketing projects and campaigns-including membership launches, event rollouts, and agency deliverables-tracking timelines and ensuring no deliverables fall through the cracks.Podcast & Agency Coordination: Oversee the operational workflow for the association's podcast series and agency partners, coordinating inputs, assets, and reviews for short-form video clips and social deliverables.Email Drafts & Coordination: Draft initial copy and coordinate content inputs with internal stakeholders for high-frequency daily email communications.Website Content Updates: Perform routine updates on the public website by adding webinars, events, and new content using established step-by-step checklists (no coding required).Social Media & Short-Form Video: Draft and schedule LinkedIn posts and assist with social-first short-form video creation, bringing an eye for compelling, engaging visual content.AI Tool Integration: Leverage internal AI tools (such as Claude) to assist with drafting copy, generating social posts, and streamlining repetitive tactical workflows, applying critical human review and editing prior to publishing.Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a reliable liaison between internal teams, external agency partners, and executive stakeholders to keep projects moving forward smoothly.


Qualifications:

Experience & Background: 0-2 years of hands-on marketing experience, including internships, campus media roles, or freelance work. An Associate or Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Business, or a related field is preferred.Project Management Mindset: Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to juggle multiple moving parts, prioritize tasks, and maintain momentum across shifting priorities.Communication & Writing: Strong writing and proofreading abilities with an understanding of (or interest in learning) a sophisticated B2B corporate tone for high-level executive audiences.Social & Video Intuition: Active familiarity with social platforms (especially LinkedIn) and a natural eye for short-form video content creation and storytelling.Tech Comfort & Adaptability: Resourceful mindset with a willingness to get into the back end of systems (such as website CMS tools or Monday.com/Asana) and experiment with new software or AI platforms.Key Soft Skills: High energy, coachable, highly detail-oriented, and excited to learn all aspects of marketing in a nimble B2B environment.Work Location & Hours: 100% Fully Remote; candidates must be aligned with and operate on Eastern Time (ET) working hours.

rows.title: Manager, Data Science - US Card Customer Management
rows.descriptionText:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.

Team Description

As part of the US Card data science organization, this team focuses on the customer management business, and builds top tier machine learning solutions to meet the various needs such as real-time customer behavioral prediction and valuation forecasts. We work in a team environment, collaborating closely with cross-functioning teams including the business, engineers, analysts, data science/quants, products.

Role Description

In this role, you will:

Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers loveLeverage a broad stack of technologies — Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more — to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual dataBuild machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementationFlex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals

The Ideal Candidate is:

Customer first. You love the process of analyzing and creating, but also share our passion to do the right thing. You know at the end of the day it’s about making the right decision for our customers. Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. Technical. You’re comfortable with open-source languages and are passionate about developing further. You have hands-on experience developing data science solutions using open-source tools and cloud computing platforms. Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. A data guru. “Big data” doesn’t faze you. You have the skills to retrieve, combine, and analyze data from a variety of sources and structures. You know understanding the data is often the key to great data science. 

Basic Qualifications:

Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 6 years of experience performing data analyticsA Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration plus 4 years of experience performing data analyticsA PhD in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 1 year of experience performing data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience leveraging open source programming languages for large scale data analysisAt least 1 year of experience working with machine learningAt least 1 year of experience utilizing relational databases

Preferred Qualifications:

PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) plus 3 years of experience in data analyticsAt least 1 year of experience working with AWSAt least 4 years’ experience in Python, Scala, or R for large scale data analysisAt least 4 years’ experience with machine learningAt least 4 years’ experience with SQL

Overview

Please note that this position is contingent upon the successful award of a contract currently under bid.

Goldbelt Apex, a part of the Healthcare Technology Transformation Group, is a data-focused company dedicated to process and quality in every aspect. As experts in healthcare IT experts, Apex is committed to building systems for healthcare organizations to seamlessly communicate and exchange data across different systems and devices.

Summary:

The Junior Data Analyst will support data collection, data cleanup, quality checks, spreadsheets/databases, charts and tables, recurring reports, survey data, and ad hoc analytical requests.

Personnel are assigned in support of DHHQ in Falls Church, VA, but may work from the contractor facility or remotely when authorized.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

Collect, compile, organize, and prepare data from multiple program sources for analysis and reporting.Perform routine data cleanup and quality checks to identify missing, inconsistent, duplicate, or inaccurate information.Enter, update, and maintain program data in spreadsheets, databases, and other approved data systems.Assist with maintaining the SCAADL Microsoft Access database and historical enrollment and participation information.Prepare recurring weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reports using established procedures and reporting formats.Assist with preparing ad hoc reports and data requests, including raw data, charts, graphs, and tables.Develop basic charts, graphs, tables, and other data visualizations to support program reporting and presentations.Assist with analyzing DES and SCAADL program data, including population changes, participation, timeliness, and other established performance measures.Assist with compiling and reviewing data for DES and SCAADL performance reports and other program deliverables.Support survey data activities by collecting, cleaning, organizing, and reviewing survey results for accuracy and completeness.Assist with IDES satisfaction survey activities, including preparing survey data, reports, graphs, and related materials.Pull MEB and PEB cohort lists from VTA and assist with reviewing data for accuracy, completeness, and survey eligibility.Assist with identifying and documenting data quality issues in program-related systems and escalating issues to the appropriate personnel.Assist with system data support activities, including data validation, user acceptance testing, and documentation of identified issues.Maintain documentation and established procedures related to recurring reports and data processes.Assist senior analysts with gathering data, validating information, preparing analytical materials, and responding to Government data requests.Coordinate with team members and Government personnel to obtain and clarify data needed for assigned reporting and analytical tasks.Provide other support as needed.

rows.title: Information Technology & Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
Description

Do you enjoy solving complex problems at the intersection of technology and data to support mission-critical operations?

If so, we are looking for someone like you to join our team at APL.

Recognized as one of Computerworld’s Top Places to Work in IT for seven consecutive years, APL is seeking an Information Technology & Data Analyst to support enterprise IT systems and leverage data to drive informed decision-making across the organization.

This role serves as a critical bridge between business needs and technical solutions, ensuring systems are secure, reliable, and aligned with organizational and mission requirements.

Position Summary

The Information Technology & Data Analyst bridges the gap between data, technology, and policy by transforming complex data into actionable insights and ensuring accurate, policy-aligned data capture. This role designs, develops, and supports dashboards, tools, and IT systems to enable effective data use across the organization.

Responsibilities include analyzing, designing, implementing, and maintaining IT systems, as well as collecting, normalizing, and analyzing complex datasets to identify trends, develop visualizations, and deliver insights that support operational and strategic decision-making.

rows.title: GTM Data Analyst
rows.descriptionText:
MarginEdge is hiring an Analyst to build out go-to-market analytics: pipeline and conversion reporting, coverage and capacity modeling, commission calculation, and the analysis leadership uses to decide where to put money and headcount.

The enticing part of this role is that you own the whole path. You'll help frame the question, write the SQL, build the model, put it in source control, and present the answer — and the version you build is the one the company keeps using. There's no analytics team you hand a spec to. That's the trade: you have to be technical enough to build it, and you get to skip the six weeks of translation.

You'll report to the Director of Data Platform and Analytics and sit inside the data team, with Revenue Operations as your primary stakeholder. Your work gets reviewed by people who care whether the model is sound, and your roadmap comes from what the revenue organization actually needs. You'll work regularly with the Director of Revenue Operations, the CRO, and FP&A — more direct exposure to how revenue decisions get made than this kind of role usually carries.

We care much more about how you think and what you can build than where you've worked. Consulting, finance, RevOps, a BI seat at a smaller company, a science or engineering background you've since pointed at data problems — all fine.

MarginEdge: Where hospitality meets technology

As a team built by former (and current!) restaurant operators, our mission is to bring operators the same energy, attention to detail, and passion that they bring to their guests. Our culture is deeply rooted in service, partially because that’s where so many of our team come from (including everyone on our Business Development team), but also because we believe it is just the right way to run a business. We design our software with profound empathy for the complexity of running a restaurant, and the goal of making the magic just a little easier for operators by taking the complex (read: very annoying) back office tasks off their plate, while empowering them with real-time data.

Our founders share a deep history in both owning and operating restaurants and in building successful tech companies. We are venture-backed and serve 12,000+ restaurants across the US and Canada.

We enable restaurants to make magic while knowing we are doing the same for them.

We have the utmost respect for our clients and because of this, we are unable to hire their current employees.

What type of responsibilities will I have?

Build the analysis that decides things.

Build the analysis behind weekly pipeline reviews, forecast reviews, monthly business reviews, and sales board reporting, and take over more of it as you ramp.Own stage-to-stage conversion reporting: conversion rates, cycle times, and win rates by channel, team, segment, and product.Build assumption-based models for strategic initiatives — new segments, pricing changes, channel bets — with the assumptions parameterized rather than buried in a formula.Help run and extend the coverage and capacity models: work the revenue target back to the pipeline and headcount required, and flag the gap early enough that leadership can act on it.Contribute to the pipeline-based bottoms-up forecast and its reconciliation against the sales team commitment and the top-down model.Investigate the unglamorous questions — why a cohort converted worse than the one before it, why cycle time moved in one segment and not another — and bring them to leadership before you're asked.

Build the thing that answers them next quarter.

Build and maintain the GTM layer of our dbt project: funnel and conversion models, pipeline history, rep and territory attribution.Ship through source control — branch, pull request, review, tests, documentation. Your code gets reviewed, and eventually you'll review other people's.Reconcile Salesforce, subscription billing, and product usage data, and become the person who can explain precisely why they disagree when they do.Help define GTM metrics in our semantic layer, with RevOps as the metric owner, so self-service and agent-based querying return governed numbers rather than someone's best guess.

Use AI as a real tool and check its work.

Use Claude for query drafting, model scaffolding, and analysis iteration, and help RevOps stakeholders get useful work out of it.QA AI output seriously: know what the query actually did, catch the plausible-but-wrong answer, and be able to explain the mechanism behind a finding rather than repeating it.

What qualifications or skills are required?

Demonstrated professional experience doing analytical work where you were expected to structure some of the problem yourself, not just execute a spec.Strong SQL. CTEs, joins, and window functions should be comfortable. More importantly, when a query returns a number that looks wrong, you find out why rather than running it again.Working knowledge of source control — branches, commits, pull requests. You don't need to have worked on a large codebase, but if your instinct is to build in a shared spreadsheet, this role will frustrate you.Enough curiosity about how data gets where it is to reason about where a number came from and when it last landed. You won't own ingestion.Real spreadsheet skill. A lot of what you produce lands in Excel in front of an executive, and you should be able to build a multi-tab model someone else can follow and extend.The ability to say the number is wrong to a room that would prefer it weren't, and an obsession with accuracy that survives deadline pressure.Funnel and SaaS metrics: conversion rate, pipeline coverage, cycle time, gross and net retention, CAC, payback. If you already know what breaks each one, great. If not, you'll learn them here, and you should be able to explain them by month three.

Nice To Haves

dbt — Core, project structure, tests, macros. If you've built tested, version-controlled transformation logic some other way, say so.Trino/Athena or Snowflake. We're mid-migration, so you'd see both.Python for the analysis SQL shouldn't do.Salesforce as a data source, including the parts of it that lie to you.Subscription billing data (Zuora or similar), quota setting, territory design, or sales compensation modeling.Semantic or metrics layer experience (MetricFlow, Cube, or similar).BI development in Preset/Superset, Looker, Tableau, or comparable.

Compensation: The anticipated salary range for this role is $90,000–$110,000 annually. Where a candidate falls within that range depends on a variety of factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus opportunities and our comprehensive benefits package.

What’s it like to work for MarginEdge? 

Imagine the fun of a great restaurant - surrounded by a team of people (including some that you help to manage!) who care about hospitality, care about quality, and care about each other - then subtract the long nights, weekends, drunk customers at the bar...et voila, MarginEdge!

We work hard, we work fast and we fuel our work with a commitment of transparency from leadership, straight talk and trust between teams. We believe that the best people do their best work when they feel empowered - so whether you are remote or in our office (likely eating a catered lunch from our clients in our baller, brand new penthouse HQ in Ballston) you get to work with your manager to call your shot on what works best for you. Did we mention it has a full commercial kitchen and is walking distance (covered walking, that is) from the metro?

Benefits (Shut The Front Door, They Are Amazing)

In order to fuel this rocket ship, we need to build a team as passionate about our work and product as we are. We believe that top talent (that’s you!) should feel deeply connected to their work, appreciated for the time they give to building our organization and have the balance necessary to give their best during work hours and all those after-hours too. We do this by offering a suite of kick ass benefits not only to be competitive and catch the eye of super smart people (that’s you again!) but also provide the foundation for a career you love and a life outside of work you love just as much.

Unlimited Paid Time Off (and we mean it, we encourage your healthy work life balance!)Medical, Dental, Vision, and Short/Long-Term Disability Insurance (preventative care for the win)Health Savings Account with employer match (dependent upon your medical plan selection)Commuter benefits with employer contribution (excluding limos and helos - for now)Generous Life Insurance PlanShort- and Long-term DisabilityCompany-Paid Holidays401(k) and matchingStock Options to buy into everything we are doing to support this industry12-week fully Paid Parental LeaveLunch catered twice a week at our HQ in Arlington (we exclusively cater from our clients, too!A wellness program that sponsors healthy activities such as step challenges and provides discounts to gyms and fitness classes.

Check out our 100% “Recommend to a Friend” rating from anonymous employee reviews on Glassdoor.

Oh, and our recognition in the Washington Post as a top small businesses to work for in 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025!

And most important, what our customers think about our work on Capterra and G2 Crowd.

Our Fine Print is Bold: We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran, marital, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law. You be you. While we are proudest of our commitment to exceptional culture and creating a truly excellent work environment, we see our benefits as an extension of that belief. Our benefits package is designed to be exceptionally competitive and a reflection of our commitment to a best-in-class workplace for all.

As a team built by former (and current!) restaurant operators, our goal to bring our clients the same energy, attention to detail and passion that they give their guests. Our culture is deeply rooted in service—partially because that’s where we came from but also because we believe it's the right way to run a business. We design our software with profound empathy for the complexity of running a restaurant.

Our dream is to make the magic just a little easier for operators and their teams. We believe in crazy things like knowing how much waste your kitchen is producing and what your total spend is during the period. Solving these kinds of problems is really freaking hard to do, which is why we develop cutting-edge technology that answers these questions with data science.

Job Description

Westat is a leader in research, data collection and analysis, technical assistance, evaluation, and communications. At Two Six Technologies, we build, deploy, and implement innovative products that solve the world’s most complex challenges today. Through unrivaled collaboration and unwavering trust, we push the boundaries of what’s possible to empower our team and support our customers in building a safer global future.

Job Title: Technical Lab AssociateJob Description

The Technical Laboratory Associate plays a key role in supporting laboratory-based research, process development, and manufacturing support functions. This position focuses on hands-on testing, analytical evaluation, and verification of materials to ensure consistency with defined requirements.
