rows.title: R&D Domain Specialist – Research Technology & Innovation Associate Consultant (Discovery)
rows.descriptionText:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

As a R&D Domain Specialist – Research Technology & Innovation Associate Consultant in Discovery, you will apply your pharma R&D domain knowledge, consulting skills, and research technology experience to help clients improve and streamline drug discovery workflows at leading biotech and biopharma organizations.

ZS’s Discovery Venture partners with clients to develop and deploy in silico approaches that accelerate the discovery of safer, more effective therapeutics. We work closely with other ZS practices, bringing hands-on scientific expertise to enhance both technology and strategy initiatives. As a Venture within ZS, we continuously develop, test, and refine new approaches to maximize impact for our clients and the patients they serve. This unique position enables us to combine agility and innovation with the resources and knowledge of ZS’s 13,000+ global team. ZS is expanding the Discovery Venture and seeking driven, curious, and creative experts to help shape the practice area, collaborate across ZS’s R&D teams, and deliver excellent outcomes for clients.

What you’ll do:

Lead structured discovery interviews and workshops with scientists, business stakeholders, and IT teams to understand current challenges, workflows, and technology needs. Own current- and future-state workflow documentation, including process maps, requirements documentation, and structured outputs that inform solution design. Translate scientific and business needs into actionable requirements, structured problem statements, and roadmap inputs. Apply hands-on experience with research technology systems and advanced analytics to improve and streamline drug discovery processes. Support clients across R&D workflows, with a focus on research technology platforms, data enablement, and scientific process improvement. Develop strategy-level outputs independently, including findings, recommendations, workflow assessments, and roadmap materials. Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams, including scientists, business partners, IT stakeholders, data scientists, and project managers, to integrate research technology and analytics into broader project objectives. Support client readouts with evidence-based presentations and clearly communicate analysis findings, recommendations, and next steps. Lead modules and workstreams within projects while contributing to hands-on implementation and solution development. Contribute to the assessment of emerging datasets, technologies, and platforms that impact drug discovery. Serve as a subject matter expert in research technology, analytics, or a relevant discovery domain to drive innovation, mentor colleagues, and share knowledge across teams. 

What you’ll bring:

Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree strongly preferred, ideally in Life Sciences, Business Administration, Health Informatics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, MIS, or a related field; PhD in a pharma-relevant domain is a plus. At least 2.5 years of relevant professional experience, ideally in consulting, CRO, pharma, biotech, or research technology environmentsDemonstrated pharma domain knowledge, including familiarity with R&D workflows and drug discovery processes. Experience with large molecule or antibody discovery and in vitro and in vivo preclinical development is strongly preferred. Familiarity with more novel hybrid modalities is a plus. Experience gathering, documenting, and translating business, scientific, and technical requirements using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and Visio. Experience developing process maps and current- and future-state workflows. Ability to translate scientific needs into structured problem statements, actionable requirements, and roadmap inputs. Strong cross-functional stakeholder engagement experience, including collaboration with scientific teams, business partners, and senior IT stakeholders. Data analysis fundamentals, including experience with tools such as SQL, Excel, and/or SAS. Familiarity with research and enterprise platforms such as ERP, LIMS, or ELN systems. Light project management experience, including the ability to manage workstreams, track deliverables, and coordinate across stakeholders. Proficiency in at least one programming language, agile product development, and/or project management techniques is preferred. Evidence of a strong commitment to quality and client satisfaction. Excellent communication, presentation, and team leadership skills, with an eagerness for feedback and continuous improvement. Passion, curiosity, and a growth mindset, coupled with a deep commitment to an open and collaborative working environment. Fluency in EnglishClient-first mentalityIntense work ethicCollaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathwaysMilestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunitiesInternal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States, visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

To complete your application:

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

Find Out More At:

www.zs.com

rows.title: Salesforce Associate Consultant

parsed.text: South San Francisco, CA, United States

rows.descriptionText:
ZS is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by bringing together data, science, technology and human ingenuity to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a client-first mentality to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

What you’ll do: Business Technoogy Associate Consultant in the Digital Products & Solutions Practice Area will…

Digital Products & Solutions team helps organizations in their digital transformation journey by transforming last-mile experiences. We are uniquely positioned to bring together deep domain, analytics, technology/platform, and consulting expertise, with a strong focus on innovation and design. The Salesforce service line focuses on redefining how life sciences organizations engage HCPs, patients, caregivers, and payers, and on reengineering the commercial, medical, and patient-services processes behind those journeys. We collaborate with CSTs and practice areas to develop innovative domain solutions by infusing analytics and AI. We continue to be a preferred Salesforce implementation and innovation partner for our clients and have significantly scaled our expertise across Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, Data Cloud, CRM Analytics, and Agentforce. With Life Sciences Cloud now anchoring CRM roadmaps across pharma, biotech, and medtech — and many clients actively reassessing their commercial platform — this is a rare opportunity to shape an industry-defining transition from the front line.

What You’ll Do: 

Translate commercial, medical, and patient-services business needs into Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud and Health Cloud solution designs — spanning HCP engagement and rep productivity, call planning and multichannel cycle plans, sample management, patient support and hub services, and clinical trial participant engagement. Run requirements and fit-gap workshops with commercial operations, medical affairs, patient services, and IT stakeholders; document as-is/to-be process flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria that development teams can build against. Design the data model and configuration approach across core life sciences objects — HCP/HCO accounts and affiliations, territory alignments, product hierarchies, interactions, consent and channel preferences — making deliberate calls on out-of-the-box versus custom. Shape integrations with the life sciences data ecosystem: customer master/MDM and data change request workflows, third-party reference and prescription data, approved content from Vault or equivalent DAM, and API/MuleSoft orchestration with ERP, MDM, and analytics platforms. Support Veeva CRM to Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud migration assessments — capability mapping, data and content migration strategy, field-force impact, and phased roadmap definition. Bring Data Cloud, Einstein, and Agentforce into the solution: unified HCP and patient profiles, next-best-action for field teams, patient journey orchestration, and agentic assistants for field, service, and hub users. Embed compliance by design — HIPAA and GDPR, GxP and 21 CFR Part 11 expectations, computer system validation, PhRMA Code, Sunshine Act/Open Payments spend capture, PDMA sample accountability, and consent and opt-in management. Partner with solution architects and development teams through build, SIT and UAT, validation, deployment, and hypercare, staying accountable for functional quality throughoutOwn a workstream end to end — scope, plan, timeline, risks, and deliverable quality — and flag issues to leadership early with a recommended path forward. Structure ambiguous client problems into hypothesis-driven analyses, and build the storyline and executive-ready deliverables that carry the recommendation. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and steering committee updates; explain technical trade-offs and their business implications to non-technical audiences. Build business cases and value realization frameworks — adoption, rep productivity, patient onboarding cycle time, cost to serve — and track benefits post go-live. Drive adoption and change management: persona definition, training, communications, super-user enablement, and adoption dashboards. Coach analysts and associates, review their work, and manage day-to-day client relationships with judgment about what to escalate. Contribute to practice building — proposals and RFP responses, reusable accelerators and demo assets, points of view, and recruiting. 

What You’ll Bring:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, IT, engineering, or a related discipline; candidates with a life sciences or business background and strong technology aptitude are also encouraged to apply. Required: 3+ years of relevant consulting experience, including hands-on Salesforce consulting and implementation experience.Exposure to Veeva CRM or Vault CRM, and to the considerations involved in migrating off it — strongly preferred. Salesforce Administrator certification expected; Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Platform App Builder, or Agentforce credentials are strongly preferred. Experience in working with healthcare companies (Pharma, Life Sciences, Med Tech, etc.) and knowledge of industry-specific challenges is preferred.Fluency in EnglishClient-first mentalityIntense work ethicCollaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

How you’ll grow:

Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathwaysMilestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunitiesInternal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

Perks & Benefits:

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in United States, visit ZS US office locations | Where we work | ZS.

Hybrid working model:

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel:

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.

Considering applying?

At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.

If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.

ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.

Work Authorization:

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Candidates must have authorization to work in the United States that does not now or in the future require employer sponsorship.

To complete your application:

An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.

NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.

Find Out More At:

www.zs.com

rows.title: Lead Solutions Engineer, Apps & Gaming
rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities
The Solutions Engineering team is a specialized team that is in control of the relationship between TikTok advertising clients. The team is looking for engineers with an entrepreneurial mindset and the voice of the market. The team is made up of creative problem solvers and strategic software engineers who work with clients to understand their problems and develop solutions. We work at the intersection of business and engineering to assist TikTok's marketing and advertising partners to flourish and achieve their business goals by developing technology solutions that fit their demands.

As a Lead Solution Engineer, you will help to partner with different business verticals and enable the full potential of new features, products, and business opportunities. You will be working and supporting cross-functional teams of R&D, Customer Success, and Product Management. This role allows you to use TikTok's platforms and community to solve real-world business problems.

Responsibilities:
- Lead the design and development of scalable, production-grade solutions in collaboration with TikTok Product Engineering teams to meet evolving business and client needs.
- Act as a technical leader and subject matter expert across the Solutions Engineering organization, providing architectural guidance and driving engineering excellence.
- Understand, apply and use TikTok's products and innovative technology, identify, develop, and maximize new and existing commercial prospects with advertising clients.
- Cultivate close partnerships with the customer success team to identify potential business opportunities and support them in achieving business goals.
- Design and build end-to-end systems and launch-plan strategies; launch production-level code, with an emphasis on long-term maintainability and scalability with applicable documentation and test plans, in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
- Identify stakeholders independently and align cross-functional partners toward project completion goals.
- Build and cultivate relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
- Using Data to influence decision-making through the presentation of business value and impact.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or above, majoring in Computer Science or related fields
- 5+ years of experience in software development, technical solutions design and delivery
- 3+ years of experience in a technical leadership role
- Familiarity with one or more general-purpose programming languages (e.g. Python, Go, Java, C/C++) and API/backend systems design
- Hands-on experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., production model training and deployment, model evaluation, tuning/optimization, data pipeline processing, and debugging production issues).
- Demonstrated ability to tailor your presentation to the audience's technical level and comfort delivering technical subjects to groups of any size or background
- Experience in advertising technology working with large volume data analytics.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with mobile application development and advertising across iOS/Android
- Experience with machine learning frameworks and libraries such as TensorFlow or Keras

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

As part of the People Risk, Privacy & Compliance team, the Immigration Program Manager (UK) will serve as our most senior in-house subject matter expert on UK immigration compliance, with broader responsibility for supporting Rest of World (non-US) immigration workstreams. This is a senior individual contributor role operating with significant autonomy: you will set the direction of the UK immigration program, provide definitive counsel on the most complex and precedent-setting matters, and influence organisational strategy.Your primary focus is optimising UK immigration processes across insourced and outsourced operations, owning compliance and audit readiness, and staying ahead of regulatory change. You will also act as a senior partner to the wider ROW immigration program, bringing consistency, risk frameworks, and vendor governance to a multi-country footprint.

Program Manager, Global Immigration Responsibilities:

Act as the definitive subject matter expert and escalation point for UK immigration compliance, and as a senior advisor on ROW (non-US) immigration mattersSet the UK immigration compliance strategy and roadmapidentify policy and process gaps, draft revisions, and drive implementation across teams and vendorsMonitor regulatory change across the UK and ROW, assess strategic and operational impact, and land the resulting policy and process changesOwn vendor strategy and governance for immigration providers and shared services teams, holding partners to a high bar of employee, manager, and stakeholder experienceprovide direction to team members and vendor resources without formal people management accountabilityDefine program metrics and use complex data sets to report on compliance health, risk indicators, and vendor performance to senior leadershipPartner with Legal, HR, Recruiting, Payroll, Global Mobility, and business leadersinfluence through credibility and trust rather than positional authority, and be sought out as the expert across the organisationProvide critical expertise for corporate development activity such as mergers, acquisitions, and entity or footprint changesIdentify, scope, and take ownership of emerging compliance problems as the team and company evolve, exercising independent judgement on approach and solution

Minimum Qualifications:

10+ years of experience in immigration, employment compliance, or people compliance, including in-house program leadership at a large-scale organisation or equivalent law firm/consultancy experienceDeep, authoritative expertise in UK immigration: Skilled Worker and Global Business Mobility routes, sponsor licence duties and reporting, right to work, record-keeping, and Home Office compliance visits and auditsExperience supporting immigration across multiple non-US jurisdictions, and comfort in operating where guidance is ambiguous or precedent does not yet existTrack record of setting strategy and driving large-scale, cross-functional programs from conception to implementationDemonstrated data analytics expertise, and the ability to set technical direction for peers on complex projectsExperience using AI tools and technology to streamline compliance workflows, improve efficiency, or enhance decision-makingStrong working knowledge of adjacent frameworks - employment law, data privacy (e.g. GDPR), and workforce regulatory requirementsExperience influencing senior leadership and implementing industry-standard practices across vendors, able to make complex immigration matters clear and actionableExperience making autonomous, high-judgement decisions, and spotting emerging issues before they escalateExceptional attention to detail and accuracy with highly confidential dataExcellent communication skills, handling sensitive matters with tact and diplomacy. Ability to travel occasionally as needed for cross-site engagement

Preferred Qualifications:

Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologiesExperience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)Bachelor's degree in law, Human Resources, compliance, or a related fieldDepth in one or more additional jurisdictions (e.g. EU member states, APAC) and experience supporting multi-country mobility populationsExperience managing outside counsel and outsourced immigration providers at scale

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about  benefits  at Meta.

rows.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Generative AI (Image & Video)
rows.descriptionText:

We’re deeply committed to the well-being of everyone in our global community, which is why our values are at the root of everything we do. We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join the Consumer Gen AI Product MLE team at Snap!

rows.title: Data Scientist - Macro
rows.descriptionText:
Qube Research & Technologies (QRT) is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager, operating in all liquid asset classes across the world. We are a technology and data driven group implementing a scientific approach to investing. Combining data, research, technology, and trading expertise has shaped QRT’s collaborative mindset which enables us to solve the most complex challenges. QRT’s culture of innovation continuously drives our ambition to deliver high quality returns for our investors.
You will work at the intersection of financial markets, data science and engineering, supporting the discovery, evaluation and integration of financial datasets used across quantitative research and trading. The role combines technical expertise with an understanding of Macro markets, working closely with Quantitative Researchers, Portfolio Managers and Traders to translate business requirements into practical data solutions. You will engage directly with external data providers, assess existing data assets and identify opportunities to expand the firm's data capabilities.
Your future role within QRTCollaborate with Quantitative Researchers, Portfolio Managers and Traders to understand their data requirements and identify suitable datasets for research and trading strategiesEvaluate existing data assets and external vendor offerings, assessing coverage, quality, consistency and suitability for specific financial applicationsManage the discovery, evaluation and onboarding of new datasets, with a focus on Macro markets, including Rates, bonds, swaps, derivatives and alternative dataEngage directly with external data providers to understand their offerings, assess APIs and investigate data availability, structure and delivery mechanismsDevelop Python tools and data pipelines to extract, clean, normalise and analyse financial datasets from multiple sourcesInvestigate discrepancies across data providers, including differences in instrument identifiers, pricing conventions, timestamps and reference dataMaintain and improve the quality and consistency of existing datasets, proactively resolving issues and identifying opportunities to enhance data coverageCollaborate with engineering teams to automate data ingestion, validation and integration processes, ensuring reliable delivery into research and trading environments
Your present skillsetMinimum 2 years of relevant professional experience in Data Science, Data Analysis, Data Engineering or a similar role within financial marketsPractical understanding of financial markets and instruments, with exposure to Macro, Fixed Income, Rates, Credit or related asset classesStrong Python programming skills, including experience with data analysis libraries such as Pandas and NumPyGood SQL skills and experience working with structured financial datasetsExperience sourcing, analysing and processing financial data, with an understanding of data quality, validation and consistency across multiple sourcesAbility to understand financial concepts and communicate effectively with Quantitative Researchers, Portfolio Managers, Traders and external data vendorsStrong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to investigate unfamiliar datasets and identify appropriate solutions independentlyFamiliarity with external data providers, financial data platforms and API integrationAbility to manage competing priorities, take ownership of data initiatives and collaborate effectively across technical and business functionsDegree in a quantitative discipline such as Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Engineering or Finance; a postgraduate qualification is beneficialExperience developing data pipelines, automating data workflows or supporting production data infrastructure is beneficialKnowledge of financial data concepts such as yield curves, instrument reference data, market data and pricing conventions is advantageous
QRT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity as essential to our success. QRT empowers employees to work openly and respectfully to achieve collective success. In addition to professional achievement, we are offering initiatives and programs to enable employees achieve a healthy work-life balance.

rows.title: Manager, Environmental Health & Safety, Specs Operations
rows.descriptionText:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

We're looking for an experienced Environmental Health & Safety (EHS) Manager, to provide strategic leadership for EHS programs across Specs Operations. This role will establish and drive a unified EHS strategy, ensure regulatory compliance, strengthen risk management programs, and foster a world-class safety culture across manufacturing, R&D, engineering, and operational environments.

This position serves as the EHS leader for Specs Operations in EMEA, with responsibility for EHS strategy, governance, and program execution across the Abingdon (UK), Chandler (Arizona) and other EMEA Specs locations as business needs evolve.

The role may be based in either London or Abingdon, UK. The successful candidate will be expected to maintain a strong operational presence within the business through regular and significant time spent in Abingdon, partnering closely with site leadership, engineering, manufacturing, facilities, and workplace teams.

The role also requires occasional international travel to Chandler, Arizona and other Specs locations across Europe to support operational initiatives, audits, expansion projects, leadership engagement, and program implementation activities.

What you’ll do:

EHS Strategy & Leadership

Lead the development, governance, and continuous improvement of EHS standards, programs, and strategic initiatives across Specs Operations globally, ensuring consistency while enabling site specific operational requirements. Establish annual EHS objectives, key results, and performance indicators for Abingdon, Chandler, and other assigned Specs locations. Present EHS performance, emerging risks, compliance status, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership and executive stakeholders, enabling informed business and operational decisions. Provide leadership and direction for EHS Specialists, including performance management, coaching, career development, and succession planning. Influence organizational decision making by integrating EHS considerations into operational, engineering, and business planning processes. Build a high performance safety culture focused on accountability, risk reduction, and continuous improvement. 

Governance, Compliance & Risk Management

Own EHS management systems, ensuring alignment with ISO 14001, ISO 45001, HSG65 principles, and Snap corporate standards. Provide strategic oversight of compliance with applicable UK, U.S., and local environmental, health, and safety regulations. Establish governance processes for compliance, auditing, inspections, corrective actions, and management reviews. Lead enterprise-level risk assessments for manufacturing, cleanroom, and R&D operations. Ensure effective management of regulatory obligations, permits, compliance documentation, agency interactions, and external audits. 

Manufacturing, R&D and High-Hazard Program Ownership

Own EHS programs supporting manufacturing, engineering, R&D, cleanroom, facilities, and operational functions. Provide strategic oversight of hazardous materials, hazardous waste, chemical safety, machine safety, contractor safety, laser safety, industrial hygiene, and hazardous gas safety programs. Establish governance and performance standards for hazardous gas systems, including toxic and hazardous gas storage, distribution, monitoring, and emergency response programs. Partner with Engineering, Facilities, Manufacturing, Workplace Services, and Operations leaders to ensure EHS requirements are integrated into facility design, equipment procurement, commissioning, and operational changes. Provide EHS leadership for capital projects, facility expansions, equipment installations, new technologies, and operational scale-up initiatives through proactive risk management and design review. 

Organizational Capability & Culture

Develop EHS competency frameworks, training strategies, and leadership engagement programs for employees, contractors, and leaders. Lead safety committees, emergency response teams, and cross-functional governance forums to strengthen accountability and operational excellence. Promote the sharing of lessons learned, best practices, and standardized methodologies across locations. 

Program Management & Continuous Improvement

Establish EHS maturity assessments and continuous improvement roadmaps. Manage EHS budgets, resource planning, and annual objectives. Utilize data analytics, leading indicators, and risk trends to identify opportunities for operational improvement and risk reduction. Develop business cases and strategic recommendations for EHS investments, staffing, and growth initiatives. 

Incident Management & Emergency Preparedness

Lead investigations of serious incidents, significant near misses, and high potential events across assigned Specs locations. Ensure robust root cause analysis methodologies are applied and corrective actions are effectively implemented and sustained. Oversee emergency preparedness and EHS business continuity programs across assigned Specs locations, ensuring organizational readiness for operational disruptions, emergency events, and EHS business continuity risks. Provide strategic leadership during significant incidents and emergency events, coordinating with site leadership, Security, Workplace Services, and executive stakeholders to support response and recovery efforts. 

Minimum Qualifications: 

Bachelor's degree in Environmental Health & Safety, Engineering, Occupational Health, Environmental Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 10+ years of progressive Environmental Health & Safety experience. 3+ years of people leadership experience managing EHS professionals or leading multi-site EHS programs. Expert knowledge of EHS management systems, regulatory compliance, risk management, and strategic program development in manufacturing, R&D, cleanroom, semiconductor, advanced technology, or hardware development environments. Experience managing EHS programs within manufacturing, R&D, cleanroom, semiconductor, advanced technology, or hardware development environments. Experience leading EHS programs across multiple locations, business units, or regulatory jurisdictionsStrong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to communicate technical and regulatory risks to executive and non-technical audiences. 

Preferred Qualifications:

NEBOSH Diploma (Level 6), CSP, CMIOSH, or equivalent advanced EHS qualification. Experience leading EHS programs across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. Experience leading EHS governance programs within global hardware, manufacturing, semiconductor, or advanced technology organizations. Demonstrated success building EHS organizations during periods of rapid growth, expansion, operational transformation, mergers, acquisitions, or facility growth initiatives.

To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long-term success!

rows.title: Data Analysis & Insights Project Intern (TikTok Shop) - 2026 Start - 2027 Start
rows.descriptionText:
Responsibilities

The TikTok commerce team builds the solutions that help businesses engage audiences, inspire product discovery, and create commercial experiences on a platform where brands and merchants connect meaningfully with creators and communities.

We work closely with merchants, creators, and partners to support sustainable business growth while keeping the experience safe and trusted for the community. As the business scales across global markets, we take on complex challenges across content, commerce, trust, and the differing needs of each local market.

You will help shape the future of AI-native commerce, where discovery, entertainment, and buying happen in the same place.

About The Team

The e-Commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-Commerce experience to our users.

As a Project Intern, you will contribute to impactful short-term projects and gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, professional environment. This internship offers the opportunity to develop practical skills, apply your knowledge to real-world challenges, and explore your career interests.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early.

Responsibilities

 Support project-based goal tracking by monitoring key metrics across merchant and product performance, including sample supply, content output, and sales contribution. Analyze data to identify high-potential merchants and products, helping define the incubation profile and pathway for affiliate-focused sellers. Track and report on sample supply and content creation trends, identifying gaps and opportunities to optimize resource allocation. Assist in preparing weekly reports and analytical materials to summarize business performance and highlight key trends. Contribute to case study development by analyzing merchant and product performance, providing data-backed insights to support Account Managers in merchant outreach and pitch preparation. Help synthesize best practices and develop actionable pathways for merchants to optimize their affiliate investments. Support the consolidation of hit product cases by gathering data and insights from cross-functional teams, including policy resources, merchant BD inputs, and match-making incubation cases. Assist in quantifying the value of hit products by analyzing metrics such as sustained GMV growth contribution, merchant tier upgrades, and overall store GMV impact. Help document and communicate the methodology behind hit product incubation—for example, the correlation between sample investments, content volume, creator partnerships, and product success—to educate merchants and Account Managers on best practices.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s)

 Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree Available to start immediately until the end of the year Highly interested in the e-Commerce industry, with strong curiosity and the ability to learn quickly, and understand the short video/content and live broadcast ecosystems of TikTok. Proficient in Excel/Lark Sheets, with basic data analysis skills

Preferred Qualification(s)

 Be mindful of data and be able to proficiently use at least one data visualization analysis tool. Previous experience in influencer affiliate, content strategy, or e-Commerce operations will be highly valued. Programming or coding skills are a plus; interest in leveraging internal and external tools and models to explore AI-powered solutions for operational work is highly preferred.

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

rows.title: Applications Engineer, Level 3
rows.descriptionText:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.

We’re looking for a Full Stack Application Engineer to join our Finance Technology team. You’ll help build and operate business-critical applications that connect Finance, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing, supporting hardware development and production from planning and procurement through inventory, costing, and financial reporting.

This is an end-to-end engineering role where you’ll work with experienced engineers and business partners to turn operational needs into reliable software. You’ll contribute across the development lifecycle from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support while growing your knowledge of enterprise systems and finance and manufacturing workflows.

What you’ll do:

Develop, test, deploy, and support secure and scalable web applications and services used by Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Operations teams. Deliver well-defined features across the full stack, including user interfaces, APIs, business logic, data models, integrations, and automated tests. Help develop and maintain integrations among ERP, MRP, MES, PLM, warehouse, procurement, finance, and analytics platforms using APIs, events, and batch processing. Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions. Monitor application health, investigate issues, and contribute to improvements in performance, reliability, and operational support. Participate in design reviews, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, and documentation to maintain high engineering standards. Learn from teammates, share knowledge, and contribute to an inclusive and collaborative engineering culture. 

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

Full-stack development skills using JavaScript or TypeScript and experience with a modern front-end framework such as React, Angular, or Vue. Experience developing backend services or APIs using a language such as Java, Python, Go, or Node.js. Understanding of software design fundamentals, data structures, object-oriented programming, web application architecture, and common integration patterns. Familiarity with REST APIs, relational databases, SQL, and integrations with SaaS or enterprise platforms. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into maintainable technical solutions with guidance. Strong problem-solving skills and an interest in learning unfamiliar technologies and business domains. Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and non-engineering partners. A sense of ownership for the quality, reliability, and user experience of the software you build.

rows.title: Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure Software Systems
rows.descriptionText:
The Meta Infra Technical Program Management (TPM) community is pioneering technologies to bring people and businesses closer together at a global scale. Infra TPMs are the enablers for our toughest business strategies to become technical realities, requiring direct and close partnership with both Engineering and Product teams to make products come to life with incredible scale, reliability, and efficiency.Meta's infrastructure software stack is being upgraded for a world where the primary consumer of our platforms is an agent, not a human at a terminal, and our core infrastructure stack is being upgraded for the rigor, speed, and scale required of modern training, inferencing, and app development. These shifts change how we design APIs and interfaces, how we onboard and support internal and external partners, how we plan features, and how we measure adoption and success. We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to own that transformation for a major surface of Meta's Infra software stack.In this role, you will partner with Engineering and Product leadership to shape the technical roadmap for the platforms you own, drive the design and rollout of the interfaces those platforms expose, and own end-to-end delivery and adoption with the partner teams who build on top of them. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy on ambiguous, cross-organizational problems turning open-ended strategic questions into concrete programs with a credible path to success and you will set the technical program management standard for the teams around you.

Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure Software Systems Responsibilities:

rows.title: AI Research Scientist —Generative AI for Materials Discovery
rows.descriptionText:
Meta’s Reality Labs Research (RL-R) brings together a team of researchers, developers, and engineers to create the future of Mixed Reality (MR), Augmented Reality (AR), and Wearable Artificial Intelligence (AI). The Materials and Systems Innovation (MSI) group within Reality Labs Research creates and accelerates breakthrough materials and device technologies that unblock the path to low-cost, all-day wearable AR devices and advanced sensing and actuating systems for robotics. We identify key technology gaps requiring step-change innovation, build AI-driven autonomous discovery pipelines to compress development timelines, leverage external partners to accelerate research, and deliver high-quality technology solutions through cross-functional, high-performing teams.In this role, you will pioneer the application of generative AI to design novel compounds and molecular crystals, directly accelerating the discovery of next-generation materials for AR/VR devices and advanced robotic systems. Working at the frontier of deep generative modeling, computational chemistry, and agentic AI, you will develop and deploy state-of-the-art models — including diffusion models, flow matching, and transformer-based architectures — that predict and generate stable crystal structures and molecular candidates with target properties. Your work will be tightly integrated into our AI-driven autonomous discovery platform, collaborating with computational chemists and AI agent scientists to close the loop from molecular design to experimental validation.Together, we are going to build advanced prototypes, technologies, and toolsets that can advance how people interact with their surroundings. We invite you to join us as we work to bring these technologies from research to reality.

AI Research Scientist —Generative AI for Materials Discovery Responsibilities:

Develop, train, and deploy generative models (diffusion models, flow matching, variational autoencoders, transformer-based architectures) for molecular and crystal structure generation, property-conditioned design, and crystal structure prediction (CSP)Design and implement reinforcement learning and alignment strategies (e.g., physics-informed reward signals from machine-learned interatomic potentials) to steer generative models toward physically stable and synthesizable candidatesBuild foundational models and scalable pretraining pipelines that unify generative and predictive learning across molecules and crystalline materials, handling both discrete atom types and continuous 3D geometriesCollaborate closely with computational chemists to integrate first-principles calculations (DFT, force fields), molecular dynamics simulations, and domain-specific constraints into generative workflowsPartner with AI agent scientists to embed generative molecular design capabilities into LLM-based multi-agent systems, enabling closed-loop autonomous experiment planning, candidate generation, and decision makingCurate, preprocess, and manage large-scale molecular and crystal structure datasets for model training and benchmarkingEstablish rigorous evaluation frameworks — measuring validity, novelty, uniqueness, stability, and synthesizability of generated structures — and benchmark against state-of-the-art methodsContribute to the architecture and roadmap of the autonomous materials-discovery platform, ensuring generative design modules interface seamlessly with robotic workcells, characterization instruments, and data infrastructure

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experiencePh.D. degree in Machine Learning, Computational Chemistry, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or a closely related technical field3+ years of research experience in generative modeling applied to molecular systems, crystal structures, or materials science (academic or industry)Familiarity with large-scale molecular and crystal databases and data processing pipelines for chemical dataDemonstrated expertise in deep generative models — including diffusion models, flow matching / continuous normalizing flows, variational autoencoders, or autoregressive models — with applications to 3D molecular or crystal structure generationProgramming proficiency in Python with hands-on experience in PyTorch or JAXproficiency in building, training, and evaluating large-scale deep learning modelsTrack record of first-author publications in top-tier ML or computational chemistry venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, JACS, Nature Computational Science, Digital Discovery)Solid understanding of crystallography fundamentals— and molecular representations (molecular graphs, SMILES, 3D conformers)

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience integrating ML models into agentic AI frameworks or LLM-based multi-agent systems for autonomous scientific discoveryExperience with crystal structure prediction (CSP) pipelines, including lattice energy ranking and structure relaxation using machine-learned interatomic potentialsDemonstrated ability to collaborate across disciplines — bridging ML research with experimental chemistry, materials science, and software engineering teamsExperience building or fine-tuning foundation models (100M+ parameters) for chemical or materials domains, including multimodal architectures that jointly handle molecular graphs, 3D coordinates, and periodic lattice structuresKnowledge of geometric deep learning, equivariant neural networks, or graph neural networks for molecular property predictionFamiliarity with reinforcement learning or RLHF-style alignment techniques applied to molecular or materials generation

rows.descriptionText:

rows.descriptionText:

You will design the planning process itself, build alignment on it across a large and technically diverse set of partner teams, educate those teams on how to participate, and guide both demand and supply organizations through its execution. This is a senior individual contributor role for a planning practitioner with depth across data center infrastructure, power, supply chain, and infrastructure demand.

Own the medium-range and long-range infrastructure capacity planning processes end to end, from demand collection through supply commitment.Partner with infrastructure engineering teams, product groups, and finance to translate product and AI roadmaps into multi-year compute, power, and data center capacity requirements.Design, document, and iterate on the planning process, including the planning calendar, required inputs, decision checkpoints, and published outputs.Educate partner teams on the planning process and build the shared definitions, artifacts, and templates that teams use to participate in it.Guide demand teams in forecasting and articulating their infrastructure requirements, and guide supply teams in translating those requirements into build, procurement, and deployment plans.Identify gaps between forecasted infrastructure demand and planned supply, and drive the trade-off decisions needed to close them.Define the metrics used to measure forecast accuracy, plan attainment, and capacity utilization, and drive improvement against those metrics over time.Partner with data center and supply chain teams on lead times, constraints, and sequencing that determine when capacity can be delivered.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience15+ years of experience in capacity planning, supply chain planning, or demand planningExperience designing and owning a recurring, multi-quarter planning process spanning multiple organizationsExperience with data center infrastructure planning, including power, capacity, or supply chain constraintsExperience presenting planning recommendations and trade-offs to executive-level audiences

rows.title: AI Research Scientist —Generative AI for Materials Discovery
rows.descriptionText:
Meta’s Reality Labs Research (RL-R) brings together a team of researchers, developers, and engineers to create the future of Mixed Reality (MR), Augmented Reality (AR), and Wearable Artificial Intelligence (AI). The Materials and Systems Innovation (MSI) group within Reality Labs Research creates and accelerates breakthrough materials and device technologies that unblock the path to low-cost, all-day wearable AR devices and advanced sensing and actuating systems for robotics. We identify key technology gaps requiring step-change innovation, build AI-driven autonomous discovery pipelines to compress development timelines, leverage external partners to accelerate research, and deliver high-quality technology solutions through cross-functional, high-performing teams.In this role, you will pioneer the application of generative AI to design novel compounds and molecular crystals, directly accelerating the discovery of next-generation materials for AR/VR devices and advanced robotic systems. Working at the frontier of deep generative modeling, computational chemistry, and agentic AI, you will develop and deploy state-of-the-art models — including diffusion models, flow matching, and transformer-based architectures — that predict and generate stable crystal structures and molecular candidates with target properties. Your work will be tightly integrated into our AI-driven autonomous discovery platform, collaborating with computational chemists and AI agent scientists to close the loop from molecular design to experimental validation.Together, we are going to build advanced prototypes, technologies, and toolsets that can advance how people interact with their surroundings. We invite you to join us as we work to bring these technologies from research to reality.

AI Research Scientist —Generative AI for Materials Discovery Responsibilities:

Develop, train, and deploy generative models (diffusion models, flow matching, variational autoencoders, transformer-based architectures) for molecular and crystal structure generation, property-conditioned design, and crystal structure prediction (CSP)Design and implement reinforcement learning and alignment strategies (e.g., physics-informed reward signals from machine-learned interatomic potentials) to steer generative models toward physically stable and synthesizable candidatesBuild foundational models and scalable pretraining pipelines that unify generative and predictive learning across molecules and crystalline materials, handling both discrete atom types and continuous 3D geometriesCollaborate closely with computational chemists to integrate first-principles calculations (DFT, force fields), molecular dynamics simulations, and domain-specific constraints into generative workflowsPartner with AI agent scientists to embed generative molecular design capabilities into LLM-based multi-agent systems, enabling closed-loop autonomous experiment planning, candidate generation, and decision makingCurate, preprocess, and manage large-scale molecular and crystal structure datasets for model training and benchmarkingEstablish rigorous evaluation frameworks — measuring validity, novelty, uniqueness, stability, and synthesizability of generated structures — and benchmark against state-of-the-art methodsContribute to the architecture and roadmap of the autonomous materials-discovery platform, ensuring generative design modules interface seamlessly with robotic workcells, characterization instruments, and data infrastructure

Minimum Qualifications:

3+ years of research experience in generative modeling applied to molecular systems, crystal structures, or materials science (academic or industry)Familiarity with large-scale molecular and crystal databases and data processing pipelines for chemical dataDemonstrated expertise in deep generative models — including diffusion models, flow matching / continuous normalizing flows, variational autoencoders, or autoregressive models — with applications to 3D molecular or crystal structure generationProgramming proficiency in Python with hands-on experience in PyTorch or JAXproficiency in building, training, and evaluating large-scale deep learning modelsTrack record of first-author publications in top-tier ML or computational chemistry venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, JACS, Nature Computational Science, Digital Discovery)Solid understanding of crystallography fundamentals— and molecular representations (molecular graphs, SMILES, 3D conformers)

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience integrating ML models into agentic AI frameworks or LLM-based multi-agent systems for autonomous scientific discoveryHands-on experience with computational chemistry tools and simulation frameworks (DFT codes such as VASP/Gaussian, molecular dynamics with LAMMPS/OpenMM/ASE, force field development)Experience with crystal structure prediction (CSP) pipelines, including lattice energy ranking and structure relaxation using machine-learned interatomic potentialsDemonstrated ability to collaborate across disciplines — bridging ML research with experimental chemistry, materials science, and software engineering teamsExperience building or fine-tuning foundation models (100M+ parameters) for chemical or materials domains, including multimodal architectures that jointly handle molecular graphs, 3D coordinates, and periodic lattice structuresKnowledge of geometric deep learning, equivariant neural networks, or graph neural networks for molecular property predictionFamiliarity with reinforcement learning or RLHF-style alignment techniques applied to molecular or materials generation

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

rows.descriptionText:
Meta is seeking a Research Engineer to join the Safety Evaluation team within Meta Superintelligence Labs. Our mission is to make the safety of Meta's frontier AI systems measurable — turning ambiguous notions of "safe" into rigorous, defensible metrics that model developers, product teams, and company leadership rely on to make launch decisions.Safety evaluation is the ground truth for every safety claim Meta makes. This role owns that ground truth: designing the evaluations that detect emerging risks in text, image, voice, video, and agentic systems; building the infrastructure that runs them continuously against training checkpoints and production traffic; and setting the technical direction for how safety is measured across Meta's AI portfolio. You will define measurement standards that outlast any single model generation, and your results will directly gate what ships to billions of people.

rows.title: Assistant Commercial Excellence Manager - Calvin Klein & Hugo Boss
rows.descriptionText:
COMMERCIAL EXCELLENCE ASSISTANT MANAGER SALES / COMMERCIAL EXCELLENCE SW19 - Wimbledon (2 to 3 days per week in the office) 

As Commercial Excellence Assistant Manager, you will play an important role in supporting Coty’s commercial agenda across some of the UK’s most iconic prestige fragrance brands, including Calvin Klein and Hugo Boss.
Working closely with the Commercial Excellence Team and cross-functional partners, you will help turn sales data, retailer performance and brand plans into clear commercial actions that support growth across key customers including Boots, Superdrug and Amazon.
This role offers an exciting blend of commercial analysis, stakeholder management, promotional planning and hands-on execution. You will gain exposure to sales performance, brand meetings, media strategy, retailer planning, launch execution and international collaboration, while building the commercial foundations needed to grow within a fast-paced global beauty business.

THE ROLE 
OPTIMIZE, ENABLE, INNOVATE! 
As our Commercial Excellence Assistant Manager, you will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day commercial excellence agenda for Calvin Klein and Hugo Boss. You will help analyse performance, coordinate commercial activity and support the team in delivering excellent execution across retailers, brands and internal stakeholders.
This role combines sales analysis, commercial planning, stakeholder coordination, promotional execution and modern, data-driven ways of working. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Brand, Media, International teams and retailer partners to support shared commercial goals, while using digital and AI-enabled tools to improve reporting, generate insights and support faster decision making.

Retailer Planning and Commercial Execution Support day-to-day commercial activity across key retailer partners including Boots, Superdrug and Amazon.Help coordinate promotional plans, customer initiatives and brand activity across retail channels.Support the development and execution of promo plans, including preparation for key planning periods such as September.Work with sales counterparts to understand customer priorities and support strong execution.Partner with internal teams to ensure commercial plans are delivered effectively and on time.Support retailer meeting preparation, including data inputs, performance updates and action tracking.Help ensure customer commitments, promotional plans and commercial actions are followed through.Bring energy, ownership and curiosity to a fast-moving commercial environment.
Brand, Media and Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Brand teams to understand new launches, brand priorities and commercial activation plans.Collaborate with Media teams to understand media strategy and how it connects to promotional and retailer activity.Interact regularly with international teams and cross-functional partners around shared commercial goals.Support Georgia and the wider team on day-to-day priorities while more senior meetings and longer-term projects are led at manager level.Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders across Sales, Brand, Media and Commercial Excellence.Communicate clearly and confidently in meetings, including with more senior stakeholders.Contribute to a collaborative team culture where people work together at pace and with shared ownership.Develop a strong understanding of how brand strategy, retailer execution and commercial performance connect.


YOU ARE A COTY FIT 
As a commercially curious and highly organised professional, you thrive in a fast-paced environment where data, collaboration and stakeholder engagement are key. You enjoy analysing performance, understanding what drives growth and turning information into clear actions.
You are passionate about beauty, eager to learn and motivated by the opportunity to work on iconic brands. You are articulate, personable and confident enough to contribute in meetings, while bringing the right attitude, pace and curiosity to keep developing in a commercial career.Around 2 to 4 years’ experience within a commercial, sales, analytics, category, trade marketing, retail, buying, merchandising or customer-facing environment.Experience within Beauty, FMCG, Consumer Goods or Retail would be advantageous.Strong commercial awareness and interest in how brands, retailers and promotional plans drive growth.Strong analytical capability and confidence working with sales data and performance reporting.Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.Strong communication skills and the confidence to speak clearly in meetings.Ability to work with a wide range of stakeholders across sales, brand, media, international teams and retailer partners.A proactive, positive and team-oriented working style.Curiosity, learning agility and passion for the beauty industry.Comfortable working with digital tools, reporting processes and data-driven ways of working.Curiosity about technology, AI and emerging ways of working that can improve commercial performance.Experience supporting a large brand, major retailer, fast-growth business or start-up style environment would be valuable.The drive, energy and ambition to build a successful commercial career within Coty.

If you're ready to help shape the performance of Calvin Klein and Hugo Boss within a leading global beauty business, we want you on our team!


WHAT WE OFFERThis is a unique opportunity to build strong commercial foundations within a global beauty company, supporting iconic fragrance brands and gaining broad exposure across sales performance, retailer planning, promotional activity, brand launches, media strategy and international collaboration.
You’ll gain experience across commercial excellence, sales analysis, stakeholder management, retailer execution, performance reporting and AI-enabled ways of working, developing the future-focused skills needed to succeed in a modern commercial organisation.
And if you'd like to build a successful career in the beauty industry...
At Coty, we have a strong track record of accelerating careers and creating opportunities well beyond your first role. A career at Coty could take you in many directions, including:
Fast-track commercial progressionProgress into broader Commercial Excellence, National Account Executive, National Account Manager, Commercial Manager or wider Sales and Commercial leadership roles.Take ownership of increasingly strategic brands, retailers, projects and commercial responsibilities.
Local and international opportunitiesExplore career moves across our regional and global teams.Opportunities to work from Coty locations including New York, Amsterdam, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Sydney, Tokyo and other offices around the world.
Cross-functional career pathwaysMove into exciting adjacent functions such as Marketing, Digital, Category Management, Revenue Growth Management, Ecommerce and broader Commercial leadership roles.Build a diverse skill set across commercial, brand-facing, analytical and retailer-focused disciplines.
Wherever you want your career to go, Coty offers the scale, brands, people and opportunities to help you get there.
You will also have a great benefits package including, amongst others, the following:A competitive benefits package to support your health, wellbeing and financial securityPrivate medical insurance with fast access to specialist and mental health support8% pension fully contributed by CotyLife assurance and income protection for added peace of mindFlexible hybrid working with our Omni-Working model, with up to 50% remote workingGenerous family-friendly policies including enhanced parental leave, birthday leave, volunteering days and sabbatical optionsEveryday perks including employee discounts and salary sacrifice schemesOpportunities to get involved in DE&I, sustainability and employee-led initiatives25 days of holidays + extra 4 days allowance including a day off for your birthday

rows.descriptionText:
About Strava

Strava is the app for active people. With over 200 million athletes in more than 185 countries, it’s more than tracking workouts—it’s where people make progress together, from new habits to new personal bests. No matter your sport or how you track it, Strava’s got you covered. Find your crew, crush your goals, and make every effort count. Start your journey with Strava today.

Our mission is simple: to motivate people to live their best active lives. We believe in the power of movement to connect and drive people forward.

About This Role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead and improve the subscription experience across Strava. In this role, you will shape and run our conversion and monetization strategy, running fast-paced experiments to increase subscriber growth and retention. You will own the strategy for how users discover and experience Strava's full value, working closely with engineering, design, data, research, and marketing to understand the holistic journey and improve it.

We follow a flexible hybrid model that generally translates to around half of your time on-site in our San Francisco office—roughly three days per week.

What You'll Do

Own the subscription strategy and roadmap to increase free-to-paid conversion and long-term subscriber retention. Design and drive rigorous experiments that help us understand and learn about what drives purchase decisions across the full funnel – from pricing and packaging to messaging and value prop positioning. Work closely with engineering, design, analytics, research, and marketing to deliver high-quality experiences. Track and own core subscription health metrics—including conversion rates, churn, renewals, and lifetime value. Communicate experimentation strategy, performance and trade-offs to product peers and leadership

What You'll Bring To The Team

5+ years of experience managing global subscription products, conversion funnels, or driving growth in consumer software. Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience with experimentation and A/B testing and evaluating results (e.g. conversion rate, trial-to-paid, plan mix shift, LTV)A calm, adaptable operator who thrives amidst rapid change, bringing clarity and focus to a fast-paced environment. Action-oriented mindset with the ability to prioritize work and solve complex problems, balancing a high quality user experience with revenue impact. Clear communication skills, with the ability to build consensus across product, engineering, data, design, research, marketing, and leadership teams. 

For information on benefits, please click here.

Why Join Us?

Movement brings us together. At Strava, we’re building the world’s largest community of active people, helping them stay motivated and achieve their goals.

Our global team is passionate about making movement fun, meaningful, and accessible to everyone. Whether you’re shaping the technology, growing our community, or driving innovation, your work at Strava makes an impact.

When you join Strava, you’re not just joining a company—you’re joining a movement. If you’re ready to bring your energy, ideas, and drive, let’s build something incredible together.

Strava builds software that makes the best part of our athletes’ days even better. Just as we’re deeply committed to unlocking their potential, we’re dedicated to providing a world-class, inclusive workplace where our employees can grow and thrive, too. We’re backed by Sequoia Capital, TCV, Madrone Partners and Jackson Square Ventures, and we’re expanding in order to exceed the needs of our growing community of global athletes. Our culture reflects our community. We are continuously striving to hire and engage teammates from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives because we know we are a stronger team together.

In keeping with the values of Strava, we make all employment decisions including hiring, evaluation, termination, promotional and training opportunities, without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, physical handicap, mental disability, medical condition, disability, gender or identity or expression, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, marital status, height and/or weight.
